Oloferinesi ategeka ko bamwinjiza aho babikaga ibikoresho bye bya feza, bigenewe ameza ye. Ategeka ko bamugaburira ku biribwa bye no kuri divayi ye.
heading: Yudita acumbika mu ngando y’Abanyashuru

text: Nyamara Yudita aramubwira ati «Nzirinda kubiryaho, bitazangusha mu ikosa; ibyo nazanye ni byo bizantunga.»
Oloferinesi ati «Ese impamba yawe nishira, tuzashobora dute kukubonera ibindi nka byo? Kuko muri twe, nta muntu n’umwe wo mu bwoko bwawe.»
Yudita aramusubiza ati «Gira amahoro, shobuja! Umuja wawe ntazamara impamba mfite hano, mbere y’uko Uhoraho akoresha ikiganza cyanjye ibyo yateganyije.»
Ibyegera bya Oloferinesi bimuyobora mu ihema ry’icumbi, araharyama kugeza mu gicuku, nuko ahagana mu museke, arabyuka.
Atuma kuri Oloferinesi ati «Databuja ategeke ko bajya bareka umuja wawe agasohoka gusenga.»
Maze Oloferinesi ategeka abamurindaga kutabimubuza. Yudita amara iminsi itatu mu ngando. Yasohokaga nijoro, akerekeza mu kabande ka Betuliya, maze akiyuhagira ku isoko y’amazi.
Iyo yazamukaga, yasabaga Uhoraho Imana ya Israheli kugira ngo amuyobore mu mugambi we wo kuzahura ubwoko bwe.
Yaba amaze guhindukira yisukuye, akaguma mu ihema rye, kugeza igihe bamuzanira ibiryo bye ahagana ku mugoroba.
heading: Oloferinesi akoresha igitaramo cyo gusangira

text: Hanyuma, ku munsi wa kane, Oloferinesi akoresha isangira ry’abagaragu be bonyine, ntiyagira n’umwe atumira mu bafasha be bakuru.
Abwira Bagowasi, umukone we wari ushinzwe ibye byose, ati «Genda wumvishe wa mugore w’Umuhebureyikazi uri iwawe, ko yadusanga iwacu, tugasangira ibyo kurya n’ibyo kunywa.
Koko byadutera ikimwaro, turetse umugore nk’uriya akagenda tudashyikiranye. Kuko turamutse tutamwiyegereje, yazaduseka!»

Bagowasi asohoka rero kwa Oloferinesi, yinjira kwa Yudita, maze aramubwira ati «Uyu muja w’uburanga ntatinye kuza agana databuja, kugira ngo ahabwe icyubahiro imbere ye! Aranywa divayi mu byishimo hamwe natwe, maze uyu munsi abe nk’umwe mu bakobwa b’Abanyashuru bahora mu ngoro ya Nebukadinetsari.»
Yudita aramusubiza ati «Ndi nde kugira ngo mvuguruze databuja? Icyo abona cyiza cyose nzihutira kugikora, kandi bizahore binshimisha kugeza igihe nzapfira.»

Arahaguruka, yambara imyenda myiza n’imirimbo ye yose ya kigore. Umuja we amubanza imbere kwa Oloferinesi, maze asasa impu hasi, kugira ngo Yudita aze gufungura azirambarayeho. Izo mpu yari yarazihawe na Bagowasi, kugira ngo ajye azicaraho buri munsi.

Yudita arinjira, ararambarara, nuko amaso ya Oloferinesi atwarwa n’ubwiza bwe, maze umutima we uraturagurwa. Agira icyifuzo gikomeye cyane cyo kuryamana na we: kuva umunsi yari yamubonyeho ubwa mbere, yashakaga akanya keza ko kumushuka.
Aramubwira rero ngo «Cyo nywa, wishimane natwe».
Yudita aramubwira ati «Ndi bunywe, shobuja, kuko kuva navuka, nta gihe ubuzima bwanjye bwizihiwe nk’uyu munsi.»
Yudita afata ku byo umuja we yari yamuteguriye, maze arira kandi anywera imbere ye.

Oloferinesi yari yatwawe n’ibyishimo kubera Yudita, nuko anywa divayi y’ikirenga atari yarigeze anywa n’umunsi n’umwe kuva aho yavukiye.Currently Selected:Yudita 12: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Bumaze kwira byatinze, ibyegera bya Oloferinesi byihutira gutaha. Bagowasi akingira hanze ihema rya shebuja, nuko yigizayo abahatindaga, bose bajya kuryama, bananijwe n’inzoga z’ikirenga.
heading: Yudita aca umutwe Oloferinesi

text: Yudita wenyine arekerwa mu ihema hamwe na Oloferinesi wari watembagaye ku buriri bwe, kuko yari yinamye muri divayi.

Yudita rero abwira umuja we guhagarara hanze, hafi y’icyumba baryamamo, no kuhamutegerereza aho aza gusohokera nk’uko yari asanzwe abigira buri munsi. Ubundi kandi, amwibutsa ko aza gusohoka akajya gusenga; anabibwira Bagowasi.

Bose rero bari basohotse bava kwa Oloferinesi, kandi nta n’umwe, yaba muto yaba mukuru, wari wasigaye mu cyumba yaryamagamo. Uko yari yagahagaze hafi y’igitanda cya Oloferinesi, Yudita aribwira ati «Uhoraho Mana y’ububasha bwose, muri iyi saha erekeza amaso ku byo ndi bukore, kugira ngo Yeruzalemu ishimagizwe.
Koko rero, ubu igihe kirageze cyo kwita ku ngenerwamurage zawe, no kurangiza umugambi wanjye, kugira ngo mponyore abanzi baduhagurukiye.»
Yegera rero umutambiko w’igitanda wari wegereye umutwe wa Oloferinesi, akura inkota ye,
asatira uburiri, akamata umusatsi w’uwo mugabo, aravuga ati «Mpa imbaraga kuri uyu munsi, Nyagasani, Mana ya Israheli!»
Nuko Yudita amukubita ku gikanu n’imbaraga ze zose, agira kabiri, amuca umutwe.
Ahubura rero umurambo wa Oloferinesi ku gitanda; umwenda wari ukingirije awuvana ku nkingi. Hashize akanya arasohoka, ahereza umuja we umutwe wa Oloferinesi,

na we awushyira mu ruhago. Bombi barasohokana, nk’uko bari basanzwe babigenza bagiye gusenga. Bambukiranya ingando, bakikira umubande wose, bazamuka umusozi wa Betuliya, maze bagera ku marembo y’umugi.
heading: Yudita yinjira muri Betuliya

text: Bakiri kure, Yudita ahamagara abarindazamu, ati «Nimukingure, nimukingure irembo! Imana, Imana yacu iri kumwe natwe, yo ihora igaragariza ubuhangare bwayo muri Israheli, n’imbaraga zayo mu banzi bacu, nk’uko yabigenjeje uyu munsi.»
Igihe abantu bo mu mugi bumvise ijwi rye, bihutira kumanuka bagana irembo ry’umugi, kandi bahamagara n’abakuru b’umugi.
Kuva ku muto kugera ku mukuru, bose baza biruka, kuko batizeraga ko ashobora kugaruka. Bakingura irembo, barabakira. Bacana umuriro wo kubonesha, maze barabakikiza.
Yudita ababwira mu ijwi riranguruye, ati «Nimusingize Imana! Nimusingize Imana itakuye impuhwe zayo ku nzu ya Israheli, maze iri joro ikaba yahonyoje abanzi bacu ukuboko kwanjye.»

Nuko avana wa mutwe mu ruhago, arawubereka, ati «Nimurebe umutwe wa Oloferinesi, umugaba mukuru w’ingabo za Ashuru. Nimurebe kandi umwenda wari ukingirije aho yari yatembagaye yasinze. Uhoraho yamukubitishije ukuboko k’umugore!
Harakabaho Uhoraho wandinze mu nzira nakurikiye! Kuko uruhanga rwanjye rwanyuze uwo mugabo, rukamugusha mu cyorezo, tudakoranye icyaha cyanyanduza kikantera isoni.»
Imbaga yose iratangara cyane; bose barunama, baramya Imana, maze bavugira icyarimwe, bati «Singizwa, Mana yacu, wowe watsembye abanzi b’umuryango wawe uyu munsi!»

Oziya abwira Yudita, ati «Mwana wanjye, Imana isumba byose niguhunde imigisha, uhebuze abagore bose bo ku isi. Kandi nasingizwe Uhoraho, Imana, we waremye ijuru n’isi, kandi akaba yarakuyoboye kugira ngo uce umutwe w’umutware w’abanzi bacu.
Koko rero, abantu bo mu bihe byose ntibazahwema kuzirikana mu mitima yabo uko wiringiye Imana, n’ukuntu yakugaragarije ubuhangare bwayo.

Imana niguhe kuratwa iteka no guhora ubona ibyiza byayo, kuko utazigamye ubuzima bwawe igihe ubwoko bwacu bwari bwasuzuguwe, ahubwo ukamagirira kure ukurimburwa kwacu, ugenda mu butungane imbere y’Imana yacu.» Imbaga yose irasubiza iti «Amen! Amen!»Currently Selected:Yudita 13: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Yudita arababwira ati «Nimutege amatwi, bavandimwe. Mufate uyu mutwe, maze muwumanike hejuru y’inkike yanyu.
heading: Akiyoro yemera Imana y’ukuri ya Israheli

text: Noneho umuseke numara gukeba, n’izuba ritangiye kurasa ku isi, mufate buri wese intwaro ze, maze umugabo wese muzima aze gusohoka mu mugi. Abo bantu mubahe umutware, mbese nk’aho mwaba mushaka kumanuka mu gisiza mugana itsinda rya mbere ry’Abanyashuru badusatiriye. Ariko ntimumanuke!

Bazihutira gufata intwaro zabo, ngo basubire mu ngando, bakangure abagaba b’ingabo za Ashuru. Noneho baze kuvuduka binjire mu ihema rya Oloferinesi, maze be kumubona. Ubwoba bubatahe, maze babahungire kure;
mwebwe mubatsinde mu nzira banyura zose.

Ariko mbere yo gukora ibyo, nimubanze mumpamagarire Akiyoro w’Umuhamoni, kugira ngo yirebere ubwe kandi ahamye ko uyu koko ari uwari wasuzuguye inzu ya Israheli akamwohereza muri twe nk’usanga urupfu.»
Bahamagara Akiyoro ava mu nzu ya Oziya. Akihagera, arabukwa umutwe wa Oloferinesi wari ufashwe n’umwe mu bari bateraniye aho, nuko agwa yubamye, ararabirana.
Bamaze kumubyutsa, yijugunya ku birenge bya Yudita, yunama cyane imbere ye, maze aravuga ati «Vugwa ibigwi mu mahema yose ya Yuda, no mu mahanga yose; kandi abazumva izina ryawe bazashye ubwoba!

Ngaho, ntekerereza ibyo wakoze byose muri iyi minsi.» Yudita na we, ahagaze hagati muri iyo mbaga, amurondorera ibyo yakoze byose kuva ku munsi asohotse muri Betuliya kugeza muri uwo mwanya yavugagaho.
Arangije kuvuga, imbaga yose itera hejuru n’amashyi y’urufaya, umugi wuzura urusaku rw’ibyishimo.
Akiyoro abonye ibyo Imana ya Israheli yari yakoze byose, yemera Imana cyane, arigenyesha, maze yakirwa bidasubirwaho mu muryango w’Abayisraheli.
heading: Bagowasi ahishura umurambo wa Oloferinesi

text: Umuseke ukebye, bamanika umutwe wa Oloferinesi ku nkike y’umugi. Buri muntu afata intwaro ze, maze basohoka udutsiko bagana ku manga y’umusozi.
Abanyashuru bababonye, bohereza intumwa ku bakuru babo, na bo babimenyesha abagaba babo, abatware bategekaga ingabo igihumbi, n’abandi bategetsi babo bose.
Bajya ku ihema rya Oloferinesi, nuko babwira uwari ushinzwe ibye byose, bati «Kangura umutegetsi wacu, kuko ba batindi b’abacakara batinyutse kumanuka kurwana natwe ngo tubatsembe burundu.»
Bagowasi rero ni ko kwinjira. Akomanga ku nyegamo y’ihema, agira ngo Oloferinesi aryamanye na Yudita.
Ariko kuko nta wakomaga, yigizayo inyegamo, yinjira mu cyumba cyo kuraramo. Nuko amusanga ari intumbi, arambaraye hasi imbere y’urwuririro, bamuciye umutwe.
Bagowasi arataka cyane, ararira, aratsikimba, araboroga, ashishimura imyambaro ye.
Nuko yinjira mu ihema aho Yudita yari acumbitse, ntiyahamusanga. Avuduka agana imbaga, abogoza ati
«Abacakara bigaragambije! Umugore umwe w’Abahebureyi ateje ikimwaro inzu y’umwami Nebukadinetsari. Dore Oloferinesi agaramye ku butaka, bamuciye umutwe!»

Babyumvise, abatware b’ingabo za Ashuru bashishimura imyenda yabo; baradagadwa cyane, bavuza induru, maze ingando yose bayikwiza imiborogo.Currently Selected:Yudita 14: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Abari bakiri mu mahema babyumvise, barumirwa kubera ibyari byabaye.
heading: Abanyashuru bahunga Abayisraheli

text: Baradagadwa kandi bagira ubwoba cyane. Ntihagira umuntu n’umwe uguma iruhande rw’undi, ahubwo banyanyagirira rimwe, bahunga banyura mu tuyira twose two mu mibande n’imusozi.
Abari baciye ingando mu misozi miremire ikikije Betuliya, na bo barahunga. Ubwo rero ingabo za Israheli, abashoboye kurwana bose, zirabahomerera.

Oziya yohereza intumwa i Betomesitemu, i Bebayi, i Koba n’i Kola. Azohereza no mu gihugu cyose cya Israheli kugira ngo zibamenyeshe ibyari byabaye, maze zibasabe bose gutangatanga abanzi no kubatsemba.

Ibyo babyumvise, Abayisraheli birohera ku banzi icyarimwe, barabarwanya kugera i Koba. Abaturage b’i Yeruzalemu barabakurikira na bo, ndetse n’abo mu misozi miremire bose, kuko bari bamenyeshejwe ibyari byabaye mu ngando y’abanzi babo. Abo muri Gilihadi n’abo muri Galileya babatera baturutse ku ruhande, barabarwanya bikaze, babageza i Damasi no mu karere kayikikije.
Naho abandi bari basigaye i Betuliya, biroha ahari ingando y’Abanyashuru, barahasahura, barikungahaza cyane.

Abayisraheli bavuye muri iryo marana, bafata ibyari bisigaye byose. Abantu bo mu midugudu n’abo mu nsisiro zo mu misozi miremire n’abo mu gisiza, bigabagabanya iminyago myinshi, kuko yari ishyano ryose.
heading: Ibirori by’umutsindo w’Abayisraheli

text: Yowakimi, umuherezabitambo mukuru, hamwe n’inama y’abakuru b’imiryango y’Abayisraheli bari batuye i Yeruzalemu, baza kureba ibyiza Uhoraho yari yakoreye Israheli. Bashakaga kandi no kureba Yudita no kumusuhuza.
Binjiye iwe, bose bamushimagiriza icyarimwe, bavuga bati «Uri ikuzo rya Yeruzalemu, n’ishema rya Israheli! Uri ishimwe ry’abo mu bwoko bwacu bose!
Ibyo byose wabikoresheje ukuboko kwawe, ugirira neza Israheli, bishimisha Imana. Hundwa imigisha n’Uhoraho Umushoborabyose ubuziraherezo.» Nuko imbaga yose iravuga iti «Amen!»

Imbaga yose isahura aho ingando y’Abanyashuru yahoze, mu minsi mirongo itatu. Baha Yudita ihema rya Oloferinesi, ibikoresho bye byose bya feza, ibitanda bye, amabesani n’ibindi bye byose. Arabifata, abihekesha inyumbu ye, maze ibisigaye abirunda mu magare ye akururwa n’ibimasa.
Abagore bose ba Israheli bahururira kumureba, maze baramushimagiza, bamuririmbira. Yudita ubwe akura udushami ku biti, aduha abagore bari kumwe,

badukoramo amakamba y’imizeti, nuko barayambara. We nyine, na bagenzi be, bajya imbere y’imbaga yose, bayobora abandi bagore bose babyinaga, banaririmba. Abagabo bose bo muri Israheli, bitwaje intwaro zabo kandi batamirije amakamba, babaherekeza baririmba indirimbo z’ibyishongoro.

Rwagati mu mbaga y’Abayisraheli bose, Yudita atera indirimbo yo gushimira Imana, nuko imbaga yose ikajya isubiramo.Currently Selected:Yudita 15: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in

Yudita aravuga ati«Nimuterere Imana yanjye indirimbo,iherekezwe n’umurishyo w’ingoma.Nimuririmbire Uhoraho mukoresheje ibyuma birangira,nimumuhimbire icyishongoro cyo kumurata,musingize kandi mwiyambaze izina rye!
heading: Indirimbo ya Yudita

text: Kuko Uhoraho ari Imana itatanya ibitero by’intambara,aganditse rwagati mu muryango we,yangobotoye mu kiganza cy’abantotezaga.
Ashuru yaje iturutse mu misozi yo mu majyaruguru,izana n’uduhumbagiza tw’ingabo zayo;ubwinshi bwabo bwagomeraga imigezi,kandi amafarasi yabo agapfukira imisozi.
Bigambaga ko bazatwika igihugu cyanjye,bakamarisha abasore banjye inkota,ko bazoreka ibibondo byanjye,bakancuza abana banjye,n’inkumi zanjye bakazifata ku ngufu.
Uhoraho Umushoborabyose yarabibatesheje,abigirishije ukuboko k’umugore.

Koko kandi, intwari muri bo ntiyaguye izize abasore,si n’abakomoka ku bantu b’ibyamamare bamuhanantuye,cyangwa ngo ibihanyanswa bimutere,ahubwo ni Yudita, umukobwa wa Merari,wamutsindishije ubwiza bw’uruhanga rwe.
Yiyambuye ikanzu y’ubupfakazi,agira ngo yunamure imbabare za Israheli.Yasize uruhanga rwe imibavu,
imisatsi ye ayifatisha agashumi,yambarira ikanzu ya hariri kumureshya.
Urukweto rwe rwigarurira indoro ye,maze ubwiza bwe bumutwara umutima,nuko inkota imuca ijosi!
Abaperisi bahindishwa umushyitsi n’ubukaka bwe,n’Abamedi bakangaranywa n’ubutwari bwe.
Ni bwo rero intamenyekana zanjye zateye hejuru,maze bo bashya ubwoba,abanyantege nke banjye barasakuza,baranguruye ijwi, maze bo barahunga.
Inkota yarabahinguranijenk’aho ari utwana tukiri ku ibere,barabakomeretsa, nk’uko babigirira abahunga ku rugamba.Bapfira gushira mu gitero cyagabwe na Nyagasani!
Ngiye kuririmbira Imana yanjye indirimbo nshya:Nyagasani, uri igihangange, kandi wisesuyeho ikuzo;uri intagereranywa mu buhangare, ukaba na Rudasumbwa.
Ibiremwa byose nibikugaragire,kuko wavuze ijambo rimwe, byose bikaremwa.Umwuka wawe ni wo wabihaye intege,kandi nta muntu n’umwe uzananira ijwi ryawe.
Imisozi izarimbagurikira aho ishingiye,maze yivange n’imigezi,naho ibitare bizashonga nk’ibishashara,imbere y’uruhanga rwawe,nyamara abagutinya bo ntuhwema kubagirira impuhwe.
Impumuro y’igitambo gitwikwa yagushimisha ite,n’ikinure cyacyo batura, cyakumarira iki?Ariko utinya Uhoraho ahora ari igihangange.
Hagowe amahanga yiha kurwanya ubwoko bwanjye!Uhoraho Umushoborabyose azayihimura ku munsi w’urubanza,azagabiza imibiri yabo umuriro n’inyo,maze bazarizwe n’amagorwa yabo ubuzira herezo.»
Bageze i Yeruzalemu, baramya Imana, nuko imbaga imaze kwisukura, batura ibitambo bitwikwa, hamwe n’ibindi bitambo n’amaturo bishakiye.
Yudita atura Imana ibintu byose bya Oloferinesi, Abayisraheli bari bamuhaye, biratwikwa. Naho umwenda yari yivaniye ubwe mu cyumba cyo kuraramo cya Oloferinesi, awegurira Imana.
Bamara amezi atatu mu byishimo i Yeruzalemu, imbere y’ahantu hatagatifu. Nuko Yudita agumana na bo.
heading: Uko Yudita yashaje

text: Iyo minsi irangiye, buri wese asubira mu munani we. Yudita na we asubira i Betuliya, maze aguma mu isambu ye. Nuko aba ikirangirire mu gihugu, iminsi yose yabayeho.
Benshi bifuje kumureshya, ariko ntiyigeze agira undi mugabo babana mu minsi yose yari akiriho, kuva aho umugabo we Manase apfiriye agahambwa hamwe n’abasekuruza be.

Uko imyaka yashiraga, yarushagaho kuba ikirangirire; asazira mu nzu y’umugabo we, ageza ku myaka ijana n’itanu. Asubiza ubwigenge umuja we, nuko apfira i Betuliya, bamushyingura mu mva y’umugabo we Manase.
Inzu ya Israheli imwiraburira iminsi irindwi. Mbere yo gupfa, yari yaragabanije ibintu bye abo mu muryango w’umugabo we Manase, n’abo mu muryango we bwite.

Ntihongera kugira utera ubwoba Abayisraheli Yudita akiriho, bimara n’igihe kirekire nyuma y’urupfu rwe.Currently Selected:Yudita 16: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Aho Alegisanderi, mwene Filipo w’Umumasedoniya, wari waraturutse mu gihugu cya Kitimu, amariye kunesha Dariyusi, umwami w’Abaperisi n’Abamedi, yamuzunguye ku ngoma ahereye kuri Helade.
heading: Igoma ya Alegisanderi mukuru

text: Nuko agaba ibitero byinshi, yigarurira imigi myinshi ikomeye kandi atsemba abami bo muri ako karere.
Ni bwo akomeje, agera iyo gihera, avana muri ibyo bihugu iminyago itabarika, ku isi yose ntihagira urevura. Ibyo bimuviramo kwikuza, ubwirasi bumuziba umutima,
ahera ko agaba igitero gikomeye, yigarurira intara nyinshi, ibihugu; n’abami baramuyoboka bakajya bamuha amaturo.
Ibyo birangiye, afatwa n’indwara imuheza mu buriri, bityo amenya ko agiye gupfa.
Ni ko guhamagaza abatware b’abanyacyubahiro babyirukanye na we, maze abagabanya igihugu cye mbere y’uko apfa.
Nuko Alegisanderi apfa amaze imyaka cumi n’ibiri ku ngoma.
Abo batware batangira gutegeka, buri wese aho yagabanye.
Aho Alegisanderi apfiriye, abo batware bose batamiriza amakamba, bakomeza kuzungurwa n’abana babo imyaka ishira ari myinshi, cyakora bateza ibyago ku isi hose.
heading: Abayahudi bafata umuco w’Abagereki / ( / )

text: Muri bo haza kwaduka uwabarushije ububi bose, ari we Antiyokusi Epifani, umuhungu w’umwami Antiyokusi, wari warabaye igihe mu bugwate i Roma, aza kuba umwami mu mwaka w’ijana na mirongo itatu n’irindwi w’ingoma y’Abagereki.

Muri iyo minsi, muri Israheli haduka abantu b’ibyigomeke, bashuka abantu benshi bababwira bati «Nimucyo tugirane amasezerano n’amahanga adukikije, kuko kuva aho twitandukanyirije na yo, ari bwo twatewe n’ibyago bitagira ingano.»
Ayo magambo arabanyura.
Ni bwo benshi muri rubanda bihutiye gusanga umwami, na we abaha uburenganzira bwo gukurikiza imigenzereze y’abanyamahanga.
Nuko barema itorero i Yeruzalemu bakurikije imigenzereze y’ibyo bihugu by’amahanga,
ntibongera kugenya abahungu babo kandi bihakana Isezerano ritagatifu, kugira ngo basabane n’abanyamahanga. Bityo barigura ngo bakunde bakore ibidakwiye.
heading: Umwami Antiyokusi wa kane asahura Ingoro / ( / )

text: Antiyokusi ngo abone ko ubutegetsi bwe bumaze gushinga imizi, ashaka no kwigarurira igihugu cya Misiri kugira ngo ategeke ibyo bihugu byombi.
Ni ko kujyana mu Misiri igitero kinini cyane, amagare y’intambara, inzovu n’amato menshi,
atera Putolemeyi, umwami wa Misiri. Nuko Putolemeyi aza gusubira inyuma aramuhunga, asiga ku rugamba habuye abantu benshi.
Imigi ikomeye y’Abanyamisiri irafatwa, nuko Antiyokusi akura iminyago itabarika muri icyo gihugu.
Amaze gutsinda Misiri, ahindukira mu mwaka w’ijana na mirongo ine n’itatu, azamukana n’ingabo nyinshi cyane, maze atera igihugu cya Israheli n’umugi wa Yeruzalemu.
Antiyokusi yinjira mu Ngoro nta cyo yishisha, asahura urutambiro rwa zahabu, igitereko cy’amatara n’ibyacyo byose,

ameza yari agenewe gushyirwaho imigati y’umumuriko, intango zasukwagamo amaturo aseswa, inkongoro, amasafuriya ya zahabu, umubambiko n’amakamba; imitako ya zahabu yari mu ruhande rw’imbere rw’Ingoro, asiga ayitamuruye yose.
Asahura feza, zahabu n’ibikoresho by’agaciro gakomeye, ajyana n’ibindi byiza byinshi yashoboye kubona.
Amaze kubisahura byose, asubira mu gihugu cye, amaze kuhicira abantu benshi kandi ahavugiye amagambo y’ubwirasi bukomeye.
Nuko haba icyunamo muri Israheli yose:
Abatware n’abakuru b’umuryango baraganya,abasore n’inkumi bacika intege,n’uburanga bw’abagore burahindana.
Umusore umaze iminsi arongoye atangira kuganya,n’umugeni mu cyumba cye ajya mu cyunamo.
Isi ihinda umushyitsi kubera abayituye,n’inzu yose ya Yakobo ikorwa n’ikimwaro.
heading: Ikigo cy’i Yeruzalemu gikomezwa / ( / )

text: Hashize imyaka ibiri, umwami yohereza mu migi ya Yudeya umutware w’abakoreshakoro b’i Misiya, agera i Yeruzalemu n’igitero kinini cyane.
Aryarya abaturage abizeza amahoro, maze na bo baramwemera. Ariko umurwa aza kuwugwa gitumo, awuteza ibyago bikomeye kandi yica Abayisraheli batagira ingano.
Nuko asahura umurwa, arawutwika, asenya amazu yawo n’inkike zawo.
Abagore n’abana bajyanwa ari imbohe, amatungo yaho barayanyaga.
Bongera kubaka bundi bushya umurwa wa Dawudi, bawukikiza inkike ndende kandi ikomeye ifite iminara miremire, maze bawugira ikigo cyabo.
Bawushyiramo abantu b’inkozi z’ibibi kandi b’ibyigomeke, baba ari bo bahakomera.
Bahabika kandi n’intwaro, bahahunika ibiribwa, bahabika n’iminyago basahuye i Yeruzalemu, maze hababera ubwihugiko bukomeye.
Aho hantu habera Ingoro icyugarizi,n’umwanzi gica uzahoza Israheli ku nkeke.
Bamena amaraso y’intungane mu mpande zose z’Ingoro,bahindanya ahantu hatagatifu.
Abaturage ba Yeruzalemu barahunga kubera abo bantu,umugi wigarurirwa n’abanyamahanga,abawuvukiyemo ubahindukira ihangan’abana bawo bawuhungamo.
Ingoro yawo irasenywa ihinduka itongo,iminsi mikuru yawo ihinduka icyunamo,isabato zawo bazihindura agashinyaguro,n’icyubahiro cyawo gihinduka urw’amenyo.
Aho ikuzo ryawo ryageze,ni na ho ikimwaro cyagarukiye;n’ubwamamare bwawo buhinduka icyunamo.
heading: Antiyokusi akuraho imigenzo y’Abayahudi / ( / )

text: Bukeye, umwami ategeka ko abatuye igihugu cye cyose biremamo umuryango umwe rukumbi,
buri wese akareka imigenzo ye; maze amahanga yose agakurikiza amabwiriza y’umwami.
Abayisraheli benshi bakira neza iyobokamana rye, batura ibitambo ibigirwamana kandi bica isabato.
Umwami yohereza amabaruwa n’intumwa i Yeruzalemu no mu migi ya Yudeya, abategeka gukurikiza imigenzereze itari isanzwe mu gihugu cyabo,
kutongera guturira mu Ngoro ibitambo bitwikwa cyangwa se ibindi bitambo kimwe n’amaturo aseswa, kwica isabato n’iminsi mikuru,
guhumanya Ingoro n’ibikoresho bitagatifu,
kubaka intambiro, indaro n’ingoro z’ibigirwamana, gutura ingurube n’inyamaswa zahumanye ho ibitambo,
kureka kugenya abahungu babo no kwiyandarika borama mu bihumanya n’ibizira by’amoko yose,
bakibagirwa batyo Amategeko kandi bagahindanya imigenzo yabo yose.
Kandi umuntu wese utazakurikiza itegeko ry’umwami, azicwa.
Nuko umwami yandikira igihugu cye akurikije ayo mabwiriza yose, ashyiraho abagenzuzi mu gihugu cyose, n’abatuye muri Yudeya, abategeka ko buri mugi uzajya uturirwamo ibitambo.
Abenshi muri rubanda — abo bose nyine bari barihakanye Amategeko — bayoboka abo bantu b’umwami, maze igihugu bagiteza ibyago,
kandi batera ubwoba Abayisraheli, basigara bihisha ahantu hose babonye ubuhungiro.

Mu mwaka w’ijana na mirongo ine n’itanu, ku munsi wa cumi n’itanu w’ukwezi kwa Kisilewu, umwami atereka ishyano riteye agahinda ku rutambiro rw’ibitambo bitwikwa, bubaka intambiro mu migi ya Yudeya yari hafi aho.
Ku miryango y’amazu no ku bibuga bahatwikira ububani.
Naho ibitabo by’Amategeko babonaga bakabishwanyaguza babiroha mu muriro.
Uwo bafatanye igitabo cy’Isezerano cyangwa se uwo babonaga akurikiza Amategeko, iteka ry’umwami rikamucira urwo gupfa.
Buri kwezi bazengurukaga imigi bagahana Abayisraheli babaga bafashwe,
naho ku wa makumyabiri n’itanu wa buri kwezi, bagaturira ibitambo ku rutambiro rwubatswe aho urw’ibitambo bitwikwa rwahoze.
Abagore babaga baragenyesheje abahungu babo baricwaga, — nk’uko iteka ry’umwami ryabitegekaga —
bakabicana n’abana bonsa babaziritse ku ijosi, bakabicana n’ababaga babafashije muri uwo muhango wo kugenya.
Nyamara abenshi mu Bayisraheli bakomeza kuba intwari, bagira imbaraga zituma babasha kutarya ibintu byahumanye.
Bemera gupfa aho kurya ibiribwa byahumanye cyangwa kwica Isezerano ritagatifu; koko kandi barapfa.

Nuko muri iyo minsi, Israheli irarakarirwa bikomeye.Currently Selected:Icya mbere cy'Abamakabe 1: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Muri iyo minsi, haduka Matatiyasi mwene Yohani, umuhungu wa Simewoni, umuherezabitambo wo muri bene Yowaribu, yimuka i Yeruzalemu ajya gutura i Modini.
heading: II. MATATIYASI ATANGIRA INTAMBARA NTAGATIFU / Matatiyasi n’abahungu be

text: Yari afite abahungu batanu: Yohani bitaga Gadi,
Simoni witwaga irya Tasi,
Yuda witwaga irya Makabe,
Eleyazari witwaga irya Awarani, na Yonatesi witwaga irya Afusi.
Ubwo yitegereza amahano yakorwaga muri Yudeya n’i Yeruzalemu,

nuko aravuga ati «Mbega ishyano! Naba se naravukiye kureba uko umuryango wanjye urimbuka, no kwitegereza amatongo y’umugi mutagatifu? Ubwo se nzakomeza manjirwe, kandi umurwa mutagatifu wagabijwe abanzi, n’Ingoro yeguriwe abanyamahanga?
Ingoro yawo yahindutse nk’umuntu utakigira agaciro,
ibyarangaga ikuzo ryawo babitwayeho iminyago,ku bibuga byawo barahicira ibitambambuga,n’abasore bawo barashirira ku nkota y’umwanzi.
Ni irihe hanga ritahihaye ubutegetsi cyangwa ngo iby’aho ribyigabizeho iminyago?
Imirimbo yawo yose bayikuyeho,ubwigenge wahoranye, bwahindutse ubucakara.
None dore ahantu hacu hatagatifu,kirezi cyacu n’ikuzo ryacu, habaye itongo,amahanga yarahahumanyije.
Koko ubu kubaho biracyatumariye iki?»
Nuko Matatiyasi n’abahungu be bashishimura imyambaro yabo, bambara ibigunira kandi bajya mu cyunamo gikomeye.
heading: Igitambo cy’i Modini n’ingaruka zacyo

text: Nuko abatware b’ingabo z’umwami bari bashinzwe gutesha rubanda iby’iyobokamana, baza i Modini bazanywe no gutura ibitambo.
Abayisraheli benshi barahabasanga, ariko Matatiyasi n’abahungu be bajya ukwabo.
Abatware b’ingabo z’umwami ni ko guterura, babwira Matatiyasi, bati «Uri umutware w’ikirangirire muri uyu mugi, ushyigikiwe n’abahungu bawe n’abavandimwe.

Ngaho rero ngwino, abe ari wowe ubanziriza abandi kubahiriza itegeko ry’umwami, mbese nk’uko amahanga yose, abantu bo muri Yuda n’abasigaye i Yeruzalemu babigize. Bityo wowe n’abahungu bawe muzabarirwe mu ncuti z’umwami, muzagororerwe feza na zahabu, n’ibindi by’amoko menshi.»
Matatiyasi abasubiza mu ijwi riranguruye, ati «Niba imiryango yose iri mu gihugu cy’umwami imwumvira, buri muryango ukirengagiza imigenzo y’abasekuruza bawo igakurikiza amategeko ye,
jyewe, abahungu banjye n’abavandimwe banjye, tuzakurikiza Isezerano ry’abasekuruza bacu.
Imana iraturinde kwihakana Amategeko n’ibikorwa tugomba gukurikiza.
Nta bwo tuzumvira amategeko y’umwami, atuma duteshuka ku migenzo yacu ku buryo twabogamira iburyo cyangwa ibumoso.»
Ngo amare kuvuga ayo magambo, Umuyahudi aratambuka bose bamureba, kugira ngo ature igitambo ku rutambiro rw’i Modini, nk’uko iteka ry’umwami ryabitegekaga.
Matatiyasi ngo abibone, ishyaka rimugurumanamo yumva agize akanyabugabo; uburakari buba bwose maze ariruka amusogotera ku rutambiro.
Umuntu w’umwami wategekaga gutura ibitambo na we amutsinda aho, nuko urutambiro ararusenya.
Yarwaniye Amategeko ishyaka nk’iryo Pinehasi yigeze kugira, igihe yishe Zimiri mwene Salu.
Nuko Matatiyasi atera hejuru mu ijwi riranguruye, abwira umugi wose ati «Abantu bose biyumvamo ishyaka ry’Amategeko kandi bakaba bashyigikiye Isezerano, nibankurikire!»
Matatiyasi ubwe n’abahungu be bahungira mu misozi, basiga mu mugi ibyo bari batunze byose.
heading: Abayahudi b’indahemuka bagomera umwami

text: Nuko abantu benshi bifuzaga gukomeza ubutungane no gukurikiza Amategeko, baramanuka bajya kwiturira mu butayu,
bo n’abana babo, abagore babo n’amatungo yabo, kuko ibyago byari bimaze kubarembya.
Babimenyesha abatware b’umwami n’ingabo ze zari zituye i Yeruzalemu mu murwa wa Dawudi, ko abantu banze itegeko ry’umwami, bamanutse bakaba bihishe mu buvumo bwo mu butayu.
Ubwo igitero gikomeye kirabakurikirana, ngo bamare kubashyikira baca ingando ahateganye na bo, bitegura kubatera ku isabato.
Ni ko kubabwira bati «Rwose murakabije! Ngaho nimusohoke, mwumvire itegeko ry’umwami, bityo mubone kurokoka.»
Abandi barabasubiza bati «Ntidusohoka kandi ntituzumvira n’itegeko ry’umwami, ridutegeka kwica isabato.»
Baherako babirohaho,
ariko bo ntibarushya banirwanaho, habe ngo babatere n’amabuye cyangwa ngo bagire icyo bakinga ku buvumo bwabo.
Ahubwo baravuga bati «Nimureke dupfire mu butungane; ijuru n’isi ni byo dutanzeho abagabo, ko mutwishe muturenganyije.»
Nuko babirohaho kuri uwo munsi w’isabato, barabica, bo n’abagore babo, abana babo n’amatungo yabo, bose hamwe bageraga ku bantu igihumbi.
heading: Matatiyasi n’abantu be birwanaho

text: Matatiyasi n’incuti ze ngo babyumve barabaririra cyane,
maze barabwirana bati «Nituramuka tugenjeje nk’abavandimwe bacu, ntiturwanye abanyamahanga ngo turengere amagara yacu n’imigenzo yacu, baradutsemba ku isi bidatinze.»
Uwo munsi nyine, biyemeza ibi bikurikira: «Umuntu wese uzaza kudutera ku isabato, tuzamurwanye, hato twese tudapfira gushira nk’abavandimwe bacu bapfiriye mu buvumo.»
Nuko umuryango w’Abahasidimu urabasanga, bakaba abantu b’intwari muri Israheli, barwaniraga ishyaka Amategeko.
Abashakaga kwitarura ibyo bibi byose na bo baza kubunganira no kubater inkunga,
bahera ko barema igitero gikomeye, maze mu burakari bwabo batikiza abanyabyaha, mu mujinya wabo batsemba abahakanyi, abarokotse bahungira mu mahanga.
Matatiyasi n’incuti ze barahindukira, basenya intambiro,
kandi bagenya ku gahato abana bose bo mu gihugu cya Israheli, batari baragenywe.
Bamenesha ababasuzuguraga maze ibyo bifuje byose birabahira,
barwanira Amategeko bayambura abanyamahanga n’abami, ntibatuma umunyabyaha yigamba.
heading: Umurage wa Matatiyasi n’urupfu rwe

text: Nuko iminsi y’ubuzima bwa Matatiyasi igiye kurangira, abwira abahungu be, ati «Dore ubu higanje ugusebanya n’agasuzuguro, n’igihe cy’urugomo n’uburakari kirageze.
None rero bana banjye, nimurwanire ishyaka Amategeko, muhare n’amagara yanyu kubera Isezerano ry’abasekuruza.
Nimwibuke ibikorwa byakozwe n’abasekuruza bacumu gihe cyabo,bibaheshe ikuzo rikomeye kandi bibagireibirangirire ubuziraherezo.
Abrahamu se ntiyabaye indahemuka mu bigeragezo,maze bigatuma abonwaho ubutungane?
Yozefu na we yumviye Amategeko mu mibabaro ye,bituma aba umutegetsi wa Misiri.
Pinehasi, umukurambere wacu, kubera ishyaka rye ryinshi,yahawe isezerano ry’ubuherezabitambo buhoraho.
Yozuwe, kuba yaratunganyije umurimo we,byatumye agirwa umucamanza muri Israheli.
Kalebu, kubera ko yahamije ukuri mu ikoraniro,byamuhesheje umurage mu gihugu cye.
Dawudi, kubera ubudahemuka bwe,yarazwe intebe y’ubwami buzahoraho iteka.
Eliya, kubera ishyaka yarwaniye Amategeko,yaboneyeho kuzamurwa mu ijuru.
Ananiya, Azariya na Misayeli kuko biringiye Imana,barokotse indimi z’umuriro.
Daniyeli, kubera ubutungane bwe,yakijijwe urwasaya rw’intare.
Nuko rero namwe, nimumenye ko uko ibisekuruza bigenda bisimburana, abiringira Imana bose batazigera bajegajega.
Ntimugatinye ibikangisho by’umunyabyaha, kuko ikuzo rye rihinduka ibishingwe rikaribwa n’inyo.
Uyu munsi baba bamusingiza, ariko ejo ntiyongere kugaragara, nuko akisubirira mu mukungugu we, n’imigambi ye igahinduak ubusa.
Bana banjye, nimube intwari kandi mukomere ku Mategeko, kuko ari yo azabahesha ikuzo.
Nguwo Simewoni, umuvandimwe wanyu, nzi neza ko ari umuntu ugira inama nziza, mujye mumwumvira, azababera umubyeyi.
Yuda Makabe, wabaye intwari kuva mu buto bwe, azaba umugaba w’ingabo zanyu, maze azarwanye amahanga.
Naho mwebwe, nimwiyegereze abakurikiza Amategeko bose, maze muhorere umuryango wanyu.
Muziture amahanga inabi yabagiriye, kandi mwihambire ku mabwiriza mukesha Amategeko.»
Ibyo birangiye Matatiyasi abaha umugisha, maze yisangira abasekuruza be.

Yapfuye mu mwaka w’ijana na mirongo ine n’itandatu, ahambwa mu mva y’abasekuruza be i Modini, nuko Abayisraheli bose baramuririra bikomeye.Currently Selected:Icya mbere cy'Abamakabe 2: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Umuhungu wa Matatiyasi, Yuda wiswe irya Makabe, aramuzungura;
heading: III. YUDA MAKABE, UMUTWARE W’ABAYAHUDI (166–160 mb. K.) / Igisingizo cya Yuda Makabe

text: abavandimwe be n’abayoboke ba se bamutera inkunga, barwanira Israheli bashyizeho umwete.
Yamamaje ikuzo ry’umuryango we,yambara umwambaro w’icyuma nk’intwari,akenyera intwaro ze maze ashoza urugamba,arengera ingando ye akoresheje inkota ye.
Mu bigwi by’ubutwari asa n’intare,cyangwa icyana cyayo kivugira ku muhigo wacyo.
Yakurikiranye abahakanyi abavumbura aho bihishe,atwika abadurumbanyaga umuryango we.
Abahakanyi batsindwa n’ubwoba abateye,ab’inkozi z’ibibi bose barahahamuka,ukuboko kwe guhirwa no gutabara.
Abami benshi yabateye kwiheba,maze ibikorwa bye bishimisha Yakobo,azahora asingizwa ubuziraherezo.
Yazengurutse imigi ya Yuda ayitsembamo abahakanyi,bityo akiza Israheli uburakari bw’Imana.
Yabaye ikirangirire kugera ku mpera z’isi,akoranyiriza hamwe abari barazimiye.
heading: Yuda atsinda incuro ebyiri

text: Nuko Apoloni akoranya abanyamahanga n’izindi ngabo nyinshi zo muri Samariya, kugira ngo atere Israheli.
Yuda ngo abimenye aramusanganira, aramutsinda maze aramwica. Benshi barakomereka byo gupfa, abasigaye barahunga.
Nuko bararuza iminyago, Yuda atwara inkota ya Apoloni, akaba ari yo arwanisha mu ntambara zose yarwanye mu buzima bwe.
Seroni, umugaba w’ingabo zo muri Siriya, amenye ko Yuda yiyegereje ingabo z’abayobokamana, kandi abantu bamenyereye intambara,
aribwira ati «Ngomba kugira icyivugo n’ikuzo mu gihugu. Ngiye rero kurwanya Yuda n’abantu be, bihaye guhinyura itegeko ry’umwami.»
Nuko na we aragenda, azamukana n’igitero kinini cy’abagomeramana, kugira ngo bamufashe kwihimura ku Bayisraheli.
Akigera ku musozi wa Betihoroni, Yuda aza amusanganiye ari kumwe n’itsinda ry’abantu bake.

Ngo babone icyo gitero cyazaga kibasanga, babwira Yuda bati «Twashobora dute kurwanya igitero kinini kandi gikomeye kuriya, n’ukuntu dukabije kuba bake? Dore twaguye agacuho, kuko nta cyo twigeze dukoza ku munwa uyu munsi.»
Yuda arabasubiza ati «Ni ikintu cyoroshye rwose, ko abantu benshi baneshwa na bake, kandi si ngombwa ko Nyir’ijuru akoresha abantu benshi cyangwa se bake,
kuko gutsinda urugamba bidaturuka ku bunini bw’igitero, ahubwo bituruka ku mbaraga zo mu Ijuru.
Bariya bantu baduteye baje buzuye ubwirasi n’ubugome, kugira ngo badutsembe, twebwe n’abagore bacu n’abana bacu kandi ngo banadusahure.
Nyamara twe turarwanirira amagara yacu n’Amategeko yacu;
ntimubatinye rero, kuko Imana izabadutsindira.»
Akimara kuvuga ayo magambo, abirohaho abatunguye, nuko Seroni n’ingabo ze bararwibonera.
Barabakurikirana no ku gacuri ka Betihoroni kugera mu kibaya, hagwa abantu bagera kuri magana inani, abarokotse bahungira mu gihugu cy’Abafilisiti.
Yuda n’abavandimwe be bakurizaho gutinywa no guhindisha imishyitsi amahanga abakikije.
Ubwamamare bwe bugera ku mwami, n’amahanga atangira kuvuga iby’imirwano ya Yuda.
heading: Umwami aha Liziya ubutumwa bwo kurimbura Israheli

text: Umwami Antiyokusi ngo yumve iyo nkuru ararakara cyane, ategeka ko bakoranya ingabo zose z’igihugu cye, kugira ngo bareme igitero gikomeye.
Afungura ububiko bw’umutungo we, aha ingabo ze igihembo cy’umwaka wose, abamenyesha ko bagomba guhora biteguye icyabagwirira cyose.
Cyakora asanga feza ari nkeya mu bubiko bwe, kandi n’imisoro yaragabanutse mu gihugu cye bitewe n’ubushyamirane ndetse n’ibyago yari yareteje mu gihugu, akuraho amategeko yari asanzwe.
Aza gutinya ko yazabura ibyo yishyura nk’uko byari byarabaye incuro nyinshi, akabura n’ibyo atangira ubuntu, dore ko yanatangaga atitangiriye itama kurusha abami bamubanjirije.
Ubwoba buramutaha, yiyemeza kujya gusoresha mu ntara zo mu Buperisi no gukorakoranya feza nyinshi.
Nuko ubutegetsi abusigira Liziya, umuntu w’ikirangirire kandi w’igikomangoma, ngo atware ahereye kuri Efurati kugera ku rugabano rw’igihugu cye n’icya Misiri,
kandi amushinga no kurera umuhungu we Antiyokusi kugeza igihe azagarukira.
Amusigira igice kimwe cy’ingabo hamwe n’inzovu, amuha n’andi mategeko cyane cyane ayerekeye abaturage ba Yudeya na Yeruzalemu:
yagombaga kugabayo igitero cyo gutsemba ingabo za Israheli no gutsiratsiza abasigaye i Yeruzalemu, akabasibanganyamo urwibutso rw’aho hantu,
akahatuza abanyamahanga, igihugu cyabo cyose akagitangaho iminani.

Umwami afata igice cy’ingabo zisigaye, arahaguruka ava i Antiyokiya, yari umurwa mukuru w’igihugu cye. Ubwo hari mu mwaka w’ijana na mirongo ine n’irindwi: yambuka Efurati, akomeza urugendo anyuze mu ntara z’amajyaruguru.
heading: Gorigiya na Nikanori bagaba igitero cy’Abanyasiriya muri Yudeya / ( / )

text: Nyuma y’ibyo, Liziya yihitiramo Putolemeyi mwene Dorimene, Nikanori na Gorigiya bari n’ibikomerezwa mu ncuti z’umwami,
abohereza hamwe n’abantu ibihumbi mirongo ine bagenza amaguru, n’ibihumbi birindwi by’abanyamafarasi, kugira ngo batere igihugu cya Yudeya kandi bakirimbure, bakurikije itegeko ry’umwami.
Barahaguruka n’ingabo zabo zose, bagera hafi ya Emawusi mu gihugu cy’imirambi, maze bahaca ingando.

Abacuruzi bo muri iyo ntara ngo babyumve, bafata zahabu na feza bitagira ingano, ndetse n’iminyururu, bajya mu ngando kugura Abayisraheli bo kugira abacakara. Bamwe mu Banyadumeya n’abo mu gihugu cy’Abafilisiti bajyana na bo.
Yuda n’abavandimwe be babona ko icyago cyabasumbirije kandi ko n’ingabo zaciye ingando mu gihugu cyabo; bamenya kandi ko umwami yatanze itegeko ryo kubatsemba bose.
Nuko barabwirana bati «Nimucyo duhagurutse abantu bacu, turwanirire umuryango wacu n’ahantu hacu hatagatifu.»
Hanyuma bakoranya ikoraniro kugira ngo bitegure intambara, basenge kandi basabe imbabazi.

Ubwo Yeruzalemu yasaga n’ubutayu budatuwe,nta n’umwe mu bana bayo wayinjiragamocyangwa ngo ayisohokemo.Ingoro yari yarasuzuguwe,abana b’abanyamahanga bituriye mu murwa,wari warahindutse ubukonde bwabo.Nta byishimo byari bikirangwa kwa Yakobo,nta wari ukihumva imyirongi n’inanga.
heading: Abayahudi bakoranira i Masifa / ( / )

text: Nuko Abayahudi barakorana maze baza i Masifa, ahateganye na Yeruzalemu, kuko kera higeze kuba isengero ry’Abayisraheli.
Uwo munsi basiba kurya, bambara ibigunira, binyanyagiza ivu mu mutwe kandi bashishimura imyambaro yabo.
Barambura igitabo cy’Amategeko kugira ngo abe ari cyo batahuramo inama z’icyo bagomba gukora, batigannye abanyamahanga bagishaga inama amashusho y’ibigirwamana byabo.
Bazana imyambaro y’ubuherezabitambo, hamwe n’imiganura n’amaturo y’umugabane wa cumi, hanyuma bahamagaza Abanazireya bari barujuje amasezerano yabo.
Nuko barangurura amajwi barangamiye ijuru, baravuga bati «Bariya bantu turabagenza dute? Turaberekeza he?
Dore ahantu hawe hatagatifu barahasuzuguye, barahahindanya, abaherezabitambo bawe bari mu cyunamo no mu kimwaro,
none dore n’amahanga yaduhagurukiye kugira ngo adutsiratsize. Kandi nawe ubwawe, uzi imigambi badufitiye.
Twashobora dute guhangana na bo, niba utadutabaye?»
Nuko bavuza uturumbeti, ari na ko batera induru nyinshi.
Ibyo birangiye, Yuda ashyiraho abatware ba rubanda, abatware b’inteko z’abantu igihumbi, iz’abantu ijana, iza mirongo itanu n’izigizwe n’abantu icumi.
Cyakora abari mu bwubatsi cyangwa abakiri mu bugeni, abari bamaze gutera umuzabibu cyangwa abafite ubwoba, avuga ko bakwiye gusubira imuhira nk’uko Amategeko abibemerera.
Nuko igitero kirahaguruka, maze baca ingando mu majyepfo ya Emawusi.
Yuda ni ko kubabwira ati «Nimukomere kandi mube intwari, mwiteguye ko bucya murwanya ariya mahanga yakoraniye kudutsemba no gusenya Ingoro yacu,
kuko icyaruta ari uko twagwa ku rugamba, aho kuba indorerezi z’ibyago by’igihugu cyacu n’ahantu hacu hatagatifu.
Uko Uwo mu ijuru azabishaka, ni ko azabikora.»Currently Selected:Icya mbere cy'Abamakabe 3: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Gorigiya afata abantu ibihumbi bitanu bagenza amaguru, n’abandi b’intwari igihumbi b’abanyamafarasi, maze iryo tsinda rigenda nijoro,
heading: Urugamba rwo kuri Emawusi / ( / , / )

text: ari ukugira ngo batere mu ngando y’Abayahudi, babice babatunguye. Abantu bo mu kigo bamubera ibyitso.
Yuda ngo abyumve, ahagurukana n’abantu be b’intwari, kugira ngo arwanye igitero cy’ingabo z’umwami cyari Emawusi,
mu gihe ingabo zacyo zikinyanyagiye inyuma y’ingando yazo.
Gorigiya na we uko yakageze nijoro ku ngando ya Yuda, ntiyagira n’umwe ahasanga maze atangira gushakira Abayahudi mu misozi, kuko yibwiraga ati «Bariho baraduhunga.»
Bukeye, Yuda aba ageze mu kibaya ari kumwe n’abantu ibihumbi bitatu. Cyakora ntibari bafite intwaro n’inkota nk’uko babyifuzaga.
Babonaga ingando y’abanyamahanga ikomeye kandi yirinze, ikikijwe n’abanyamafarasi, mbese abantu bamenyereye intambara.
Nuko Yuda abwira abantu be ati «Ntimubatinyire ubwinshi bwabo cyangwa ngo mukangwe n’imirindi yabo.
Nimwibuke uko abasekuruza bacu bakijijwe ku Nyanja itukura, igihe Farawo yari abahomereye n’igitero.
None rero, nimucyo dutakambire Nyir’ijuru: niba adushaka, aribuka Isezerano yagiranye n’abasekuruza bacu, maze uyu munsi ajanjagure kiriya gitero mureba imbere yacu.
Bityo, amahanga yose azamenye ko hariho Utabara kandi agakiza Israheli.»
Abanyamahanga ngo bubure amaso babona Abayahudi barabateye,
bahera ko basohoka mu ngando ngo babarwanye. Abantu ba Yuda bavuza akarumbeti,
maze ruhera ko rurambikana. Abanyamahanga baraneshwa, bahunga bagana ku kibaya,
ariko abanzi bose bari inyuma bashirira ku bugi bw’inkota. Bakomeza kubakurikirana kugera i Gazara no mu bibaya by’Idumeya, ibya Azoto n’ibya Yaminiya; hagwa abantu bagera ku bihumbi bitatu.
Yuda avuye kubirukana we n’abantu be,
abwira rubanda ati «Ntimushimishwe n’iminyago yonyine, kuko indi ntambara itwugarije.
Dore Gorigiya n’igitero cye bari mu misozi iri hafi yacu, bararekereje. None rero, nimushinge ibirindiro imbere y’abanzi bacu, mubarwanye; hanyuma mubone ubutwara iminyago nta cyo mwishisha.»
Yuda akimara kubabwira ibyo, babona umutwe umwe wa cya gitero urungurukira mu mpinga y’umusozi.
Ni bwo babonye ko ababo bahunze n’ingando ikaba yahindutse umuyonga: kuko umwotsi wari ugicumbeka ari wo wabyerekanaga,
maze bituma bakuka umutima. Ngo bakubite amaso cya gitero cya Yuda cyari mu kibaya kiteguye urugamba,
bahungira bose mu gihugu cy’Abafilisiti.
Nuko Yuda arahindukira asahura ingando, bahakura zahabu na feza n’ibiceri byinshi, imyenda y’imihemba n’iy’isine, n’ubundi bukire bwinshi.
Abayahudi batabarukaga basingiza kandi bashimira Nyir’ijuru bavuga bati «Ni mwiza kandi impuhwe ze zihoraho iteka!»
Uwo munsi ubera Israheli ikimenyetso cy’ubucunguzi bukomeye.
Abanyamahanga bari barokotse bajya kumenyesha Liziya uko byari byagenze.
Nuko iyo nkuru imutera ubwoba kandi imuca intege, kuko bitagendekeye Israheli uko we yabyifuzaga, bikaba binanyuranye n’ibyo umwami yari yamutegetse.
heading: Igitero cya mbere cya Liziya / ( / )

text: Mu mwaka ukurikiyeho, Liziya akoranya abantu ibihumbi mirongo itandatu b’intwari, n’abanyamafarasi ibihumbi bitanu ngo noneho ahashye Abayahudi.
Baza muri Idumeya, maze baca ingando i Betishuri. Yuda na we arabasanganira ari kumwe n’abantu ibihumbi cumi.

Abonye ko icyo gitero gikomeye, atakamba agira ati «Shimirwa Mukiza wa Israheli, wowe wajanjaguje ikiganza cy’umugaragu wawe Dawudi igitero cy’umurwanyi w’igihangange, ingando y’Abafilisiti ukayigabiza Yonatani mwene Sawuli, n’uwamutwazaga intwaro ze.
Ndakwinginze na none ngo ubigenze utyo, ushyire kiriya gitero mu maboko ya Israheli, umuryango wawe; bagire isoni z’ingabo zabo n’abanyamafarasi babo.
Bateze ubwoba, ubavanemo icyizere bafitiye ingabo zabo, bityo bacibwe intege no gutekereza ko bashobora gutsindwa.
Batsembeshe inkota y’abagukunda, maze abazi izina ryawe bose bagusingirize mu ndirimbo!»
Nuko ruherako rwambikana, umuntu ku wundi, hagwa abantu bagera ku bihumbi bitanu mu ngabo za Liziya.

Liziya ngo abone ko ingabo ze zikangaranye, n’ubutwari bw’ingabo za Yuda zari ziyemeje gukira cyangwa zigapfa gitwari, afata inzira ajya i Antiyokiya, ahavana abanyamahanga kugira ngo azagaruke muri Yudeya n’igitero kiruta ubwinshi icya mbere.
heading: Ihumanurwa ry’Ingoro no kuyegurira Imana

text: Nuko Yuda n’abavandimwe be baravuga bati «Dore abanzi bacu bamaze gutsindwa, nimucyo tujye guhumanura Ingoro no kuyegurira Imana.»
Ingabo zose zirakorana, barazamuka bajya ku musozi wa Siyoni.
Ngo bahagere basanga ahantu hatagatifu harabaye amatongo, urutambiro rwarandavuye, inzugi barazitwitse, mu bikari harameze ibihuru nk’ibyo mu ishyamba cyangwa ku musozi, n’ibyumba barabishenye.
Bahera ko bashishimura imyambaro yabo, bajya mu cyunamo kandi bisiga ivu mu mutwe.
Bagwa bubitse uruhanga ku butaka, maze ku kimenyetso cy’akarumbeti barangurura amajwi barangamiye ijuru.
Yuda ategeka abantu kurwanya abari batuye mu kigo, kugeza ubwo arangije gusukura Ingoro.
Ibyo birangiye, atoranya abaherezabitambo batarangwaho ubwandu kandi bazwiho ishyaka ry’Amategeko,
bahumanura Ingoro, n’amabuye yanduye bayahirikira mu ngarani.
Ariko basigara bibaza icyo bagomba gukora ku rutambiro rw’ibitambo bitwikwa rwari rwarandavuye,
bityo baza kugera ku mwanzuro ushimishije wo kurusenya ngo hato rutazabakoza isoni, kubera ko abanyamahanga baruhumanyije. Nuko bararusenya,
amabuye yarwo bayarunda ahantu hatunganye ku musozi Ingoro yari yubatseho, mu gihe bagitegereje ko haza umuhanuzi wagira icyo avuga ku biyerekeyeho.
Hanyuma bazana amabuye atabajwe, uko Amategeko yabivugaga, maze bayubakisha urundi rutambiro rushya, rumeze nk’urwa mbere.
Basana Ingoro, n’imbere hayo, basukura no mu bikari byayo.
Bamaze gukora ibindi bikoresho bitagatifu, binjiza mu Ngoro igitereko cy’amatara, bashyiraho n’urutambiro rw’imibavu n’ameza.
Batwikira ububani ku rutambiro, bacana n’amatara yo ku gitereko, amurikira Ingoro yose.
Bashyira imigati ku meza, bamanika n’imyenda maze barangiza batyo imirimo bari batangiye.
Mu mwaka w’ijana na mirongo ine n’icyenda, ku wa makumyabiri n’itanu w’ukwezi kwa cyenda — ari ko Kisilewu — babyuka mu museso
maze batura igitambo gitegetswe ku rutambiro rushya rw’ibitambo bitwikwa bari bubatse.
Urutambiro barutaha mu majwi y’indirimbo, y’inanga z’amoko yose n’ay’ibyuma birangira, ibyo bibera igihe kimwe no ku munsi umwe n’uwo abanyamahanga bandavujeho urutambiro rwa mbere.
Rubanda rwose rurapfukama rurasenga, berekeza ibisingizo byabo kuri Nyir’ijuru wabahaye gutsinda.
Mu minsi umunani yose, begurira Imana urutambiro, baturana umunezero ibitambo bitwikwa, ibitambo by’ubumwe n’ibyo gushimira.
Urukuta rw’imbere rw’Ingoro barutakisha amakamba ya zahabu n’indi mitako, bongera gusana imiryango, n’ibyumba babishyiraho inzugi.
Rubanda rwose rusabwa n’ibyishimo, isoni bari baratewe n’abanyamahanga zirasibangana.

Nuko Yuda hamwe n’abavandimwe be, n’ikoraniro ryose rya Israheli, bemeza ko iminsi yo kwegurira Imana urutambiro izajya ihimbazwa mu gihe cyayo buri mwaka, ibirori bikamara iminsi munani mu byishimo no mu munezero, kuva ku wa makumyabiri n’itanu w’ukwezi kwa Kisilewu.
Icyo gihe, bakikiza inkike ndende n’iminara ikomeye impande zose z’umusozi wa Siyoni, ngo hato amahanga atazavaho yongera gukoza ikirenge aho hantu.

Nuko Yuda ahashyira abarinzi bo kuharinda; akomeza na Betishuri kugira ngo rubanda rugire ikigo cyo kururinda, ahateganye na Idumeya.Currently Selected:Icya mbere cy'Abamakabe 4: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Amahanga abakikije ngo yumve ko urutambiro rwongeye kubakwa, n’Ingoro ko yongeye gusubirana nk’uko yari imeze mbere, bararakara cyane,
heading: Igitero cyo muri Idumeya no mu gihugu cy’Abahamoni / ( / )

text: maze biyemeza gutsemba urubyaro rwa Yakobo rwari rubatuyemo; batangira kwica no kwirukana bamwe muri rubanda.
Yuda arwana na bene Ezawu bo muri Idumeya no mu gihugu cy’Akarabateni, kuko ari ho bari bafungiye Abayisraheli. Arabanesha, abagira ubusa maze abatwara iminyago.
Aza kwibuka n’ubugome bwa bene Bayani, bari barabereye umuryango inkomyi n’impamvu y’ibyago, kubera ibico bajyaga babatega ku mayira.
Amaze kubakubakubira mu minara yabo, abafungiramo maze arabarimbura; iyo minara ayiha inkongi, ayitwikana n’ibyari biyirimo byose.
Ibyo birangiye anyura mu Bahamoni, ahasanga ingabo zikomeye n’abaturage benshi bategekwaga na Timote.
Abagabiza ibitero byinshi, arabahashya, baratsindwa.
Yigarurira atyo Yazeri n’insisiro zayo zose, hanyuma agaruka muri Yudeya.
heading: Ibyabanjirije ibitero byo muri Galileya na Gilihadi

text: Nuko abanyamahanga bari batuye muri Gilihadi, bajya inama yo gutsemba Abayisraheli batuye mu gihugu cyabo, bo ariko bahungira mu kigo cy’i Datema.
Bohereza Yuda n’abavandimwe be amabaruwa yanditsemo aya magambo ngo «Abanyamahanga badukikije bagiye inama yo kudutsemba.
Baritegura gufata ikigo ducumbitsemo, kandi Timote ni we mugaba w’igitero cyabo.
Nimutebuke rero mubadukize, kuko abenshi muri twe bapfuye.
Abavandimwe bacu bose bari batuye mu gihugu cya Tobi bashiriye ku icumu, abagore n’abana babo bajyanywe bunyago, ibyabo byose barabicujwe, kandi banahiciye abantu bagera ku gihumbi.»
Igihe bariho basoma ayo mabaruwa, hatunguka izindi ntumwa ziturutse muri Galileya, zambaye imyambaro y’ibishwangi kandi zifite ubutumwa bumwe n’ubwa mbere; bwagiraga buti
«I Putolemayida, i Tiri n’i Sidoni ndetse no muri Galileya y’abanyamahanga yose, baraduhagurukiye ngo badutsembe.»
Yuda na rubanda ngo bumve ayo magambo, bakoranya inama ikomeye yo gusuzuma ukuntu batabara abavandimwe babo bagirijwe n’ibyago, hamwe n’ibitero by’abanzi.
Nuko Yuda abwira umuvandimwe we Simoni, ati «Toranya abantu, maze ujye gutabara abavandimwe bawe bo muri Galileya; naho jyewe n’umuvandimwe wanjye Yonatani, turajya muri Gilihadi.»
Muri Yudeya ahasiga Yozefu mwene Zakariya na Azariya, umutware w’umuryango hamwe n’ingabo zisigaye, kugira ngo barinde igihugu.
Arabategeka ati «Muyobore iyi mbaga kandi ntimuzashoze intambara n’amahanga, kugeza ko tuzahindukira.»
Simoni ahabwa abantu ibihumbi bitatu bo gutera muri Galileya, naho Yuda ajyana abantu ibihumbi munani, batera muri Gilihadi.
heading: Ibitero byo muri Galileya no muri Gilihadi / ( / )

text: Simoni rero atera muri Galileya, ashoza intambara nyinshi n’abanyamahanga, baratsindwa;
arabakurikirana kugera ku marembo y’ikigo cy’i Putolemayida. Ku rugamba hari haguye abanyamahanga bagera ku bihumbi bitatu, ibyo bari bafite arabibanyaga.
Ajyana Abayahudi bo muri Galileya no muri Arubata, hamwe n’abagore babo n’abana babo n’ibyo bari batunze byose, abazana muri Yudeya basabwe n’ibyishimo.
Nuko Yuda Makabe na murumuna we Yonatani, bambuka Yorudani, bagenda iminsi itatu mu butayu.
Baza guhura n’Abanabateni babakira neza babatekerereza ibyabaye byose ku bavandimwe babo bo muri Gilihadi,
n’ukuntu bamwe muri bo bari bafungiwe i Bosora, i Bosori, muri Alema, i Kasifo, i Makedi n’i Karinayini; aho hose hakaba imigi minini kandi ikomeye,
hari n’abandi bafungiye mu yindi migi ya Gilihadi, kandi abanzi babo biyemeje ko bucya batera iyo migi ikomeye bakayifata, n’abayituyemo bose bakabatsembera umunsi umwe.

Ako kanya, Yuda ahita ayobora ingabo ze mu nzira igana i Bosora, yahuranyije ubutayu. Yigarurira umugi, abagabo bose amaze kubamarira ku bugi bw’inkota no kubanyaga ibyo bari bafite, umugi arawutwika.
Ubwo ahaguruka aho nijoro, baragenda bagera ku kigo cy’i Datema.
Mu gitondo cya kare, ngo bubure amaso babona igitero cy’abantu benshi, bitwaje inzego n’imashini z’intambara kugira ngo bigarurire umugi, ndetse bahita batera.
Yuda abonye ko urugamba rutangiye, kandi ko n’urusaku rwinshi ruvanze n’imyoromo y’uturumbeti rwazamukaga mu mugi rugana mu ijuru,
abwira ingabo ze ati «Uyu munsi nimurwanire koko abavandimwe banyu!»
Yigiza imbere abantu be, abagabanyamo amatsinda atatu yo kugota umwanzi. Ubwo uturumbeti turavuga, tujyaniranye n’amasengesho atakamba.
Ingabo za Timote zimenye ko ari Makabe ubasatiriye, ziramuhunga. Makabe arabatsinda karahava, ku buryo bapfushije nk’abantu ibihumbi munani uwo munsi.
Hanyuma ahindukirana Alema, arayitera maze arayigarurira, abagabo bose amaze kubica no kubanyaga ibyo bari bafite, umugi arawutwika.
Ahavuye, ajya kwigarurira Kasifo, Makeda, Bosori n’indi migi ya Gilihadi.
Nyuma y’ibyo, Timote akoranya ikindi gitero, araza aca ingando ahateganye na Rafoni hakurya y’umugezi.
Nuko Yuda yohereza abajya gutata iyo ngando, bagaruka bamubwira bati «Uwo mutware ari kumwe n’abanyamahanga bose badukikije, baremye igitero kinini cyane,
ndetse bitabaje n’Abarabu ngo babafashe; none baciye ingando hakurya y’umugezi, biteguye kuza kugutera.» Yuda ahera ko ajya kubasanganira.
Igihe Yuda n’ingabo ze bageze hafi y’umugezi, Timote abwira abagaba b’ingabo ze ati «Naramuka adutanze kwambuka, ntituzamubasha, kuko azaba aturushije amahirwe.
Ariko aramutse agize ubwoba agaca ingando hakurya y’umugezi, tuzambukira ahateganye na we maze tumutsinde.»
Nuko Yuda ngo agere hafi y’umugezi, akwirakwiza abanditsi b’umuryango ku nkengero y’umugezi, maze arabategeka ati «Ntihagire n’umwe mureka ashinga ihema rye ahubwo bose nibajye ku rugamba!»
Ahera ko yambuka uwa mbere asatira abanzi; rubanda rwose ruramukurikira. Abanyamahanga arabamenesha, bagenda bajugunyanga intwaro zabo, birukira mu ngoro y’i Karinayini kuhashakira ubwikingo.
Abayahudi babanza gufata umugi, hanyuma batwika ingoro n’abari bayirimo bose. Nuko Karinayini isenywa ityo, kandi kuva ubwo ntibaba bagihangara kurwanya Yuda.

Yuda akoranya Abayisraheli bose bari mu gihugu cya Gilihadi, kuva ku mwana muto kugera ku muntu mukuru, hamwe n’abagore babo, abana babo n’ibintu byabo, maze iyo mbaga yose ishyira nzira igana mu gihugu cya Yudeya.
Bageze i Efuroni, wari umugi munini kandi ukomeye cyane wubatse hafi y’inzira, babona ko badashobora kuwuzenguruka, haba kuwunyura iburyo cyangwa ibumoso, basanga ahasigaye ari ukuwambukiranya.
Abaturage bawo babima inzira, ndetse n’amarembo yawo bayahindiza amabuye.
Yuda aboherereza ubutumwa bubahumuriza agira ati «Tugiye kwambukiranya igihugu cyanyu kugira ngo tugere mu cyacu, nta we uri bubagirire nabi, turitambukira gusa!» Ariko bo banga kumwugururira.
Ni bwo rero Yuda amenyesheje ingabo ze, ko buri muntu ashingira ibirindiro aho ari.
Nuko ab’intwari mu ngabo bashinga ingamba, maze Yuda abarwanya umunsi wose n’ijoro ryose, umugi wose arawigarurira.
Abagabo bose abagabiza ubugi bw’inkota, umugi wabo arawurimbura kugera ku mfatiro zawo, atwara iminyago maze awambuka agenda hejuru y’intumbi.
Abayahudi bambuka Yorudani, bagera mu kibaya kinini kiri ahateganye n’umugi wa Betishani.
Inzira yose Yuda yagendaga asindagiza abananiwe, akomeza rubanda rwose umutima, kugera muri Yudeya, igihugu cyabo.
Bazamuka umusozi wa Siyoni mu byishimo n’umunezero, batura ibitambo bitwikwa kuko bari batabarutse amahoro, nta n’umwe mu babo wahaguye.
heading: Ibyago by’i Yaminiya: ugutsindwa kwa Yozefu na Azariya / ( / )

text: Igihe Yuda na Yonatani bari mu gihugu cya Gilihadi, naho Simoni umuvandimwe wabo ari imbere ya Putolemayida muri Galileya,
Yozefu mwene Zakariya na Azariya, bari abagaba b’ingabo, ngo bumve ibikorwa byabo by’ubutwari n’intambara barwanye,
baribwira bati «Reka natwe twishakire icyivugo, tujye kurwanya amahanga adukikije.»
Nuko baha amategeko ingabo bayoboraga, baherako batera umugi wa Yaminiya.
Gorigiya n’ingabo ze basohoka mu mugi ngo basakirane, barwane.
Yozefu na Azariya batsinzwe barahunga, abanzi barabakurikirana kugera ku rugabano rwa Yudeya. Uwo munsi hapfa abantu bagera ku bihumbi bibiri mu mbaga y’Abayisraheli.
Ibyo biba icyago gikomeye mu Bayisraheli, kuko banze kumvira Yuda na barumuna be, bakibwira ko ari bwo buryo bwo kugaragaza ubutwari bwabo.
Cyakora bo, ntibabarirwaga mu bwoko bwa ba bantu bari barahawe ubushobozi bwo gukiza Israheli.
heading: Yuda atsinda igihugu cya Idumeya n’Ubufilisiti

text: Nuko ya ntwari Yuda n’abavandimwe be baba ibirangirire muri Israheli, ndetse no mu mahanga yose aho izina ryabo ryavugwaga,
imbaga y’abantu ikabyiganira iruhande rwabo kugira ngo babashimire.

Yuda n’abavandimwe be barahaguruka bajya gutera bene Ezawu, bari batuye mu karere k’amajyepfo; umugi wa Heburoni bawufata ku ngufu n’insisiro ziwukikije, inkike zawo zikomeye barazisenya n’iminara yawo barayitwika.
Ahavuye, agenda yerekeje mu gihugu cy’Abafilisiti yambukiranyije Marisa.
Uwo munsi, abaherezabitambo bashatse kugaragaza ubutwari bwabo, bagahubukira urugamba, barugwaho.

Hanyuma Yuda afata inzira ajya i Azoto, yari intara y’Abafilisiti; asenya intambiro zabo, amashusho y’amabazanyo y’ibigirwamana byabo arayatwika, imigi yaho arayisahura, maze agaruka mu gihugu cya Yudeya.Currently Selected:Icya mbere cy'Abamakabe 5: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices?
