Icyo gihe ariko Antiyokusi yazengurukaga intara zo mu majyaruguru. Aza kumenya ko mu Buperisi hari umugi witwa Elimayi wabaye icyamamare kubera ubukire bwawo, feza yawo na zahabu yawo,
heading: Urupfu rwa Antiyokusi Epifani / ( / ; / ; / )

text: ukagira n’ingoro ikize cyane, irimo ibikoresho by’intambara bicuze muri zahabu, imyambaro y’ibyuma n’intwaro byahasizwe na Alegisanderi mwene Filipo, umwami wa Masedoniya, wabaye umwami wa mbere w’Abagereki.
Aza rero kugerageza gufata uwo mugi kugira ngo awusahure, ariko ntibyashoboka, kuko abaturage bawo bari babimenye.
Bafata intwaro baramurwanya, atsinzwe arahunga, arahava asubira i Babiloni n’ikimwaro cyinshi.
Akiri mu Buperisi, baza kumumenyesha ko ingabo zari zateye muri Yudeya zatsinzwe,

kandi ko na Liziya ubwe, n’ubwo yari yajyanye n’igitero gikomeye, yatsinzwe, akaba yarahunze Abayahudi bari indatsimburwa kubera intwaro zabo, ubwinshi bw’ibyo bitwaje, n’ibyo banyaze amahanga batsinze.
Anamenya ko batembagaje rya shyano ry’ikigirwamana yari yarubatse ku rutambiro rw’i Yeruzalemu, ahantu habo hatagatifu bahakikiza inkike nka mbere, kimwe na Betishuri, umwe mu migi yabo.
Umwami ngo yumve iyo nkuru akubitwa n’inkuba, arasuhererwa bikomeye maze yiroha ku buriri bwe, arembeshwa n’agahinda kuko ibyabaye byose bitagenze uko yabyifuzaga.
Aho ahamara iminsi myinshi kuko buri kanya yabaga yazikamye. Abonye ko agiye gupfa,
atumiza incuti ze zose maze arazibwira ati «Amaso yanjye ntagitora agatotsi, n’umutima wanjye washenguwe n’ishavu.
Ubwanjye naribwiye nti ’Nk’uyu mubabaro wose mfite n’aka gahinda nazikamyemo, bituruka ku ki? Ukuntu nagwaga neza kandi ngakundwa, igihe nari ngifite amaboko!’
Ariko ubu ngubu, ni bwo nibutse ibibi byose nakoreye i Yeruzalemu, igihe nsahuye ibikoresho byose bya feza n’ibya zahabu byari bihari, nkohereza abajya gutsemba nta mpamvu abaturage bo muri Yudeya.
Ndahamya rero ko ibyo bibi nakoze ari byo binteje ibi byago, nkaba ndinze gupfana agahinda mu gihugu cy’amahanga!»
heading: Iyimikwa rya Antiyokusi wa gatanu

text: Ni ko guhamagaza Filipo, umwe mu ncuti ze, amushyiraho ngo abe umutegetsi w’igihugu cyose.
Amuha ikamba rye, ikanzu ye n’impeta ye, kugira ngo yite ku burere bw’umuhungu we Antiyokusi, kandi anamutegurire kuzamuzungura ku ngoma.
Nuko umwami Antiyokusi agwa aho ngaho, hari mu mwaka w’ijana na mirongo ine n’icyenda.
Liziya ngo amenye ko umwami yatanze, yimika Antiyokusi, umuhungu we, yari yarareze kuva mu bwana bwe kugira ngo amuzungure, amuhimba irya Ewupatori.
heading: Yuda Makabe agota ikigo cy’i Yeruzalemu

text: Abantu bo mu Kigo bari barafungiye Abayisraheli ahakikije Ingoro, bagashaka kubagirira nabi ku mpamvu ibonetse yose, kandi bagatera inkunga abanyamahanga.
Yuda yiyemeza kubatsemba, ni ko guhamagaza rubanda rwose kugira ngo babagote.
Bamaze gukorana, baca ingando imbere y’ikigo; ubwo hakaba mu mwaka w’ijana na mirongo itanu, bubaka ibya ngombwa byo kurwaniraho, bakora n’imashini.
Ariko abari bagoswe baza guca icyuho, bajyana n’Abayisraheli b’abahemu,
bajya kubwira umwami bati «Uzatindiganya na ryari kuturenganura no guhorera abavandimwe bacu?
Twiyemeje n’umutima wacu wose gukorera so, dukurikiza amategeko ye kandi twubahiriza amatangazo ye.
Kubera iyo mpamvu rero, bene wacu dusangiye igihugu baratwanze. Si ibyo gusa; abacu bose babaguye mu nzara, barishwe, n’ibyacu byose barabisahura.
Nta bwo kandi ari twe twenyine bagiriye nabi gusa, ahubwo ni ibihugu byawe byose.
Dore ubu ngubu bateye ikigo cy’i Yeruzalemu kugira ngo bakigarurire, kandi ngo bakomeze Ingoro n’ikigo cya Betishuri.
Niba rero utihutiye kubakoma imbere bazakora n’ibirenzeho, kandi nta bwo uzashobora kubahagarika.»
heading: Urugamba rw’i Betizakariya / ( / )

text: Umwami ngo abyumve ararakara, akoranya incuti ze, abagaba b’ingabo zigenza amaguru n’abanyamafarasi.
Mu bindi bihugu no mu birwa byo mu nyanja, haturuka na ho izindi ngabo z’abacancuro,
ingabo ze zose zigera ku bantu ibihumbi ijana bagenza amaguru, abanyamafarasi ibihumbi makumyabiri, n’inzovu mirongo itatu n’ebyiri zimenyereye urugamba.
Barahaguruka banyura muri Idumeya, bagota umugi wa Betishuri bawurwanya igihe kirekire bakoresheje imashini. Ariko abari bagoswe, bakarwana basohoka, batwika za mashini, birwanaho gitwari.
Nuko Yuda ava mu murwa aca ingando i Betizakariya, ahateganye n’ingando y’umwami.
Umwami na we abaduka mu gitondo cya kare, anyarukana ingabo ze azishyira ku nzira y’i Betizakariya, aba ari ho zishinga ibirindiro ziteguye urugamba, hanyuma bavuza akarumbeti.
Imbere y’inzovu bahashyira umutobe w’imizabibu n’uw’inkeri kugira ngo zikarihe ku rugamba.

Nuko bazikwirakwiza mu mitwe y’ingabo, iruhande rwa buri nzovu hakajya abantu igihumbi bambaye imyambaro y’icyuma ku gituza n’ingofero zicuzwe mu muringa, n’abanyamafarasi magana atanu mu b’ingenzi bari iruhande rwa buri gikoko.
Abo ni bo bamenyaga aho kigiye kwerekeza bakakigenda iruhande, batagitirimukaho.

Hejuru ya buri nzovu bahubakaga umunara ukomeye mu biti bakoresheje imigozi inoze, mbese wari nk’ubwugamo, kandi muri buri munara hakaba abasirikare batatu barwanira hejuru y’ibyo bikoko, hakaba n’undi ushinzwe kuyobora iyo nzovu.
Naho igice gisigaye cy’abanyamafarasi, umwami abashyira ku mpembe zombi z’urugamba kugira ngo basembure abanzi kandi bazibe icyuho.
Nuko izuba ngo rirasire ku ngabo za zahabu n’iz’umuringa, imisozi yose irakirana kandi irarabagirana boshye amafumba bacanye.
Igice kimwe cy’ingabo z’umwami gikwira mu mpinga y’umusozi, ikindi kinyanyagira mu ibanga ryawo; bakagenda batayagara kandi nta cyo bishisha.
Abantu bose bumvaga umuriri n’urwamo rw’icyo gitero, n’urw’intwaro zagendaga zikocorana, bagira ubwoba; kuko cyari igitero kinini kandi gikomeye koko.
Yuda n’abantu be barabasatira kugira ngo bashoze urugamba, abantu magana atandatu bo mu ngabo z’umwami barahagwa.
Nuko Eleyazari, uwo bahimbaga irya Awarani, arabukwa kimwe muri bya bikoko gihambiriyeho intebe nk’iy’umwami, kandi cyasumbyaga ibindi byose igihagararo; akeka ko ari cyo umwami ariho,
ni ko kwitanga kugira ngo akize umuryango we kandi ngo izina rye ritazibagirana.
Yirukankana ubutwari bwinshi, yiroha rwagati mu rugamba, arangamiye cya gikoko, agenda yica hirya no hino, ku buryo abanzi bamwitazaga mu mpande zose.
Nuko ahita yinjira mu nsi ya ya nzovu, ayitera inkota, arayica. Icyo gikoko kirunda hasi, kimugwa hejuru na we agwa aho.
Abayahudi babonye ko ingabo z’umwami zifite umurego, bahera ko barazihunga.
heading: Abanyasiriya bafata Betishuri; bakagota n’umusozi wa Siyoni / ( / )

text: Ingabo z’umwami zitanga imbere Abayahudi ngo bazahurire i Yeruzalemu, maze umwami agota Yudeya yose n’umusozi wa Siyoni.
Agirana amasezerano y’amahoro n’abatuye i Betishuri, bamwimukira mu mugi, kuko batari bafite ibibatunga mu gihe cy’intambara, kubera ko wari umwaka wo kuraza ubutaka, bukaruhuka.
Umwami ni ko kwigarurira umugi wa Betishuri, awushyiraho inteko yo kuwurinda.
Ingoro ayigota igihe kinini cyane, ahubaka ibya ngombwa byo kurwaniraho, ahashyira n’imashini z’intambara z’amoko yose; izivubura umuriro, izirasa imyambi, izitera amabuye n’imihumetso.
Abagoswe na bo bashinga imashini zabo ku ruhande rwabo, maze barwana igihe kirekire.
Ariko nta biribwa byari bikiri mu bigega, kuko uwo mwaka wari uwa karindwi, kandi rero Abayahudi bazanywe muri Yudeya bavuye mu mahanga bari bararangije kurya ibyahunitswe.
Ni ko gusiga abantu bake ahantu hatagatifu kuko bari mu kaga k’inzara, abandi baratatana umwe ukwe undi ukwe.
heading: Umwami yemerera Abayahudi gukomeza idini yabo / ( / ; / )

text: Filipo, wa wundi wari waratoranyijwe n’umwami Antiyokusi akiriho, kugira ngo amurerere umuhungu we Antiyokusi kandi amutegurire kuzamuzungura ku ngoma,
yari ahindukiye avuye mu Buperisi no muri Mediya ari kumwe n’ingabo zari zaherekeje umwami, agashaka kwigarurira ubutegetsi bwa byose.

Liziya yumvise iyo nkuru, yihutira gutahuka. Ni ko kubwira umwami, abagaba b’ingabo n’abandi bantu, ati «Turagenda dusubira inyuma buri munsi, ibidutunga bitangiye kugabanuka, n’aha hantu twateye hihagazeho. Kandi, iby’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu cyacu biradutegereje.
Nimucyo rero twumvikane na bariya bantu, duhane amahoro n’igihugu cyabo cyose.
Tubareke babeho bakurikije imigenzo yabo nka kera, kuko kuba twaravanyeho imigenzo yabo ari byo byabateye uburakari no gukora ibi byose.»
Umwami n’abagaba b’ingabo ze bemera iyo nama, ni ko kohereza abajya kugirana amasezerano y’amahoro n’Abayahudi, na bo barabyemera.
Umwami n’abagaba b’ingabo babyemeresha indahiro, noneho abari bagoswe babona gusohoka mu kigo.
Nuko umwami yinjira ku musozi wa Siyoni, ngo abone ukuntu aho hantu hakomeye, arenga kuri ya ndahiro yari yarahiye, ategeka ko basenya inkike yawo yose.

Hanyuma ahaguruka bwangu asubira i Antiyokiya, ahasanga Filipo yari yeguriye umugi. Aramurwanya, maze umugi awufata ku ngufu.Currently Selected:Icya mbere cy'Abamakabe 6: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Mu mwaka w’ijana na mirongo itanu n’umwe, Demetiriyo mwene Selewukusi ava i Roma, acikira mu mugi wo ku nyanja ari kumwe n’abantu bakeya, nuko ahatangariza ingoma ye.
heading: Demetiriyo wa mbere aba umwami; Bakidesi na Alikimu batumwa muri Yudeya / ( / )

text: Ageze mu murwa w’abasekuruza be, ingabo zifata Antiyokusi na Liziya, zibazanira Demetiriyo.
Ariko we ngo abimenye aravuga ati «Sinshaka no kubona abo bantu mu maso.»
Ingabo zihera ko zibica, maze Demetiriyo arakunda aba umwami.
Nuko abantu bose bo muri Israheli, bari bazwiho kuba ibyigenge n’ibyomanzi, baramusanga bayobowe na Alikimu washakaga kuba umuherezabitambo mukuru.
Barega rubanda ku mwami bagira bati «Yuda n’abavandimwe be bicishije incuti zawe zose, natwe batumenesha mu gihugu cyacu.
None rero woherezeyo umuntu wizeye, ajye kwirebera amarorerwa yose Yuda yakoze iwacu no mu masambu y’umwami, maze ahane abo bantu n’ababatera inkunga bose.»
Umwami ahitamo Bakidesi, umwe mu ncuti ze, ari na we wategekaga ibihugu by’iburengerazuba bwa Efurati, akaba umuntu ukomeye mu gihugu n’umuyoboke w’umwami.
Nuko umwami aramwohereza, hamwe na Alikimu w’umuhakanyi yari amaze kugira umuherezabitambo, amutegeka kujya guhora Abayisraheli.
Barahaguruka bashyira nzira, bagera mu gihugu cya Yudeya n’igitero cy’abantu benshi. Boherereza Yuda n’abavandimwe be intumwa zisaba amahoro, ariko ari ukubaryarya.
Nyamara bo ntibagira icyo babasubiza kuko babonaga bazanye igitero gikomeye.
Ubwo ariko, inama y’abigishamategeko yari iteraniye kwa Alikimu na Bakidesi, kugira ngo bashakire hamwe umwanzuro w’ukuri.
Aba mbere muri abo Bayisraheli basabaga amahoro bari Abahasidimu;
bagira bati «Ni umuherezabitambo wo mu muryango wa Aroni wazanye n’ingabo, ntazatugirira nabi.»
Avugana na bo amagambo y’amahoro, ari na ko abyemeresha indahiro agira ati «Nimuhumure ntidushaka kubagirira nabi, kimwe n’incuti zanyu.»
Bahera ko barabyemera, nyamara uwo munsi afatisha mirongo itandatu muri bo, arabica. Bityo harangira amagambo y’Ibyanditswe aho bigira biti
«Bashwanyaguje umubiri w’intungane zawe, n’amaraso yazo bayanyanyagiza impande za Yeruzalemu, maze habura n’umwe ubahamba.»
Nuko rubanda rwose rutahwa n’ubwoba, bakavuga bati «Nta kuri n’ubutabera bibarangwaho, kuko barenze ku masezerano n’indahiro bari bagize.»
Bukeye, Bakidesi ava i Yeruzalemu ajya guca ingando i Betizeti. Akajya atuma gufata abantu benshi mu bari bamuyobotse, kimwe n’abandi bo muri rubanda; akabica maze akabaroha mu iriba rirerire.
Iyo ntara ayegurira Alikimu, amuha n’ingabo zo kumushyigikira, hanyuma Bakidesi asubira i bwami.
Alikimu akomeza kurwanira icyubahiro cyo kuba umuherezabitambo mukuru,
ababuzaga rubanda amahoro bose baramuyoboka, bigarurira igihugu cya Yudeya kandi bagirira nabi cyane Israheli.
Yuda abonye ko ubugiranabi bwa Alikimu n’abayoboke be bagirira Israheli butambutse kure ubw’abanyamahanga,
azenguruka igihugu cyose cya Yudeya kugira ngo ahore abagambanyi, kandi ababuze gukomeza kuzerera mu gihugu.
heading: Nikanori muri Yudeya; urugamba rw’i Kafarisalamu / ( / )

text: Nuko Alikimu ngo abone ko Yuda n’abantu be bamaze kumurusha amaboko, kandi ko atagishoboye kubarwanya, ahera ko asubira ibwami maze abarega amarorerwa atagira ingano.
Umwami ni ko kohereza Nikanori, umwe mu bagaba be b’ibirangirire, akaba umwanzi n’umugome ukomeye kuri Israheli, amuha ubutumwa bwo kurimbura iyo mbaga.
Nikanori agera i Yeruzalemu n’igitero gikomeye, atuma kuri Yuda n’abavandimwe be asaba amahoro, mu magambo yuje uburyarya agira ati
«Ntibikabe rwose ko narwana namwe, nazazana gusa n’abantu bakeya kugira ngo twumvikane mu mahoro.»
Nuko ngo agere kwa Yuda bararamukanya mu mahoro, nyamara ubwo abanzi bakaba barekereje gufata Yuda.
Yuda abonye ko Nikanori yaje iwe yiyoberanyije, aramutinya ndetse ntiyaba agishaka no kumubona.
Nikanori na we ngo amenye ko umugambi we watahuwe, atera Yuda kugira ngo amurwanyirize hafi ya Kafarisalamu.
Hagwa abantu bagera kuri magana atanu mu ngabo za Nikanori, abandi bahungira mu murwa wa Dawudi.
heading: Nikanori ahigira gusenya Ingoro

text: Ibyo birangiye, Nikanori arazamuka, ajya ku musozi wa Siyoni. Abaherezabitambo n’abakuru b’umuryango basohoka mu Ngoro baje kumwifuriza amahoro, no kumwereka igitambo gitwikwa baturiraga umwami.
Ariko we arabakwena, abakoza isoni, arabahindanya kandi ababwira amagambo yuzuye agasuzuguro.
Muri ubwo burakari bwe ararahira ati «Niba noneho Yuda n’ingabo ze batangarukiye, igihe nzagarukira amahoro ari yose, nzatwika iriya Ngoro!»
Abaherezabitambo barikubura, bahagarara imbere y’urutambiro rw’Ingoro, basesa amarira bavuga bati
«Ni wowe wihitiyemo iyi Nzu kugira ngo yambarizwemo izina ryawe kandi ngo ibere umuryango wawe Inzu yo kugusenga no kukwambaza.
None rero, tebuka uhorere igihugu cyawe, maze uriya muntu n’ingabo ze bashirire ku bugi bw’inkota. Ibuka ibitutsi batutse izina ryawe, maze ubabuze ubuhumeka!»
heading: Ugutsindwa n’urupfu rwa Nikanori muri Adasa / ( / )

text: Nikanori ava i Yeruzalemu ajya guca ingando i Betihoroni, ari na ho ingabo zo muri Siriya zamusanze.
Yuda na we aca ingando muri Adasa, ari kumwe n’abantu ibihumbi bitatu. Nuko asenga avuga ati
«Igihe intumwa z’umwami w’Abanyashuru zitutse izina ryawe, umumalayika wawe yaraje abicamo abantu ibihumbi ijana na mirongo inani na batanu.
N’uyu munsi rero utsembe kiriya gitero mu maso yacu, kugira ngo n’abandi bose bamenyereho ko Nikanori yavuze nabi Ingoro yawe, kandi umucire urukwiranye n’ubugome bwe!»
Nuko ibitero byombi bisakirana ku munsi wa cumi n’itatu w’ukwezi kwa Adari, ari na ko Nikanori yatsinzwemo, aba ari na we ugwa uwa mbere ku rugamba.
Ingabo za Nikanori zibonye ko aguye zijugunya intwaro zazo, zirihungira.
Abayahudi babakurikirana umunsi wose, kuva Adasa kugera ku nkengero za Gazara, bagenda bavuza uturumbeti inyuma yabo.
Abatuye mu nsisiro zose zo muri Yudeya barasohoka, kugira ngo bagote izo mpunzi zanyuranagamo. Nuko bose bamarwa n’inkota ntihagira n’umwe urokoka.
Bamaze kubacuza no gutwara iminyago, Nikanori bamuca umutwe n’ikiganza cy’iburyo yaramburanaga agasuzuguro, barabijyana babimanika ahateganye na Yeruzalemu.
Rubanda rusagukwa n’ibyishimo, uwo munsi bawugirira ibirori nk’indi minsi mikuru yose y’umunezero.

Bategeka ko uwo munsi uzajya uhimbazwa buri mwaka ku munsi wa cumi n’itatu w’ukwezi kwa Adari. Nuko igihugu cya Yudeya kimara iminsi mu ituze.Currently Selected:Icya mbere cy'Abamakabe 7: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Nuko Yuda aza kumva bavuga ibyerekeye Abanyaroma. Ngo bari abantu b’ibihangange, bakagwa neza ku bunze ubumwe na bo bose kandi bakabana neza n’ubasanze wese, mbese bari intwari koko.
heading: Ubwamamare bw’Abanyaroma

text: Bamutekerereza ibitero bagabye n’ibikorwa bakoze mu Bugalati, ukuntu bigaruriye icyo gihugu bakanabaka umusoro,
ibyo bakoze byose mu gihugu cya Hispaniya, bashaka kwigarurira ibisimu by’umuringa n’ibya zahabu byo muri icyo gihugu.

Banamutekerereza ukuntu batsinze icyo gihugu cyose babikesheje ubwenge bwabo buhugutse n’umuhate wabo, (koko kandi icyo gihugu cyari kure y’iwabo cyane); bakaba baratsinze n’abami baturutse ku mpera z’isi baje kubarwanya, barabatsinda bikomeye naho abandi bakabazanira umusoro buri mwaka.
Ndetse bari baratsinze na Filipo na Perise, umwami w’Abakitimu, n’intwaro zabo, kimwe n’abandi bose bari barabahagurukiye, maze barabayoboka.
Antiyokusi mukuru, umwami wa Aziya wari waje kubarwanya n’inzovu ijana na makumyabiri, abanyamafarasi, amagare y’intambara n’igitero kinini, baramutsinze ibi bidasubirwaho, ndetse banamufata mpiri.
Ari we, ari n’abamuzunguye ku ngoma bose, bategekwa kujya bazana imisoro uko igihe kigeze, no gutanga abantu ho ingwate.
Nuko bamunyaga igihugu cy’Ubuhinde, Mediya, Lidiya na zimwe mu ntara zirusha izindi ubwiza, bamaze kubimunyaga babigabira umwami Ewumene.
Ni bwo abo mu Bugereki bahuje umugambi wo kujya kubatsemba,

ariko Abanyaroma ngo babimenye boherezayo umugaba umwe w’ingabo, arabarwanya maze bapfamo abantu benshi. Abagore n’abana babatwara ari imbohe, babasahura ibyabo byose, igihugu barakigarurira, basenya ikigo cyabo n’abantu babo babagira abacakara, bakaba na n’ubu bakiburimo.
Naho ibindi bihugu n’ibirwa byari byarabigometseho, Abanyaroma bari barabitsinze kandi barabyigarurira.
Nyamara amacuti yabo n’ababiringiraga, bakomeje kugirana na bo umubano mwiza. Bigaruriye n’abami baturanye ndetse n’aba kure, bityo ababumvise bose bakabatinya.
Abo babaga bashatse gutabara no kwimika, bakaganza; abo badashatse bakabanyaga ingoma; mbese koko baba ibihangange ku buryo bugaragara.
Cyakora, muri ibyo byose, nta n’umwe muri bo wambaraga ikamba cyangwa umwambaro wa cyami, ngo na we bimuheshe ikuzo.
Bishyiriyeho inama nkuru igizwe n’abantu magana atatu na makumyabiri yateranaga buri munsi, kugira ngo basuzume ibibazo bya rubanda kandi ngo barusheho kugira umutekano.
Buri mwaka, umuntu umwe yashingwaga ubuyobozi bwayo agategeka igihugu cyose; mbese bose bakamwumvira nta ngingimira cyangwa se ishyari.
heading: Abayahudi bagirana amasezerano n’Abanyaroma

text: Yuda rero ni ko gutoranya Ewupolemi, mwene Yohani wo mu nzu ya Akosi, na Yasoni mwene Eleyazari, abatuma i Roma kugira ngo bajye gushaka umubano, bagirane amasezerano n’Abanyaroma,
no kugira ngo bababohore kuko yabonaga abami b’Abagereki barushaho gukandamiza Israheli.
Bamaze gukora urugendo rurerure bagera i Roma, binjira mu nzu y’inama nkuru, bafata ijambo, bagira bati
«Yuda Makabe n’abavandimwe be hamwe n’imbaga yose y’Abayahudi babadutumyeho, kugira ngo tugirane amasezerano, tubane mu mahoro kandi tubarirwe mu mubare w’abayoboke banyu n’incuti zanyu.»
Ayo magambo ashimisha abateraniye mu nama bose.
Dore amagambo banditse ku bimanyu by’umuringa bakabyohereza i Yeruzalemu, kugira ngo bibere Abayahudi ikimenyetso cy’amahoro n’icy’amasezerano bagiranye:
«Amahoro nasagambe ku Banyaroma n’Abayahudi iteka ryose, haba mu nyanja cyangwa ku butaka! Inkota n’umwanzi nibijye kure yabo!
Roma niramuka itewe iyambere cyangwa se umwe mu ncuti zayo wo mu gihugu itegeka,
Abayahudi bose bazaturwanirira uko bishobotse n’umutima wabo wose.
Ntibazagira icyo baha abanzi, cyaba ingano, intwaro, feza cyangwa amato: ni ko Roma ibyemeje kandi ikazubahiriza amasezerano yayo nta ngwate.
Na none kandi, igihugu cy’Abayahudi nikibanza guterwa, Abanyaroma bazakirwanirira n’umutima wabo wose.
Nta cyo bazaha abanzi, cyaba ingano, intwaro, feza cyangwa amato: ni ko Roma ibyemeje kandi ikazubahiriza amasezerano yayo nta buryarya.
Ayo ni yo masezerano Roma igiranye n’igihugu cy’Abayahudi.
Niba kandi mu gihe kizaza hari bamwe bashatse kugira icyo bongeraho cyangwa se bakuraho bizakorwa uko bishoboka; ibigomba kongerwaho cyangwa se kuvanwaho bizaba ihame.
Naho ku byerekeye amarorerwa yose Demetiriyo yabakoreye, twamwandikiye muri aya magambo tuti ’Ni iki gituma ukandamiza Abayahudi, incuti zacu twagiranye amasezerano?

Nibongera rero kukurega, tuzabatabara tukurwanye haba mu nyanja cyangwa ku butaka.’»Currently Selected:Icya mbere cy'Abamakabe 8: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Nyamara Demetiriyo amenye ko Nikanori yaguye ku rugamba n’ingabo ze, yongera kohereza Bakidesi na Alikimu mu gihugu cya Yudeya, hamwe n’ingabo z’uruhembe rw’iburyo.
heading: Urugamba rwo kuri Berizeti n’urupfu rwa Yuda Makabe

text: Nuko bafata inzira igana mu Galileya, bagota Mesaloti yo mu gihugu cya Arubele, barahigarurira kandi bahica n’abantu batagira ingano.
Mu kwezi kwa mbere k’umwaka w’ijana na mirongo itanu n’ibiri baca ingando i Yeruzalemu,
hanyuma bagenda berekeje i Berizeti, bajyanye n’ingabo ibihumbi makumyabiri z’abanyamaguru, n’ibihumbi bibiri by’abanyamafarasi.
Yuda na we akaba yaciye ingando Eleyasa, ari kumwe n’ingabo z’ingenzi ibihumbi bitatu.
Ngo babone ubwinshi bw’igitero cy’abanzi bagira ubwoba, maze benshi muri bo barahunga hasigara gusa nk’abantu magana inani mu ngando.
Yuda abonye ko abantu be bamushizeho kandi n’igitero kikaba kimusatiriye, acika intege kuko atari agifite igihe cyo gukoranya ingabo ze.
Uko yakihebye, abwira abari basigaye ati «Nimuhaguruke dusatire abanzi, tubarwanye uko dushoboye kose.»
Nyamara bo bamuca intege bamubwira bati «Nta kindi kindi dushoboye muri aka kanya usibye gukiza amagara yacu gusa, nyuma tukazagarukana ku rugamba n’abavandimwe bacu. Ubu rwose turi bake cyane.»
Yuda arabasubiza ati «Ibyo kubahunga byo simbikozwa! Niba umunsi wacu wageze, dupfire gitwari abavandimwe bacu, ariko tutabaretse ngo badutwarane akaganzanyo.»

Nuko igitero cy’abanzi gisohoka mu ngando gihagarara ahateganye na bo. Abanyamafarasi bigabanyamo amatsinda abiri, naho abanyamihumetso n’abanyamiheto kimwe n’abanyengabo — mbese abantu b’intwari bose — babarangaza imbere.
Bakidesi yari ku ruhembe rw’iburyo, maze akarumbeti ngo kavuge, igitero gitangira gusatira ku mpembe zombi. Ku ruhande rwa Yuda na bo bavuza akarumbeti,
maze isi ihinda umushyitsi kubera urwamo rw’ingabo. Urugamba rutangira mu gitondo rurakomeza kugeza nimugoroba.
Yuda abona ko Bakidesi n’ab’intwari mu ngabo ze baherereye ku ruhembe rw’iburyo; ubwo abagikomeye mu be baramwegera,
maze urwo ruhembe rw’iburyo bararutikiza ndetse barabakurikirana kugera ku musozi wa Azara.
Ariko Abanyasiriya bari ku ruhembe rw’ibumoso ngo babone ko urw’iburyo runeshejwe, bakurikirana Yuda na bagenzi be babaturutse inyuma.
Intambara irushaho gukaza umurego ku mpande zombi, hagwa abantu batagira ingano.
Nuko Yuda na we agwa aho ngaho, abasigaye barahunga.
heading: Ihambwa rya Yuda Makabe

text: Yonatani na Simoni batwara umurambo w’umuvandimwe wabo Yuda, bawushyingura mu mva y’abasekuruza be i Modini.
Abayisraheli bose baramuririra, bamugira mu cyunamo kandi bamarana amaganya iminsi myinshi bavuga, bati
«Iyo ntwari yakizaga Israheli, ipfuye ku buhe buryo!»
Ibindi bigwi bya Yuda, intambara ze, ibikorwa yakoze n’ibigaragaza ikuzo rye nta bwo byanditswe; byari byinshi cyane.
heading: IV. YONATANI, UMUTWARE W’ABAYAHUDI N’UMUHEREZABITAMBO MUKURU (160–142 mb. K.) / Yonatani azungura umuvandimwe we Yuda

text: Yuda amaze gupfa, abantu b’ibyigomeke n’inkozi z’ibibi bongera kwaduka muri Israheli.
Kubera ko muri iyo minsi hari harateye inzara gica, igihugu cyose kirabayoboka.
Bakidesi atoranya nkana abantu b’ibiburamutima ngo abe ari bo bategeka igihugu.
Abo bategetsi batoteza ab’incuti za Yuda, bakabakoreraho iperereza hanyuma bakabazanira Bakidesi akabahana, ndetse akabakoza n’isoni.
Nuko muri Israheli haba itotezwa ritigeze riboneka nk’iryo, kuva umunsi abahanuzi bazimiye muri Israheli.
Bukeye, incuti za Yuda zirakorana zibwira Yonatani, ziti
«Kuva aho umuvandimwe wawe Yuda apfiriye, nta wundi muntu umeze nka we twabonye washobora kurwanya abanzi bacu: Bakidesi n’abantu be n’abandi bose banga umuryango wacu.
None rero guhera ubu turagutoye, wowe ubwawe, kugira ngo utubere umutware mu mwanya we, kandi utuyobore muri iyi ntambara turwana.»
Kuva ubwo Yonatani afata ubutegetsi, asimbura umuvandimwe we Yuda.
heading: Yonatani mu butayu bw’i Tekowa

text: Bakidesi abyumvise ashaka uburyo yakwicisha Yonatani.
Yonatani na we, amaze kubimenya, ahungira mu butayu bw’i Tekowa, hamwe na Simoni umuvandimwe we n’abo bari kumwe bose, baca ingando hafi y’ikigega cy’amazi cya Asufari.
Bakidesi abimenya ari ku isabato, yambukana n’ingabo ze zose bajya hakurya ya Yorudani.
Yonatani ni ko kohereza murumuna we Yohani, wari uyoboye abari batumwe ku ncuti zabo z’Abanabateyi, kubabaza ko bashobora kubabikira ibintu byabo kuko byari byinshi cyane.
Ariko bene Amurayi, b’i Medoba, barasohoka bafata Yohani bamucuza n’ibyo yari afite byose, maze barigendera n’iminyago yabo.

Nyuma y’ibyo, baza kubwira Yonatani na Simoni umuvandimwe we, ko bene Amurayi bagiye gucyuza ubukwe bukomeye, umugeni akaza mu ngobyi ishagawe cyane, kuva i Nabata, akaba kandi ari umukobwa w’umuntu ukomeye wo mu gihugu cya Kanahani.
Bahita bibuka amaraso y’umuvandimwe wabo Yohani, ni ko kuzamuka bajya kwihisha mu ibanga ry’umusozi.
Ngo bubure amaso, babona haje ikivunge cy’abantu basakabaka, bafite n’ibintu byinshi; bakurikiwe n’umukwe, incuti ze n’abavandimwe be, hamwe n’abavuza ingoma n’abaririmbyi bambaye gisirikare.
Abayahudi bavumbuka mu bwihisho bwabo, barabasimbukira, maze si ukubica karahava; hagwa abantu benshi n’abasigaye bahungira ku musozi, Abayahudi barabacuza.
Nuko ubwari ubukwe buhinduka icyunamo, n’indirimbo zivamo amaganya.
Bamaze guhorera batyo umuvandimwe wabo, bigarukira ku nkombe za Yorudani.
heading: Abayahudi bambuka Yorudani

text: Bakidesi amaze kubimenya, ahagurukana n’ingabo ze zose aza ku nkombe ya Yorudani.
Nuko Yonatani abwira abantu be, ati «Nimuhaguruke, turwane ku magara yacu, kuko iminsi idasa; bucya bwitwa ejo.
Ngira ngo murabyibonera namwe ko urugamba rwadutangatanze, imbere n’inyuma, hakaba n’aya mazi ya Yorudani, n’iki gishanga n’ibi bihuru; ku buryo nta hantu na hamwe dushobora guhungira.
None rero, nimutakambire Nyir’ijuru kugira ngo abakure mu minwe y’abanzi banyu.»
Rumaze kwambikana, Yonatani abangura ukuboko ngo atikure Bakidesi, ariko Bakidesi aramwizibukira, asubira inyuma.
Nuko Yonatani na bagenzi be biroha muri Yorudani, baroga bafata hakurya, ariko abanzi babo ntibambuka ngo babakurikire.
Uwo munsi abantu bagera ku gihumbi mu ngabo za Bakidesi, bagwa ku rugamba.
heading: Bakidesi muri Yudeya n’urupfu rwa Alikimu

text: Bakidesi agarutse i Yeruzalemu, atangira kubakisha ibigo bikomeye muri Yudeya: ikigo cy’i Yeriko, icya Emawusi, icya Betoroni, icya Beteli, icya Tamunata, icya Faratoni n’icya Tifoni, abikikiza inkike ndende cyane, ashyira inzugi ku marembo n’ibihindizo by’ibyuma.
Hanyuma asiga muri buri kigo umutwe w’abasirikare bo gukandamiza Israheli,
maze akomeza n’umugi wa Betishuri, uwa Gazara, n’Ikigo cy’i Yeruzalemu; ahashyira abasirikare kandi ahahunika n’ibiribwa.
Abana b’abatware b’igihugu abafataho ingwate, abashyira mu Kigo cy’i Yeruzalemu ngo babe ari ho barindirwa.
Mu kwezi kwa kabiri k’umwaka w’ijana na mirongo itanu n’itanu, Alikimu ategeka gusenya inkike y’igikari cy’Ingoro; asenya atyo ibikorwa by’abahanuzi, atangira kubirimbagura.

Cyakora muri icyo gihe, Alikimu afatwa n’indwara, maze ibikorwa yari atangiye biburiramo. Umunwa we urafatana, uraremara ku buryo atari agishobora kuvuga ijambo na rimwe no gutanga amategeko y’urugo rwe.
Alikimu apfa atyo mu bubabare burenze urugero.
Bakidesi ngo abone ko Alikimu apfuye agaruka ibwami, n’igihugu cya Yuda kiboneraho kugira agahenge k’imyaka ibiri.
heading: Ukuganzwa n’itahuka rya Bakidesi

text: Abantu bose by’ibyigomeke bajya inama bagira bati «Dore Yonatani n’abantu be bibereye mu mahoro nta cyo bikanga. None reka dutumize Bakidesi, aze abafate bose ijoro rimwe.»
Ni ko kujya kumureba, maze inama yabyo barayinoza.
Bakidesi ahagurukana n’igitero gikomeye, yandikira rwihishwa incuti ze zo muri Yudeya azisaba gufata Yonatani na bagenzi be, ariko ntibabishobora kuko umugambi wabo wari wamenyekanye.
Ahubwo abo kwa Yonatani baba ari bo bafata abantu mirongo itanu mu gihugu — abari bagiye uwo mugambi w’ubugome — maze barabica.
Hanyuma Yonatani na Simoni n’abantu babo bahungira i Betibasi mu butayu, basana iby’aho byari byarasenyutse, maze barahakomeza.
Bakidesi ngo abimenye, akoranya abantu be bose kandi ahuruza n’incuti ze zo muri Yudeya.
Araza aca ingando hafi y’i Betibasi ahagota iminsi myinshi, ari na ko yubakisha imashini z’intambara.
Bukeye, Yonatani asiga umuvandimwe we Simoni mu mugi, arasohoka ajya mu gasozi yitwaje itsinda ry’abantu bakeya.
Atsinda Odomera n’abavandimwe be ndetse na bene Fazironi, abasanze mu ngando yabo. Abo bantu batangira kurwana, no gusatira cyane,
naho Simoni n’abantu be barasohoka, maze batwika za mashini.
Barwana na Bakidesi, bamutsinze biramubabaza cyane kubera ko uburyo bwo kurwana yari yateguye butamuhiriye.
Nuko ataha arakaye, abantu b’abahemu bari bamugiriye inama yo kuza mu gihugu, we n’abantu be, babicamo benshi, bityo yiyemeza kwisubirira iwe.
Yonatani ngo abyumve, amutumaho intumwa kugira ngo bagirane na we amasezerano y’amahoro no kugurana imfungwa.
Bakidesi arabyemera kandi yiyemeza kutazahemuka ku masezerano ye, amurahira ko atazongera gushaka icyamugirira nabi igihe cyose azaba akiriho.
Bakidesi amaze gusubiza imfungwa yari yarafatiye mbere mu gihugu cya Yudeya, asubira iwe kandi ntiyongera kugaruka ukundi mu gihugu cy’Abayahudi.

Nuko inkota irahosha muri Israheli na Yonatani ajya gutura i Makimasi, atangira gucira rubanda imanza no gutsemba abagome muri Israheli.Currently Selected:Icya mbere cy'Abamakabe 9: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Mu mgwaka w’ijana na mirongo itandatu, Alegisanderi mwene Antiyokusi bitaga Epifani, arambuka ajya kwigarurira Putolemayida, banamwakira neza, aba ari ho atangariza ingoma ye.
heading: Alegisanderi Balasi agira Yonatani umuherezabitambo

text: Umwami Demetiriyo ngo yumve iyo nkuru, akoranya igitero gikomeye koko maze ajya kumurwanya.
Ubwo kandi yandikira na Yonatani ibaruwa yuje amagambo y’amahoro, amusezeranya kumuha ikuzo ry’ikirenga.
Yaribwiraga ati «Reka tugirane bwangu amasezerano y’amahoro na bariya bantu, batarayagirana na Alegisanderi ngo baduhagurukire,
kuko Yonatani yazibuka ibibi byose twakoreye abavandimwe be n’umuryango we.»
Amuha ndetse n’uburenganzira bwo guhuruza ingabo, bwo gucurisha intwaro n’ubwo kwiyita incuti ye, anategeka ko bamusubiza abantu bari bafashweho ingwate mu Kigo.
Nuko Yonatani aza i Yeruzalemu, bwa butumwa abusomera rubanda rwose n’abaturage bo mu Kigo.
Bose batahwa n’ubwoba bwinshi, bumvise ko umwami yamuhaye uburenganzira bwo guhuruza ingabo.
Abaturage bo mu Kigo basubiza Yonatani abo bantu bari barafashweho ingwate, na we abashyikiriza ababyeyi babo.
Yonatani atura i Yeruzalemu, atangira gusana no gutunganya umugi;
ategeka ubwe abayobozi b’imirimo yo gusana inkike, no gukikiza umusozi wa Siyoni amabuye abajwe, kugira ngo babikomeze; ibyo byose birakorwa.
Abanyamahanga bari mu bigo byubatswe na Bakidesi barahunga,
buri wese muri bo akareka umurimo we kugira ngo yisubirire mu gihugu cye.
Cyakora i Betishuri hasigara bamwe mu byigomeke, kuko hari ubuhungiro bwabo.
Umwami Alegisanderi aza kumenya amasezerano Demetiriyo yagiranye na Yonatani; banamutekerereza intambara n’ibikorwa by’ubutwari Yonatani n’abavandimwe be bari barakoze kimwe n’imiruho barushye.
Umwami ni ko kuvuga ati «Hari ubwo se tuzigera tubona umuntu nk’uyu? Nimucyo tumugire incuti yacu, twifatanye na we!»
Ahera ko amwoherereza ibaruwa yari yanditsemo aya magambo:
«Jyewe umwami Alegisanderi, ku muvandimwe wanjye Yonatani. Ndakuramutsa!
Twumvise bakuvuga ko uri umuntu w’intwari, ukwiye kuba incuti yacu.

Ni yo mpamvu kuva uyu munsi tukugize umuherezabitambo mukuru w’umuryango wawe, tukaguha n’icyubahiro cyo kwitwa incuti y’umwami — abigaragaza amwoherereza ikanzu y’umuhemba n’ikamba rya zahabu — kugira ngo nawe udushyigikire, kandi udukomereze ubucuti.»

Nuko mu kwezi kwa karindwi k’umwaka w’ijana na mirongo itandatu, mu birori by’umunsi mukuru w’ingando Yonatani yambara imyambaro mitagatifu y’ubuherezabitambo; akorakoranya ingabo kandi acurisha intwaro nyinshi.
heading: Ibaruwa Demetiriyo wa mbere yandikiye Yonatani

text: Demetiriyo ngo amenye ibyo biramushobera, ni ko kuvuga ati
«Twakoze iki kugira ngo Alegisanderi adutange kugirana ubucuti n’Abayahudi, akaba agiye kurushaho gukomera?
Nanjye nzabandikira mu magambo aryohereye, mbemerere imyanya ihanitse n’ubukire, kugira ngo bazantere inkunga.»
Nuko abandikira muri aya magambo:«Jyewe umwami Demetiriyo, ku muryango w’Abayahudi. Ndabaramutsa!
Mwakomeje amasezerano twagiranye ubushize munakomeza kutubera incuti, mwirinda guca iruhande ngo mujye mu gice cy’abanzi bacu. Ibyo twarabimenye kandi byaradushimishije.
Nimudukomereze ubwo budahemuka natwe tuzabitura ibyiza byinshi, kubera ubuntu mutugirira.
Tuzabaruhura kuri byinshi kandi tubakorere n’ibyiza byinshi.
Kandi kuva ubu, Abayahudi bose ndababohoye kandi mbakuye ku musoro, ku mahoro y’umunyu no ku makoro.

Naho ku byerekeye igice cya gatatu cy’imyaka, n’icya kabiri cy’imbuto z’ibiti nahabwaga, guhera uyu munsi wa none n’igihe cyose, mbyeguriye igihugu cya Yudeya n’intara zayo eshatu zikuwe kuri Samariya . . .
Yeruzalemu izaba ntagatifu, kandi nyeguriye yo n’igihugu cyayo, imigabane cumi n’ibyo ingomba byose.
Neguye ku butegetsi bwose bw’Ikigo cy’i Yeruzalemu, nkaba nkeguriye umuherezabitambo mukuru, agishyiremo abantu yitoranyirije kugira ngo bakirinde.

Umuntu wese w’Umuyahudi wavanywe mu gihugu cya Yudeya ari imbohe, akajyanwa bunyago mu bihugu byanjye aho biva bikagera, uwo musubije ubwigenge bwe kandi nta ncungu natse. Ndashaka ko bose basonerwa ku musoro kimwe n’amatungo yabo.

Iminsi mikuru yose, isabato n’imboneko z’ukwezi, iminsi mikuru yashyizweho kimwe n’iminsi itau iyibanziriza n’iyikurikira, izabe iminsi y’imbabazi n’iy’ukwishyira ukizana ku Bayahudi bose bari mu gihugu cyanjye,
kandi nta n’uzigera agira icyo abishyuza cyangwa ngo abatere intugunda ku mpamvu ibonetse yose.
Abayahudi bazashyirwa mu ngabo z’umwami kugeza ku bantu ibihumbi mirongo itatu by’abasirikare, kandi bajye bahabwa igihembo nk’izindi ngabo zose z’umwami.

Bazashyirwa mu bigo by’ingenzi by’umwami, bashingwe n’imirimo ikomeye mu gihugu; abayobozi babo n’abatware bazajya batoranywa muri bo, kandi bakurikize amategeko yabo nk’uko umwami yabitegetse mu gihugu cya Yudeya.
Naho za ntara eshatu zunzwe kuri Yudeya zikuwe kuri Samariya, nizibe iza Yudeya kandi zitegekwe n’umuntu umwe, nta bundi butegetsi bundi zumvira butari ubw’umuherezabitambo mukuru.
Putolemayida na yo n’akarere kayikikije mbyeguriye Ingoro y’i Yeruzalemu, kugira ngo ijye yishyura ibyakoreshejwe mu mihango mitagatifu.
Jye ku giti cyanjye, nzajya ntanga amasikeli ibihumbi cumi na bitanu bya feza zizafatwa ku mutungo w’umwami uri mu turere tubitunganiye.
Naho ibirarane byose abasoresha batatanze uko byagombaga mu myaka ishize, kuva ubu bizajya bitangwa kugira ngo bikoreshwe imirimo y’Ingoro.
Ikindi kandi, amasikeli ibihumbi bitanu yakurwaga ku mutungo w’Ingoro wa buri mwaka, ayo na yo ndayazibukiriye, azajya ahabwa abaherezabitambo bakora imirimo yo mu Ngoro.

Umuntu wese uzahungira mu Ngoro y’i Yeruzalemu no mu mbago zayo zose, azira ko ataratanga umusoro w’umwami cyangwa se ko arimo undi mwenda, ntazakurikiranwa hamwe n’ibyo atunze byose mu gihugu cyanjye.
Naho ku byerekeye imirimo yo gusana no kubaka Ingoro, indishyi zabyo zizavanwa ku mutungo w’umwami.
Ibyo kongera kubaka inkike za Yeruzalemu no kuzikomeza, kimwe no gusana inkike z’imigi ya Yudeya, indishyi zabyo na zo zizavanwa ku mutungu w’umwami.»
heading: Urupfu rw’umwami Demetiriyo wa mbere

text: Yonatani na rubanda ngo bumve ayo magambo ntibayizera, banga no kuyemera kuko bibukaga ibibi byose Demetiriyo yakoreye Israheli, n’uburyo yari yarabashikamiye.
Biyemeza gukomeza umubano na Alegisanderi kuko ari we wababwiye bwa mbere amagambo y’amahoro, bamubera incuti z’indahemuka.
Bukeye, umwami Alegisanderi akoranya igitero gikomeye maze atera Demetiriyo.
Abami bombi bamaze gusakirana, ingabo za Alegisanderi zirahunga. Demetiriyo aramukurikirana, bityo atsinda abasirikare be.
Intambara irakomera kugeza ko izuba rirenga, ariko uwo munsi nyine, Demetiriyo na we agwa ku rugamba.
heading: Yonatani ashyirwa mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi

text: Alegisanderi yohereza intumwa kuri Putolemeyi, umwami wa Misiri, amubwira ati
«Ubwo nagarutse mu gihugu cyanjye nkaba nicaye ku ntebe y’ubwami y’abasekuruza banjye, ngafata ubutegetsi kuko natsinze Demetiriyo nkigarurira igihugu cyacu,
nkamurwanya nkamutsinda we n’ingabo ze maze tukaba twicaye ku ntebe ye ya cyami,
tugirane ubundi bucuti maze uyu munsi unshyingire umukobwa wawe, mbe umukwe wawe kandi nzaguhe kimwe n’umukobwa wawe, amaturo abakwiriye.»
Umwami Putolemeyi amusubiza agira ati «Harakabaho umunsi wagarutseho mu gihugu cy’abasekuruza bawe, ukicara ku ntebe yabo y’ubwami!
None rero, nzagukorera ibyo wanyandikiye, ariko uzaze duhurire i Putolemayida tubonane maze nzakubere sobukwe nk’uko wabivuze.»
Mu mwaka w’ijana na mirongo itandatu n’ibiri, umwami Putolemeyi ahagarukana mu Misiri na Kilewopatira, umukobwa we, baza i Putolemayida.
Umwami Alegisanderi aza gusanganira Putolemeyi, na we amushyingira umukobwa we Kilewopatira, n’ubukwe bubera i Putolemayida, buba bwiza cyane ku buryo bukwiriye abami.
Bukeye, umwami Alegisanderi yandikira Yonatani ngo aze kumureba.
Nuko Yonatani ajya i Putolemayida yabikereye koko ahahurira n’abo bami bombi; abaha amaturo ya feza na zahabu kimwe n’incuti zabo, mbese abaha n’andi maturo menshi maze barabimukundira.
Ubwo abantu b’ibyigomeke, ari na bo cyorezo cya Israheli, baramuhagurukira kugira ngo bamurege ku mwami, ariko we ntiyabyitaho na gato;
ahubwo ategeka ko bambura Yonatani imyambaro ye bakamwambika igishura cy’umuhemba; bahera ko barabikora.

Umwami amwicaza iruhande rwe maze abwira abanyacyubahiro be, ati «Nimujyane na we mu mugi, maze mutangaze ko nta muntu n’umwe uzongera kugira icyo amurega, cyangwa se ngo amutere intugunda ku mpamvu ibonetse yose.»
Abamuregaga babonye icyubahiro ahawe n’uko byatangazwaga n’umugaba w’ingabo, ndetse n’igishura cy’umuhemba yari yiteye mu bitugu, bose barahunga.
Umwami amuha icyubahiro cyo kwandikwa mu ncuti ze z’ibanze, anamugira umugaba w’ingabo n’umutegetsi w’intara nini.
Nuko Yonatani agaruka i Yeruzalemu mu mahoro no mu byishimo.
heading: Yonatani atsinda Apoloni, umutware wa Kelesiriya

text: Mu mwaka w’ijana na mirongo itandatu n’itanu, Demetiriyo, umuhungu nyine wa Demetiriyo wa mbere, aturuka i Kireta, aza mu gihugu cy’abasekuruza be.
Umwami Alegisanderi abyumvise biramurakaza cyane, ni ko kugaruka i Antiyokiya.
Demetiriyo afata Apoloni, amugira umutware wa Kelesiriya, na we akoranya igitero kinini maze aza guca ingando i Yaminiya, atuma kuri Yonatani, umuherezabitambo mukuru, ati
«Dore ni wowe wenyine usigaye uduhangara, naho jyewe nahindutse urwo baseka n’insuzugurwa kubera wowe. Kuki ukomeza kutudurumbanyiriza iyo mu misozi ?
Niba rero wizeye imbaraga, manuka nonaha udusange mu kibaya maze turebe urusha undi imbaraga, kuko ndi kumwe n’ingufu zose z’umugi.
Ubanze ubaririze neza umenye uwo ndi we n’abantera inkunga. Barahamya ko utazatunanira kuko n’abasekuruza bawe bameneshejwe mu gihugu cyabo incuro ebyiri.
None rero, ntuteze kunanira abanyamafarasi cyangwa igitero kingana gitya, muri iki kibaya kitagira amasenga ntikigire amabuye, cyangwa ahantu umuntu yahungira.»

Igihe Yonatani amaze kumva ayo magambo ya Apoloni, umutima uradiha; ahera ko atoranya abantu ibihumbi cumi, arahaguruka ava i Yeruzalemu; Simoni, umuvandimwe we aramusanganira, azanye n’igitero cyo kumutabara.
Aca ingando ahateganye na Yope; abaturage b’uwo mugi banga kumukingurira kuko warimo abasirikare ba Apoloni, maze urugamba rurambikana.
Ariko abatuye umugi baza kugira ubwoba baramukingurira, maze Yonatani yigarurira Yope.

Apoloni ngo abyumve, ashyira ku rugamba abanyamafarasi ibihumbi bitatu n’abanyamaguru batagira ingano, yerekeza Azoti nk’ushaka kwambukiranya igihugu, ari na ko akataza ajya mu kibaya kuko yari afite abanyamafarasi benshi kandi yiringiye.
Yonatani aza Azoti amuhomereye, ibitero byombi birasakirana.
Ubwo ariko Apoloni akaba yasize inyuma abanyamafarasi igihumbi bihishe.
Yonatani amenya ko hari igico inyuma ye, abanyamafarasi bagota igitero cye, barabarasa kuva mu gitondo kugeza nimugoroba.
Cyakora ingabo ze zikomeza ubutwari nk’uko Yonatani yari yabibategetse, kandi na ya mafarasi arashyira arananirwa.
Nuko Simoni abakura itsinda rye atera igice kimwe cy’ingabo z’abanzi, abanyamafarasi bamaze kunanirwa arabatsinda maze barahunga.
Abanyamafarasi banyanyagira mu kibaya, bahunga bagana Azoti, binjira muri Beti‐Dagoni, ingoro y’ikigirwamana cyabo, kugira ngo barebe ko barokoka.
Ariko Yonatani atwika Azoti n’imigi yose iyikikije, arayisahura, atwika n’ingoro ya Dagoni n’abayihungiyemo bose.
Abicishijwe inkota n’abatwitswe bose bageraga ku bihumbi munani.
Nuko Yonatani ava aho ajya guca ingando hafi ya Ashikeloni; abaturage b’uwo mugi baza kumusanganira babikereye koko.
Hanyuma Yonatani agaruka i Yeruzalemu n’abantu be, bikoreye iminyago myinshi.
Umwami Alegisanderi ngo yumve ibyo byose yongera guha Yonatani icyubahiro cyinshi.

Amwoherereza impeta ya zahabu nk’uko babigenzerezaga ababyeyi b’abami, amwegurira Akaroni n’akarere kayo kose.Currently Selected:Icya mbere cy'Abamakabe 10: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Umwami wa Misiri akoranya ingabo nyinshi zingana n’umusenyi wo ku nyanja, ndetse n’amato atagira ingano, ashaka amayeri yo gutera igihugu cya Alegisanderi kugira ngo acyomeke ku cye.
heading: Urupfu rwa Putolemeyi wa gatandatu n’urwa Alegisanderi Balasi

text: Aza muri Siriya avuga amagambo y’amahoro, abantu bo muri iyo migi bakamwugururira amarembo kandi bakaza kumusanganira, kubera ko umwami Alegisanderi yari yarabategetse kumwakira kuko yari sebukwe.
Ariko uko Putolemeyi yinjiraga muri buri mugi yawusigagamo umutwe w’abasirikare.

Igihe yari yegereje kugera Azoti, bamwereka ingoro ya Dagoni yatwitswe, Azoti n’imigi iyikikije yashenywe, intumbi z’abantu zari zinyanyagiye impande zose n’uduhirivi tw’abo Yonatani yari yaratwitse mu ntambara kuko bari bagiye baturunda aho umwami aza kunyura.
Batekerereza umwami ibyo Yonatani yakoze byose kugira ngo amwamagane ku mugaragaro, ariko umwami aricecekera.
Nuko Yonatani aza yakereye gusanganira umwami i Yope, bararamukanya maze barara aho ngaho.
Bukeye, Yonatani aherekeza umwami amugeza ku ruzi rwitwa Elewuteri, hanyuma agaruka i Yeruzalemu.
Naho umwami Putolemeyi yigarurira imigi yose yo ku nkombe kugeza kuri Selewukiya iri ku Nyanja; akomeza no kuzirikana imigambi mibi ategurira Alegisanderi.
Yohereza intumwa ku mwami Demetiriyo kumubwira ziti «Ngwino tugirane amasezerano; ndetse nzaguhe umukobwa wanjye Alegisanderi atunze kandi uzanategeke igihugu cya so.
Ndicuza kuba naramushyingiye umukobwa wanjye, akaba yarashatse kunyica.»
Yamushinjaga ibyo ngibyo kubera ko yashakaga kwigarurira igihugu cye.
Amaze kuvanayo umukobwa we, amushyingira Demetiriyo; ahita acana umubano na Alegisanderi, noneho urwangano rwabo rujya ahabona.
Putolemeyi yinjira muri Antiyokiya, atamiriza ku ruhanga rwe amakamba abiri, irya Misiri n’irya Aziya.
Icyo gihe umwami Alegisanderi yari muri Silisiya, kuko abantu bo muri ako karere bari bivumbagatanyije.
Alegisanderi ngo amare kumva ibyabaye, aza aje kumurwanya. Putolemeyi na we arahaguruka, amusanganiza igitero gikomeye, nuko aramunesha.
Alegisanderi ajya muri Arabiya kuhashaka ubuhungiro, maze umwami Putolemeyi amutsinda atyo.
Umwarabu Zabudiyeli, agesa umutwe w’Alegisanderi awoherereza Putolemeyi.
Nyuma y’iminsi itatu, umwami Putolemeyi na we arapfa, n’Abanyamisiri bari mu migi ye ikomeye bicwa n’abaturage bayo.
Nuko Demetiriyo aba umwami mu mwaka w’ijana na mirongo itandatu n’irindwi.
heading: Imibonano ya mbere ya Demetiriyo wa kabiri na Yonatani

text: Muri iyo minsi, Yonatani akoranya abaturage ba Yudeya kugira ngo batere Ikigo cy’i Yeruzalemu, bagiteza imashini nyinshi z’intambara.
Nuko ibiburaburyo byanga igihugu cyabo bijya kubonana n’umwami, kugira ngo bimumenyeshe ko Yonatani yagose Ikigo.
Umwami acyumva iyo nkuru ararakara cyane, ako kanya ndetse arahaguruka ajya i Putolemayida, yandikira Yonatani amusaba ngo asigeho gutera, kandi ngo aze i Putolemayida babonane bidatinze.
Yonatani akibona iyo baruwa, ategeka ko bakomeza kukigota, nyuma yitoranyiriza abamuherekeza mu bakuru b’umuryango wa Israheli no mu baherezabitambo, maze we ubwe yigabiza icyo cyago.
Nuko ajyana feza, zahabu, imyambaro n’andi maturo menshi, ajya i Putolemayida kubonana n’umwami maze na we amwakira neza cyane.
Bamwe mu banzi b’igihugu bagerageza kumuhata ibirego,
ariko umwami amugenzereza nk’abamubanjirije, amuhesha icyubahiro imbere y’incuti ze.
Amukomeza ku buherezabitambo bukuru n’indi mirimo inyuranye yari asanganywe, kandi amubara mu ncuti ze z’amagara.
Nuko Yonatani asaba umwami gusonera igihugu cya Yudeya ku misoro kimwe na za ntara eshatu za Samariya, akazitura amatalenta magana atatu.
Umwami arabyemera, ni ko kwandikira Yonatani muri aya magambo:
heading: Amategeko mashya yashyiriweho Abayahudi

text: «Jyewe umwami Demetiriyo, kuri Yonatani umuvandimwe wanjye no ku muryango w’Abayahudi. Ndabaramutsa!
Ibaruwa twandikiye Lasiteni, umubyeyi wacu, namwe turayiboherereje kugira ngo mumenye ibiyirimo:
Jyewe umwami Demetiriyo, kuri Lasiteni, umubyeyi wanjye. Ndakuramutsa!
Kubera umutima mwiza umuryango w’Abayahudi udufitiye, twiyemeje natwe kubagirira neza kuko ari incuti zacu kandi bagakora ibidutunganiye.

Nibahamane igihugu cya Yudeya na za ntara eshatu ari zo Aferema, Lida na Ramatayimu. Izo ntara zavanywe kuri Samariya zomekwa kuri Yudeya hamwe n’utundi turere twayo twose, kugira ngo bajye batanga amaturo ya ngombwa i Yeruzalemu mu kigwi cy’amakoro ya buri mwaka yahabwaga umwami, ku myaka no ku mbuto z’ibiti.
Naho ibindi twagombaga ku mugabane wa cumi no ku musoro, ku mahoro y’ibishanga by’umunyu no ku makoro yari atugenewe, kuva uyu munsi turabibeguriye burundu.
Kuva ubu kandi n’ahazaza, ntakizahinduka kuri ayo mabwiriza.
Iyi nyandiko uyandukurire Yonatani kandi izashyirwe ku musozi mutagatifu aho bose bayibona.»
heading: Yonatani atabara Demetiriyo wa kabiri i Antiyokiya

text: Umwami Demetiriyo abonye ko igihe cy’ingoma ye igihugu cye kiri mu ituze kandi ko nta kintu kikimubangamiye, asezerera ingabo ze buri muntu ataha iwe; uretse abanyamahanga yari yarakuye mu birwa byo mu mahanga. Ibyo rero bituma ingabo yari yararazwe n’ababyeyi be zitangira kumwanga.
Nuko Tirifoni wahoze ari umuyoboke wa Alegisanderi, ngo abone ko ingabo zose zinubira Demetiriyo, arahaguruka ajya kwa Yamiliku, wa Mwarabu wareraga Antiyokusi, umuhungu wa Alegisanderi.
Amusaba akomeje ngo amuhe uwo mwana, kugira ngo ajye kuzungura se. Amutekerereza ibyo Demetiriyo yari yarakoze byose, n’urwangano ingabo ze zari zimufitiye. Nuko ahamara iminsi myinshi.
Icyo gihe, Yonatani na we yoherereza intumwa umwami Demetiriyo, amusaba kuvana ingabo ze mu Kigo cy’i Yeruzalemu no mu bindi bigo, kuko bari bakirwana na Israheli.
Demetiriyo atuma kuri Yonatani, ati «Si n’ibyo byonyine gusa nzagukorera wowe n’igihugu cyawe, ahubwo igihe nabiboneye uburyo nzaguhesha icyubahiro, wowe n’igihugu cyawe.
Kuri ubu rero waba ugize neza unyoherereje abantu bo kuntabara, kuko ingabo zanjye zantereranye.»
Yonatani amwoherereza abantu ibihumbi bitatu b’intwari aho yari ari i Antiyokiya, nuko ngo bagere yo umwami arishima cyane.
Abaturage bo mu mugi bakoranira mu mugi rwagati, bagera nko ku bihumbi ijana na makumyabiri, bafite umugambi wo kwica umwami.
Umwami ahungira mu ngoro ye, naho abaturage bakwirakwira imihanda y’umugi, hanyuma batangira gutera.
Umwami na we abibonye atyo, ahamagara Abayahudi ngo bamurwaneho. Bahera ko baramukikiza, bakwira umugi wose uwo munsi bica abantu bagera ku bihumbi ijana.
Umugi barawutwika ari na ko basahura iminyago myinshi, maze umwami akira atyo.
Abaturage ngo babone ko Abayahudi bigaruriye umugi uko babyifuzaga, bacika intege maze batakambira umwami bagira bati
«Duhane amahoro, kandi Abayahudi bareke kuturwanya no kurwanya umugi!»

Bafasha intwaro zabo hasi maze basaba imbabazi, bityo Abayahudi bihesha icyubahiro imbere y’umwami n’abaturage bose b’igihugu cye. Bamamara batyo muri ibyo bihugu, hanyuma bagaruka i Yeruzalemu n’iminyago itagira ingano.
Umwami Demetiriyo akomera ku ngoma, n’igihugu cye kigira ituze.
Ariko aza kwirengagiza amasezerano yari yaragize, yumvikana nabi na Yonatani, ntiyamwitura ibyiza byose yamugiriye, ahubwo aramutoteza ku buryo bwinshi.
heading: Yonatani yifatanya na Antiyokusi wa gatandatu, akarwanya Demetiriyo wa kabiri

text: Ibyo birangiye, Tirifoni agaruka azanye na wa mwana Antiyokusi; n’ubwo yari muto bwose, yambara ikamba maze aba umwami.
Abasirikare bose ba Demetiriyo bibumbira kuri Tirifoni, batera Demetiriyo baramutsinda, arahunga.
Ubwo Tirifoni afata inzovu ajya kwigarurira Antiyokiya.

Bukeye, wa musore Antiyokusi yandikira Yonatani muri aya magambo: «Ngukomeje ku murimo w’ubuherezabitambo bukuru, ndetse nkweguriye n’ubutegetsi bwa za ntara enye, kandi nkakubarira no mu ncuti z’umwami.»
Nuko amwoherereza ibyungo bya zahabu n’ibikoresho byo ku meza, amuha n’uruhushya rwo kunywera mu nkongoro za zahabu, no kwambara igishura cy’umuhemba n’impeta ya zahabu.
Naho Simoni, umuvandimwe wa Yonatani, amugira umutware guhera ku byambu by’igihugu cya Tiri akageza ku nkiko za Misiri.

Yonatani arahaguruka ajya kuzenguruka ibihugu by’iburengerazuba bwa Efurati n’imigi yaho maze ingabo zose za Siriya ziramusanga ngo zimufashe kurwana. Ageze i Ashikeloni abaturage b’uwo mugi bamwakira neza cyane.
Avuye aho ngaho ajya i Gaza, ariko bamufungiraho amarembo y’umugi; na we ni ko kuwugota, amazu yawo arayatwika kandi arayasahura.
Ni bwo abantu b’i Gaza batakambiye Yonatani, na we abaha amahoro ariko afata abana b’abatware ho ingwate, maze abohereza i Yeruzalemu. Hanyuma azenguruka igihugu kugera i Damasi.
Bukeye, Yonatani yumva ko abagaba b’ingabo ba Demetiriyo bageze i Kadeshi muri Galileya, bazanye n’igitero gikomeye kugira ngo bamuteshe imirimo ye.
Nuko ajya kubasanganira, ariko asize Simoni, umuvandimwe we mu gihugu.
Ubwo Simoni na we atera Betishuri, intambara imara iminsi myinshi, maze arayigota.
Abaturage baho bamusaba amahoro, na we arayabaha, cyakora arahabamenesha, yigarurira umugi wabo kandi awushyiramo umutwe w’abasirikare bo kuwurinda.
Yonatani na we hamwe n’ingabo ze, yari yaje aca ingando ku nkombe z’ikiyaga cya Genezari, mu gitondo cya kare aba ageze mu kibaya cya Asori.
Igitero cy’abanyamahanga kiza kimusanga mu kibaya, bamaze gusiga igico mu misozi cyo gutega Yonatani. Igihe rero icyo gitero cyagendaga gisatira Abayahudi,
ba bantu bari muri cya gico baturumbuka mu bwihisho bwabo, maze batangira imirwano.
Abasirikare ba Yonatani bose barahunga ntihasigara n’umwe, uretse Matatiyasi mwene Abusalomu, na Yuda mwene Kalifi, bombi bakaba abagaba b’ingabo.
Nuko Yonatani ashishimura imyambaro ye, yinyanyagiza umukungugu mu mutwe, maze arasenga.
Hanyuma agaruka ku rugamba arwanya abanzi arabatsinda, na bo barahunga.
Ingabo ze zari zahunze, zibibonye ziramugarukira, bafatanya guhomerera abanzi kugera i Kadeshi aho ingando ye yari iri, na bo bahaca ingando.

Yonatani abonye ko ibyo akora byose bimuhira, atoranya abantu abatuma i Roma kugira ngo bakomeze kandi banavugurure ubucuti bwe n’Abanyaroma.
heading: Yonatani avugurura amasezerano ye n’Abanyaroma

text: Yohereza i Siparita n’ahandi amabaruwa ameze nk’ayo.

Ba bantu rero baragenda n’i Roma, binjira mu nzu y’inama nkuru maze baravuga bati «Yonatani, umuherezabitambo mukuru n’umuryango w’Abayahudi, batwohereje kuvugurura ubucuti n’amasezerano mwagiranye, bikomeze nk’uko byahoze mbere.»
Abagize inama nkuru babaha amabaruwa yo gushyikiriza abategetsi ba buri gihugu, kugira ngo babaherekeze bazagere amahoro mu gihugu cya Yuda.
Dore amagambo y’ibaruwa Yonatani yandikiye Abanyasiparita:
«Jyewe Yonatani, umuherezabitambo mukuru, hamwe n’inama nkuru y’igihugu, abaherezabitambo n’abasigaye b’umuryango w’Abayahudi, ku bavandimwe babo b’Abanyasiparita. Ndabaramutsa!
Mu bihe byo hambere, Areyasi umwami wanyu, yigeze koherereza Oniya, umuherezabitambo mukuru, ibaruwa ihamya ko muri abavandimwe bacu, nk’uko iyi nyandiko ibagejejweho ibyemeza.
Oniya yakiranye icyubahiro uwari watumwe, yakira n’ibaruwa yasabaga ku mugaragaro kugirana amasezerano n’ubucuti.
Ku bwacu n’ubwo tutabikeneye bwose — kuko dufite ibitabo bitagatifu biduhumuriza —
twiyemeje kohereza umuntu wo kuvugurura ubuvandimwe n’ubucuti buduhuje kugira ngo twoye kubana nk’abanyamahanga, kuko hari hashize imyaka myinshi kuva aho mutwoherereje ubutumwa.
Naho ubundi, twebwe ntiduhwema kubibuka buri gihe mu minsi mikuru no mu yindi minsi y’ibyishimo, mu bitambo dutura no mu masengesho, mbese nk’uko bikwiye kandi bitunganye kwibuka abavandimwe.
Twishimiye ikuzo ryanyu!
Naho twebwe, amakuba n’intambara byaratwugarije, n’abami duturanye baraturwanya.
Twirinze kubarushya, mwebwe n’abandi twunze ubumwe n’incuti zacu tubahuruza muri izo ntambara,
kuko udutabara aturuka mu ijuru, akadukiza. Koko kandi, yatugobotoye mu nzara z’abanzi bacu, maze bakorwa n’ikimwaro.
Nuko rero, twahisemo Numeniyo mwene Antiyokusi, na Antipateri mwene Yasoni, tubatuma ku Banyaroma ngo bavugurure ubucuti n’amasezerano byari bitwunze na bo kuva hambere.
Twabategetse rero kunyura iwanyu ngo babaramutse kandi babashyikirize n’ibaruwa yacu, yo kuvugurura ubuvandimwe bwacu.
Muzaba rero mugize neza, muramutse mudushubije icyo mutekereza kuri ibyo.»
Dore amagambo y’ibaruwa yohererejwe Oniya:
«Jyewe Areyasi, umwami w’Abanyasiparita, kuri Oniya, umuherezabitambo mukuru. Ndakuramutsa!
Hari inyandiko twasanzemo ibyerekeye ubuvandimwe bw’Abanyasiparita n’Abayahudi, kandi ko bose bakomoka kuri Abrahamu.
None rero ubwo tumaze kubimenya, byaba byiza mutwandikiye mukatumenyesha amakuru yanyu.
Natwe tubandikiye tubamenyesha ko amatungo yanyu n’ibyanyu byose ari ibyacu, n’ibyacu bikaba ibyanyu. Bityo rero, dutegetse ko baza kubamenyesha ibyo ngibyo.»
heading: Yonatani muri Kelesiriya; Simoni mu Bufilisiti

text: Bukeye, Yonatani amenya ko abagaba b’ingabo ba Demetiriyo bagarutse n’igitero kiruta ubwinshi icya mbere ngo bamurwanye.
Ahera ko ahaguruka i Yeruzalemu, ajya kubasanganirira mu gihugu cya Hamati, ntiyareka binjira mu gihugu cye.
Yohereza intasi mu ngando yabo; zigaruka zimumenyesha ko biteguye kugwa gitumo Abayahudi iryo joro.
Izuba rimaze kurenga Yonatani ategeka abantu be kuba maso, bacigatiye intwaro mu ntoki kugira ngo bitegure kurwana ijoro ryose, ashyira abarinzi ku mpande zose z’ingando.
Abanzi ngo bamenye ko Yonatani n’abantu be biteguye intambara, batahwa n’ubwoba kandi bakuka umutima, basiga bacanye amakome y’umuriro mu ngando, maze barihungira.
Yonatani n’ingabo ze babimenya mu gitondo ko bagiye, kuko bari bakomeje kubona umuriro waka.
Yonatani ni ko kubakurikirana ariko ntiyabashyikira, kuko bari bambutse uruzi rwa Elewuteri.
Nuko Yonatani ahindukirana Abarabu bitwa Abazabadeyani, arabatsinda maze arabacuza,
hanyuma ahagurutsa ingando ajya i Damasi, azenguruka iyo ntara yose.
Naho Simoni akomeza kugenda, agera i Ashikeloni no mu migi ihakikije, ahindukirana Yope, arayigarurira.
Yari yarumvise ko abaturage bashakaga kwegurira uwo mugi ingabo za Demetiriyo; ahashyira umutwe w’ingabo zo kuharinda.
heading: Yonatani yubaka Yeruzalemu

text: Yonatani ahindukiye akoranya abakuru b’umuryango, bemeza ko hagomba kubakwa ibigo bikomeye muri Yudeya,

gusana inkike za Yeruzalemu bakazigira ndende no kubaka urukuta rutandukanya Ikigo n’umugi, kugira ngo Ikigo kibe ahiherereye kandi ngo abo bantu badashobora kugira icyo bahagura cyangwa bahagurishiriza.
Nuko barakorana kugira ngo bongere bubake umugi, kuko igice cy’inkike iherereye ku mugezi wo mu burasirazuba cyari cyaratembye; bubaka kandi bundi bushya agace k’umugi kitwa Kafenata.
Simoni na we yongera kubaka Adida yo mu karere k’imirambi, arayikomeza ndetse n’amarembo yayo ayashyiraho inzugi zihindizwa ibyuma.
heading: Yonatani agwa mu maboko y’abanzi

text: Tirifoni yifuzaga gutegeka Aziya, kwambara ikamba no kwica umwami Antiyokusi.
Nyamara atinya ko Yonatani azamutambamira cyangwa akamurwanya, ni ko gushakisha uburyo bwose yamufata, akamwica. Nuko arahaguruka ajya i Betishani.
Yonatani amusanganiza igitero cy’ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ine z’ingenzi ku rugamba, maze aza i Betishani.
Tirifoni abonye ko yazanye igitero kinini, yirinda kugira icyo amutwara.
Ahubwo amwakirana icyubahiro, amushingana ku ncuti ze zose, amuha amaturo kandi ategeka incuti ze n’ingabo ze kumwubaha nka we ubwe.
Abwira Yonatani ati «Ni kuki wagombye kunaniza aba bantu bose, kandi nta ntambara dufitanye?

Ngaho bohereze mu ngo zabo, utoranyemo gusa bamwe bo kuguherekeza, hanyuma tujyane i Putolemayida. Nzakwegurira uriya mugi kimwe n’ibindi bigo bikomeye, nkongerere ingabo, nguhe n’abagaba bazo bose, hanyuma mfate inzira ntahuke, kuko ari ibyo byanzanye hano.»
Nuko Yonatani aramwizera, akora uko yamubwiye: ingabo ze arazohereza zisubira mu gihugu cya Yudeya,
asigarana abantu ibihumbi bitatu, ibihumbi bibiri muri bo abohereza muri Galileya, abandi ibihumbi bajyana na we.
Igihe Yonatani amaze kwinjira i Putolemayida, abaturage b’uwo mugi bamufungiraho amarembo, baramufata, we n’abantu be bose binjiranye, babamarira ku bugi bw’inkota.
Tirifoni yohereza ingabo n’abanyamafarasi muri Galileya no mu kibaya kinini, kugira ngo batsembe abantu bose ba Yonatani.
Ubwo na bo bababonye, bamenyeraho ko yafashwe akaba yanapfuye kimwe n’abari kumwe na we; ni ko guterana inkunga maze bibumbira hamwe bajya ku rugamba.
Abari babakurikiranye ngo babone ko bihagazeho, bisubirirayo.
Naho abandi batahuka bose amahoro mu gihugu cya Yudeya, baririra Yonatani na bagenzi be, bagira ubwoba bwinshi kandi Israheli yose ijya mu cyunamo.

Amahanga yose abakikije na yo ashaka kubatsemba, bagira bati «Nta mutware bagifite, nta n’ubatera inkunga; nimucyo tubatere, maze dusibanganye urwibutso rwabo mu bantu.»Currently Selected:Icya mbere cy'Abamakabe 12: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices?
