Roho z’intungane ziri mu biganza by’Imana,kandi nta n’igitotezo kizongera kubageraho.
heading: Amaherezo y’intungane anyuranye n’ay’abagome

text: Mu maso y’ibipfamutima bameze nk’abapfuye burundu,barigendeye basa nk’aho bagushije ishyano,
bagiye kure byitwa ko barimbutse,nyamara bo bibereye mu mahoro.
Ndetse n’ubwo mu maso y’abantu basa n’abahanwe,bahorana amizero yo kutazapfa.
Nibamara guhanishwa ibihano byoroheje,bazahabwa ingororano zitagereranywa.Imana yarabagerageje isanga bakwiye kuba abayo;
yarabasukuye nka zahabu mu ruganda,ibakira nk’igitambo kitagira inenge.
Igihe Imana izabagenderera, ni bwo bazabengerana,barabagirane nk’ibishashi by’umuriro mu bikenyeri byumye.
Bazacira amahanga imanza kandi bategeke ibihugu,maze Nyagasani ababere umwami iteka ryose.
Abamwiringiye bazamenya ukuri icyo ari cyo,abamuyobotse bazibanire na we mu rukundo,kuko asesekaza ubuntu n’imbabazi ku ntungane ze,ntanareke gusura abo yitoreye.
Ariko abagome bazahanishwa igihano gikwiranye n’ibitekerezo byabo,kuko bahinyuye umuntu w’intungane kandi bakitarura Nyagasani.
Koko rero, baragowe abasuzugura ubuhanga n’inyigisho zabwo;amizero yabo nta cyo ashingiyeho,imiruho yabo nta cyo imaze,ibyo bakora bararuhira ubusa;
abagore babo ni ibipfamutima,abana babo ni abagome,urubyaro rwabo ni ibivume!
heading: Ikiruta ni ukwibera ingumba aho kubyara abagome

text: Hahirwa umugore w’ingumba utarigeze agira amakemwa,kandi ntabonane n’umugabo bakorana icyaha,kuko azaronka umugisha igihe imitima yose izasuzumwa.
Arahirwa nanone umukone utigeze gukora ikibi,kandi ntatekereze ibinyuranyije n’ugushaka kw’Imana,kuko aziturwa ineza y’ubwo budahemuka bwe,agahabwa umwanya ushimishije mu Ngoro ya Nyagasani.
Koko rero, imbuto y’ibikorwa byiza isendereye ikuzo,n’umuzi w’ubwenge ntushobora kumungwa.
Ariko abana bavutse mu busambanyi bazakenyuka,urubyaro rukomoka ku mibanire itemewe, ruzarimbuka.
Kabone n’ubwo baramba igihe kirekire, ntibazitabwaho,ndetse no mu busaza bwabo, ntibazubahwa.
Nibakenyuka nta cyizere bazapfana,ntibazanahozwa ku munsi w’urubanza,
kuko ububabare ari yo maherezo y’inyoko y’abagome.Currently Selected:Ubuhanga 3: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ikiruta ni ukutagira abana ukagira umugenzo mwiza,kuko bazajya bakwibuka ubuziraherezo,ubikesha ko ushimwa n’Imana ndetse n’abantu.
Uwo mugenzo mwiza, iyo uriho barawukurikiza, wabura bakawifuza,uraganje mu bugingo bw’iteka, utamirije ikamba,kuko utsinze intambara itagira ikinegu.
Ariko abana benshi b’abagome bazaba imburakamaro,urubyaro rukomoka ku binyendaro nta ho rushingiye,kandi ntiruzahamya imizi ngo rukomere.
Ndetse n’iyo rwagera igihe rugaba amashami,ruzagushwa n’umuyaga kuko ruzaba rudakomeye,maze rurimburwe n’inkubi yawo.
Amashami yarwo azavunika akiri mato,imbuto zarwo zizahunguke zidahishije, maze zipfe ubusa,
kuko abana bavukiye mu busambanyibazagaragaza ububi bw’ababyeyi babo igihe cy’urubanza.
heading: Ugukenyuka kw’intungane

text: Nyamara intungane, n’ubwo yapfa ikenyutse, izanezerwa,
kuko ubukambwe bushimwa atari ugusaza cyane,ntibunagereranywe n’ubwinshi bw’imyaka;
ubuhanga ntiburindira ko imvi zimera,ubuzima buzira amakemwa ni bwo bukambwe bukwiye.
Intungane yanogeye Imana maze irakundwa,ariko yimurirwa ahandi kuko yabanaga n’abanyabyaha.
Yabavanywemo kugira ngo ikibi kitayiyobya ibitekerezo,cyangwa kikaba cyagusha umutima wayo.
Ni koko, uburindagize bw’ikibi buzimangatanya icyiza,n’inkubiri y’irari ikayobya umutima uzira uburyarya.
Uwageze ku butungane mu gihe gitoaba ashyitse ku busendere bw’imyaka myinshi.
Umutima we wanyuze Nyagasani,ari na cyo cyatumye asohoka bwangu mu ndiri y’abagome.Abantu barabibonye ariko ntibabyumva;ntibacengera mu mitima yabo ngo bazirikane
ko ineza n’imbabazi bihabwa abatowe,kandi ko Nyagasani agirira impuhwe abatagatifu be.
Urupfu rw’intungane rucira abagome urubanza,umuto ukenyutse akarucira umukambwe warambye mu bugiranabi.
Bazabona rero urupfu rw’umunyabuhanga,ariko ntibazamenya icyo Nyagasani amushakahon’impamvu itumye amuvana aho.
Bazitegereza maze babihinyure,ariko Nyagasani azabaseka.

Nyuma bo bazahinduka intumbi zigayitse,bazahore basuzuguritse ndetse no mu bapfuye.Koko Nyagasani azababirindura babanze umutwe hasi,kandi ntibazarevura n’ijambo na rimwe;azabahubanganya kugera mu mizi, barimbuke bitavugwa,ububabare bubashengure, kandi nta n’uzongera kubibuka.
heading: Umukiro w’intungane n’urubanza rw’abagome

text: Igihe ibyaha byabo bizaba byagaragajwe,bazaza bahinda umushyitsi,ibicumuro byabo bibajye imbere kugira ngo bibashinje.Currently Selected:Ubuhanga 4: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ubwo intungane izahagarare nta cyo yishisha,imbere y’abayishikamiraga bagahinyura ibikorwa byayo.
Bakiyirabukwa bazatengurwa kubera ubwoba bwinshi,batangazwe no kubona yakijijwe nta wabikekaga.
Nuko babwirane bababaye, bafite ikiniga kandi baganya,
bati «Uyu ni we kera twahinyuraga tukamuhindura urw’amenyo!Twebwe b’ibipfamutima, imibereho ye twayitaga ubusazi,n’urupfu rwe tukarubonamo ishyano.
None se yaje ate kubarirwa mu bana b’Imana?Yasangiye ate umugabane n’abatagatifujwe?
Koko twarayobye, twitaza inzira y’ukuri,urumuri rw’ubutabera ntirwatumurikira, n’izuba ntiryaturasiraho.
Ntitwahwemye kunyura mu mayira y’akarengane n’ukurimbuka,twambukiranya ubutayu butagira icyerekezo,ariko ntitwamenya inzira ya Nyagasani!
None se ubwirasi bwacu bwatumariye iki?Ubukungu twiratanaga se bwo bwatwunguye iki?
Ibyo byose byayoyotse nk’igihu,bimera nk’impuha zihita zishira.
Byagiye nk’ubwato bwahuranya imivumba y’inyanja,ku buryo nta we ubona aho bunyuzecyangwa inzira y’indiba yabwo mu mazi.

Nanone bimeze nk’igisiga kiguruka mu kirere,aho kinyuze ntikihasiga ikirari cyacyo,gikubita umwuka woroshye gikoresheje amababa yacyokikawasa, kikawucamo inzira kizunguza amababa,hanyuma kigahita nta kimenyetso gisize inyuma.
Ni kimwe n’umwambi barashe,umwuka unyuzemo uhita usubirana,ku buryo nta we umenya aho unyuze.
Natwe nguko uko twazimiye tukivuka,ntitwagira umugenzo uranga aho tunyuze,ahubwo tworama mu ngeso mbi!»
Koko rero, icyizere cy’umugomeni nk’umurama utwarwa n’umuyaga,cyangwa nk’urufuro rukubiswe n’umuhengeri;kiyoyoka nk’umwotsi mu muyaga,kigahita nk’urwibutso rw’umushyitsi w’umunsi umwe.
heading: Ikuzwa ry’intungane n’ihanwa ry’abagome

text: Nyamara intungane zibaho iteka ryose,igihembo cyazo gituruka kuri Nyagasani,n’Umusumbabyose akazitaho.
Zizahabwa ikamba ribengerana ry’ubwami,zitamirize umutako utagira uko usa,byose bivuye mu kiganza cya Nyagasani,kuko azabarwanaho n’ikiganza cye cy’iburyo,ukuboko kwe kukabakingira nk’ingabo.
Azahagurukana ishyaka yakereye kuzihorera,ibiremwa abyambike intwaro zo guhashya umwanzi.
Azakenyera ubutabera nk’umwambaro w’intambara,urubanza rudasubirwaho rumubere nk’ingofero y’icyuma,
ingabo azikingira ni ubutungane bwe budatsimburwa,
uburakari bwe budacogora abutyaze nk’inkota,maze isi yose izaze gufatanya na we kurwanya ibipfamutima.
Imirabyo izagenda nk’imyambi iboneje neza,imere nk’irashishijwe umuheto ureze koko,izasohoke mu bicu igana intego.
Umuhumetso we uzarekurana uburakari urubura rukaze,amazi y’inyanja azabuzuraneho,n’inzuzi zibarenge hejuru nta mbabazi.

Inkubi y’umuyaga izabazibiranya maze ibagosore nka serwakira;bityo isi yose izayogozwe izira icyaha,n’ubugiranabi buhirike ingoma z’ibihangange.Currently Selected:Ubuhanga 5: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Bami rero, nimwumve maze musobanukirwe,nimujijukirwe, mwe abafite ububasha ku isi yose!
heading: II. UKO SALOMONI YAGEZE KU BUHANGA / Abami bagomba gushakashaka ubuhanga

text: Nimutege amatwi, mwebwe abategeka imbaga,maze mukiratana ubwinshi bw’ibihugu byanyu!
Ububasha mufite mubukesha Nyagasani,ubutegetsi mukabuhabwa n’Umusumbabyose,ari na we uzasuzuma ibikorwa byanyu,agasesengura imigambi yanyu.
Niba rero mwebwe, bagaragu b’uwo Mwami,mutaraciye imanza mu butabera,ntimukurikize amategeko kandi ntimurangize icyo Imana ishaka,
izabagwa gitumo ku buryo buteye ubwoba,kuko urubanza rukaze rugiye gucirwa abakomeye.
Uworoheje we, agirirwa impuhwe kandi akababarirwa,ariko abanyabubasha bo bazasuzumwa bikomeye.
Umutegetsi wa bose ntatinya igihagararo cy’umuntu,nta n’ubwo yita ku bukuru bwe,kuko uworoheje kimwe n’ukomeye ari we wabaremye,n’icyo yabageneye kikaba kimwe kuri bose;
nyamara abanyabubasha bo, igenzurwa rikomeye rirabategereje.
Ni mwebwe rero, bategetsi, mbwira,kugira ngo mbigishe ubuhanga maze mureke kuyoba.
Abazaba bitondeye gukurikiza amategeko matagatifubizabaha kubarirwa mu ntungane,n’abazaba barayasobanukiwe, ababere ikiramiro.
Nuko rero, nimugirire inyota amagambo yanjye,muyifuze mubishyizeho umwete, bityo muzasobanukirwe.
heading: Ubuhanga bwigaragariza ubushaka wese

text: Ubuhanga burabengerana kandi ntibujya bucuyuka;bwigaragariza ababukunda bakabwitegereza,n’ababushakashaka bakabubona.
Bwihishurira ababwifuza,bugafata iya mbere mu kubiyereka.
Uzindutse abugana ntananirwa,abusanga bwicaye imbere y’umuryango.
Kubuzirikana byungura ubushishozi,n’uraye ijoro abushaka ntaba acyongeye guhagarika umutima,
kuko ari bwo bukwira hose bwishakira ababukwiriye,bukabakirana urugwiro aho bubasanze mu mayira,kandi bugasabana na bo mu bitekerezo byabo.
Intangiriro yo kumenya Ubuhanga,ni ukugira icyifuzo cyo kujijurwa na bwo,no kubukunda ni byo gusobanukirwa.
Kubukunda ni ugukurikiza amategeko yabwo,kuyakurikiza bigatanga icyemezo cy’ubudashanguka,
kandi ubwo budashanguka bukageza bugufi y’Imana.
Bityo rero, kugira inyota y’Ubuhanga bigeza ku bwami.
Niba rero, mwebwe bategetsi b’igihugu,mwishimira intebe n’inkoni bya cyami,nimukunde Ubuhanga kugira ngo muganze iteka ryose.
heading: Salomoni asobanura Ubuhanga icyo ari cyo

text: Ariko se Ubuhanga ni iki? Bwaba se bukomoka he?Ngiye kububamenyesha nta na kimwe mbakinze:ndabubabwira mpereye ku nkomoko yabwo,nshyire ahagaragara uko buteye,sinzigera na rimwe nteshuka ku kuri,
cyangwa ngo mbigirane ishyari rikabije,kuko ryo ritagira aho rihurira n’Ubuhanga.
Nyamara ubwinshi bw’abahanga buronkera isi umukiro,n’umwami ushishoza agatuma rubanda rumererwa neza.
Namwe rero, nimureke mbigishe bizabagirira akamaro.Currently Selected:Ubuhanga 6: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Nanjye ubwanjye ndi umuntu uzapfa nk’abandi,nkomoka ku muntu wa mbere wabumbwe mu gitaka.Umubiri wanjye wabumbabumbiwe mu nda y’umubyeyi,
heading: Salomoni yari umuntu nk’abandi

text: mu mezi cumi yose natangiriye kubaho mu maraso ye,bivuye ku mbuto y’umugabo no ku byishimo byo mu kiryamo.
Nanjye nkivuka, nahumetse umwuka twese dusangiye,maze ngwa ku isi itwakira kimwe twese,urusaku rwanjye rwa mbere ruba amarira, nk’ay’abandi bose,
ndererwa ku byahi, mu mpungenge nyinshi.
Nta mwami n’umwe wigeze atangira kubaho bitari nk’uko:
uburyo ni bumwe gusa kuri bosebwo gutangira no kurangiza ubuzima.
heading: Salomoni akunda Ubuhanga

text: Ni yo mpamvu nasabye ubushishozi, ndabuhabwa;ndambaza maze umwuka w’Ubuhanga unzamo.
Ni bwo nahisemo mbugurana inkoni n’intebe bya cyami,nsanga ubukungu nta cyo bumaze, ubugereranyije n’Ubuhanga.
Siniruhije mbugereranya n’ibuye ry’agaciro,kuko zahabu y’isi yose ari nk’umusenyi ungana urwara,naho feza ikaba nk’icyondo, uyigereranyije na bwo.
Nabukunze kuruta ubuzima n’ubwiza bw’umubiri,kandi nabuhisemo bundutira urumuri,kuko icyezezi cyabwo kitagabanuka.
Ariko kubana na bwo byanzaniye ibyiza byose icyarimwe,bwari bucigatiye mu biganza ubukungu butagira ingano.
Nishimiye ibyo byiza byose maze kumenya ko bigengwa n’Ubuhanga,nyamara sinari nzi ko ari bwo bikomokaho.
Icyo namenye nta kosa kiranganwa,nzakimenyesha abandi nta cyo mbakinze,nta n’icyo ngabanyije ku bukungu bwacyo,
kuko bubereye abantu ubukungu budashira.Ababwitabiriye bagiranye ubucuti n’Imana,barayinogera babikesha ibyiza bivuye ku bujijuke.
heading: Imana ni yo soko y’icyitwa ubumenyi cyose

text: Icyampa ngo Imana impe kuvugana ubwenge,no kwigiramo ibitekerezo bikwiranye n’ingabire nahawe,kuko ari yo iyobora Ubuhanga, ikanabwiriza ababukurikirana.
Natwe ubwacu turi mu maboko yayo kimwe n’ibyo tuvuga,ndetse n’icyitwa ubwenge n’ubushobozi cyose.
Nguko uko yampaye ubumenyi nyakuri bw’ibiriho,inyigisha gusobanukirwa n’imiterere y’isi n’imibereho y’ibiyigize;
impa kumenya intangiriro n’iherezo by’ibihe, ndetse n’aya magingo,menya n’imigendere y’izuba n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe;
imikurikiranire y’iminsi y’umwakan’umwanya w’ibinyarumuri byo mu kirere,
kamere y’inyamaswa n’imyifatire y’ibikoko by’ishyamba,imikorere y’ibinyabubasha n’ibitekerezo by’abantu,amoko y’ibihingwa n’akamaro k’imizi yabyo . .
Ibyihishe n’ibiboneka byose, narabimenye,kuko nigishijwe n’Ubuhanga bwahanze ibintu byose.
heading: Igisingizo cy’ubuhanga

text: Koko rero, Ubuhanga bubamo umwuka w’ubwenge kandi mutagatifu,umwe rukumbi, ubumbatira byose, ugacengera byose,ugira ubwibakure, wihariye, ukazira ikizinga,ubengerana, udahindagurika, ukunda icyiza, ukagira ubwira,
utavogerwa, ukagira neza kandi ukaba incuti ya muntu,utajegajega, ukiringirwa kandi ugatuza,ushobora byose, ukagenzura byose,ucengera roho zose, ari iz’inyabwenge,iz’inzirabwandure n’iz’abahanga.
Ubuhanga kandi buratebuka kurusha ibyihuta byose,bukinjira kandi bugacengera byose bubikesha kuzira ubwandure,
bukaba impumuro y’ububasha bw’Imana,n’ububengerane bw’imirase y’ikuzo ry’Umushoborabyose,ni na yo mpamvu butinjirwamo n’ubwandure ubwo ari bwo bwose.
Ubuhanga ni icyezezi cy’urumuri ruhoraho,indorerwamo izira ikizinga y’ibikorwa by’Imana,bukaba n’ishusho y’ubuntu bwayo.
N’ubwo ari bumwe rukumbi, bushobora byose,bukavugurura isi kubera ko budahinduka,maze uko ibihe bisimburana bugatura mu mitima y’intungane,kugira ngo bubahindure incuti z’Imana n’abahanuzi,
kuko Imana yikundira gusa ababana n’Ubuhanga.
Koko rero, burusha izuba kwakirana, bugasumbya inyenyeri;ubugereranyije n’urumuri, burarusumba kure:

urumuri rusimburwa n’umwijima,ariko ikibi ntikiganza Ubuhanga.Currently Selected:Ubuhanga 7: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Bwisanzurana imbaraga kuva ku mpera y’isi kugera ku yindi,maze bukayitegekana urugwiro.
heading: Ubuhanga bwabereye Salomoni umugore usumba bose

text: Narabukunze, ndabushakashaka kuva nkiri muto,narabushatse ngo bumbere umugore,maze mbukundira uburanga bwabwo.
Ikuzo ryabwo rigaragara hose, kuko bubana n’Imana,bukaba bwarakunzwe n’Umutegetsi w’ibyaremwe byose.
Koko rero, bwatojwe ubumenyi bw’Imana,ni bwo buyihitiramo ibyo ikora.
Niba ubukungu ari icyiza cyifuzwa mu buzima,ni iki cyasumbya Ubuhanga gukungahara,kandi ari bwo nkomoko ya byose?
Niba ubwenge bwacu bushobora kugira icyo bukora,Ubuhanga bwahanze ibiriho se ntiburushijeho?

Harya ngo ubutabera burakundwa?Nyamara na bwo, kimwe n’indi migenzo myiza,ni imbuto z’ubuhanga,kuko bwigisha ubwizige n’ubwitonzi, ubutabera n’ubutwari,n’ikindi cyose cyagirira abantu akamaro mu buzima.

Hazabe se abifuza kumenya ibintu n’ibindi?Ubuhanga bumenya ibyahise, bugahanura ibizaza;buzi kugenurira mu migani no gusobanura inshoberamahanga,bucengera ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza,bukamenya amateka n’uko ibihe bikurikirana.
heading: Ubuhanga ni ngombwa

text: Niyemeje rero kubwisunga mu buzima bwanjye,nzi neza ko buzambera umujyanama nyakuri,bukantera inkunga mu mubabaro n’ishavu.
Nizera ko buzampesha ikuzo muri rubanda,kandi n’ubwo nkiri muto, nzagira ishema imbere y’abakambwe.
Bazambonamo ubushishozi mu guca imanza zitabera,maze abatware bazantangarire.
Ninceceka bazantegereza, nimvuga bantege amatwi;nintinda mu magambo, bazifata ku munwa batangare.
Nzabukesha kutibagirana bibaho,maze ab’igihe kizaza mbasigire urwibutso ruhoraho.
Nzategeka ibihugu maze amahanga anyoboke,
izina ryanjye rizamamara rikangaranye abategetsi bakomeye;nzagirira neza imbaga kandi mbe n’intwari ku rugamba.
Nintabaruka nzaruhukira iruhande rw’Ubuhanga,kuko gushyikirana na bwo bitagwa nabi;kubana na bwo ntibitera ishavu,ahubwo bitanga umunezero n’ibyishimo.
heading: Salomoni yiyemeza gusaba Ubuhanga

text: Maze kubitekereza neza no kubyiyumvisha mu mutima,nsanze gushyikirana n’Ubuhanga birinda urupfu;

urukundo rwabwo rugatanga umunezero uhamye.Mu bikorwa byabwo harimo ubukungu budashira,ubanye na bwo aronka ubushishozi,naho uwamamaje amagambo yabwo, akaba ikirangirire.Ni yo mpamvu nakoze hirya no hinonshaka ukuntu bwambera umugore.
Koko nari umwana umeze neza,kandi narahawe n’umutima mwiza;
uretse n’ibyo kandi, navukanye umubiri utanduye.

Nyamara nari nzi ko nta wabona ubuhanga, atabugabiwe n’Imana,kandi no kumenya uwo iyo neza iturukaho,na byo byari intangiriro y’ubushishozi;nuko mpindukirira Nyagasani,maze nsenga n’umutima wanjye wose, ngira ntiCurrently Selected:Ubuhanga 8: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
«Mana y’abasokuruza, kandi Nyagasani Nyir’imbabazi,wowe waremye ibintu byose ku bw’ijambo ryawe,
heading: Isengesho risaba Ubuhanga

text: ukarema umuntu ukoresheje Ubuhanga bwawe,kugira ngo ategeke ibiremwa wihangiye,
agenge isi mu busabaniramana no mu butabera,kandi ngo ace imanza abigiranye umutima utunganye,
mpa kugira uruhare ku Buhanga musangiye intebe,kandi ntunce mu bana bawe.
Ndi umugaragu wawe n’umuhungu w’umuja wawe,umunyantege nke, nkagira n’ubuzima butaramba,simbashe kumva neza ubutabera n’amategeko.
Koko rero, muri bene muntu intungane yaba nde?Udafite Ubuhanga buguturukaho, nta cyo aba ari cyo.
Ni wowe wanyitoreye, ungira umwami w’umuryango wawe,umucamanza w’abahungu n’abakobwa bawe.
Wantegetse kubaka Ingoro ku musozi wawe mutagatifu,n’urutambiro mu mugi washinzemo ihema ryawe;ugira ngo bijye bitwibutsa rya Hema ritagatifu,witeguriye kuva kera na kare.
Ubuhanga murabana bukamenya ibyo ukora,mwari kumwe igihe waremaga isi;buzi ikigushimisha n’igitunganiye amategeko yawe.
Butegeke buve mu ijuru ritagatifu,aho utetse ku ntebe y’ikuzo ryawe, ubwohereze,kugira ngo buntere inkunga maze menye ikigushimisha,
kuko bwo buzi kandi bugasobanukirwa na byose.Buzanyoborana ubwitonzi mu myifatire yanjye,kandi ikuzo ryabwo rinshyigikire.
Bityo ibikorwa byanjye bizashimwa,umuryango wawe nywucire imanza zitabera,kandi nzabe nkwiriye guteka ku ntebe ya data.
Ni nde muntu washobora kumenya imigambi y’Imana?Ni nde washobora gusobanukirwa n’icyo Nyagasani ashaka?
Ibitekerezo byacu, abantu, ntibifashe,bihora bihindagurika, ntibigira ishingiro.
Umubiri ushanguka uremerera roho,iryo hema ry’ibumba rikabangamira umutima uhorana inkeke.
Turushywa no kumenya ibiri ku isi,ndetse n’ibyo dushoboye tubigeraho bituruhije,ariko se ni nde wigeze atahura ibiri mu ijuru?
Ni nde kandi wajyaga kumenya ubushake bwawe,iyo wowe ubwawe udatanga Ubuhanga,n’aho uri mu ijuru ngo wohereze Umwuka wawe mutagatifu?

Nguko uko ibitekerezo by’abatuye isi byagorowe,abantu batozwa kumenya ibigushimisha,Ubuhanga bubakiza butyo.»Currently Selected:Ubuhanga 9: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ni bwo bwakomeje umuntu wabumbwe mbere,umubyeyi w’isi wari waremwe wenyine;hanyuma bumugobotora mu cyaha yigushijemo,
heading: III. AKAMARO K’UBUHANGA MU MATEKA Y’ABANTU / Kuva kuri Adamu kugera kuri Musa

text: maze bumuha ubushobozi bwo kugenga ibyaremwe.
Nyamara, wa muhemu witandukanije na bwo kubera uburakari bwe,yararimbutse, azize ko yishe umuvandimwe we.
Igihe isi irengewe n’umwuzure kubera we,Ubuhanga ni bwo bwongeye kuyikiza,buyobora intungane mu bwato bw’igiti ubu busanzwe.

Igihe amahanga yose yoramye mu bukozi bw’ibibiagatandukanywa no kutavuga rumwe,Ubuhanga ni bwo bwarobanuye intungane,buyigira indakemwa imbere y’Imana,buyiha imbaraga zirenze urukundoumubyeyi yari afitiye umwana we.
Ndetse n’igihe abagome barimbutse,ni bwo bwagobotoye intungane yahungaga umurirowamanukiraga ku migi itanu.
Ingaruka z’ubwo bugome zatumye iyo ntaraikomeza kumagara no gucumbeka,imbuto z’ibiti ntizigera zihisha;hahinguka igishyinga cy’umunyucyabaye urwibutso rw’umutima utemera.
Abahinyuye Ubuhanga, usibye ko batashoboye kumenya ikiri cyiza,banasigiye inkomoko yabo urwibutso rw’ubusazi bwabo,ku buryo batashoboye no guhishira amafuti yabo.
Ariko Ubuhanga bwagobotoye abagaragu babwo mu magorwa yabo.

Umuntu w’intungane wahungaga uburakari bw’umuvandimwe we,bumuyobora butyo mu nzira zitunganye,bumwereka ubwami bw’Imana, bunamuha kumenya ibintu bitagatifu,butuma ajya mbere n’ubwo yari mu miruho,kandi imirimo ye bukayiha kurumbuka.
Bwamukomeyeho igihe cy’umururumba w’abamushikamiraga,kandi bumugira umukungu,
bumukiza abanzi bunamurinda abamushandikiraga imitego,bumurwanirira intambara ikomeye kugira ngo amenyeko ubusabaniramana busumbya byose ububasha.
Ntibwatereranye intungane yagurishijwe,ahubwo bwayirinze kugwa mu cyaha.
Bwamanukanye na yo mu rwobo,ntibwayirekera ku ngoyi mbere y’uko buyihainkoni ya cyami n’ubutegetsi ku bayicishaga agahato;butsinda butyo ibinyoma by’abayibeshyeraga,maze buyiha ikuzo rihoraho iteka.
heading: Iyimukamisiri

text: Ni bwo bwavanye umuryango mutagatifun’ubwoko butagira amakemwa, mu gihugu cyabicishaga agahato.
Bwinjira mu mutima w’umugaragu wa Nyagasani,ahangana n’abami b’abanyamaboko,abikoresheje ibitangaza n’ibimenyetso.
Intungane bwazihaye igihembo cy’imiruho yazo,buziyobora mu nzira y’agatangaza,buzibera ubwikingo ku manywa,n’urumuri rw’inyenyeri mu ijoro.
Bwabambukije Inyanja y’umutuku,maze bubanyuza mu mazi magari,
ariko abanzi babo buraboreka,maze bubazikuza umuvumba w’ikuzimu.
Bityo intungane zicuza abo bagome ibyabo,bahanikira icyarimwe basingiza izina ryawe ritagatifu, Nyagasani,barata ububasha bwawe bwabakijije;

koko rero, ubuhanga bubumbura umunwa w’ikiragi,bukumvikanisha imvugo y’ibitambambuga.Currently Selected:Ubuhanga 10: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Bwatumye bagera ku migambi yabo,babikesheje umuhanuzi mutagatifu;
bambukiranya ubutayu budatuwe,maze bashinga amahema yabo ahantu hatigeze hagendwa;
bahangana n’abanzi babo kandi bahashya ababarwanyaga.
heading: Igitangaza cy’amazi: Urupfu rw’Abanyamisiri n’agakiza k’Abayisraheli

text: Bagize inyota maze baragutakambira;urutare ruhanamye rubaha amazi,ibuye rikomeye ribamara inyota;
nuko ibyo abanzi babo bahanishijwe,biba ari byo bibagoboka bageze ahaga.
Igihano cy’Abanyamisiri bari biyemeje kubicira abana,cyabaye uruzi rwahindutse amaraso avanzemo icyondo.
Ariko abawe, wabahaye amazi menshi,mu gihe batari bayiteze na gato,
umaze kubicisha inyotango bumve ukuntu wahannye abanzi babo.
Koko rero, bahereye kuri uko kugeragezwa kwabo,kwari kugamije kubakosorana impuhwe,bumvise ukuntu abagome bapfuye urw’agashinyaguro,bamaze gucirwa urubanza rukaze.
Abawe wabagerageje nk’umubyeyi ubaburira,naho abo bagome ubahana wihanukiriye, nk’umwami uciye iteka.
Baba hafi cyangwa kure, bababaye kimwe,
bagira agahinda k’ingerekerane,kavanze n’amaganya yo kwibuka ibyababayeho,
kuko bamenye ko igihano bo bahanishijwe,abandi cyabaviriyemo amahirwe,bumva batyo ko ari inkunga ya Nyagasani.
Nuko uwo kera bari baranitse ku gahinga,hanyuma bakamwirukana bamuha urw’amenyo,ni we wabakangaranyije ibihe bimaze kugera,kuko bari baragize inyotairuse kure iyo intungane zagize.
heading: Imana yorohera Abanyamisiri

text: Kubera ibitekerezo byabo bifutamye bikururwa n’ubugome bwabo,byabayobeje kugeza aho bashengerera inyamaswazikurura ku butaka zitanagira ubwenge,n’ibindi bikoko biteye ishozi,wabahanishije kubateza inyamaswa nyinshi zitagira ubwenge,
kugira ngo bamenye ko urwishigishiye arusoma.
Nyamara ikiganza cyawe cy’impangare nticyahindagana,cyo cyaremye isi kiyikuye mu busa,mu kubateza ibirura bitabarika n’intare z’inkazi,
cyangwa ibikoko bitazwi byuzuye uburakaribyaremewe kuzuza uwo mugambi,bishobora kurekura umwuka utwika ukanuka nabi,cyangwa amaso yabyo agatera ibishashi bikaze.
Usibye rero ko izo nyamaswa zashoboraga kubica nabi,hari n’abicwaga n’ubwoba, bakibona uko ziteye.

Uretse n’ibyo, bari no guhirikwa n’akayaga gahuhera,bitewe n’ubutabera bwawe bwabakurikiranaga,cyangwa bagatatanywa n’umwuka w’ububasha bwawe.Ariko byose wabigennye ku rugero, ku mubare, no ku gipimo.
heading: Icyateye Imana kuborohera

text: Ububasha bwawe butagereranywa buhora bukugaragiye;ni nde rero uzahangana n’imbaraga z’ukuboko kwawe?
Koko, isi yose iri imbere yawe,nk’agakungugu katahungabanya umunzanicyangwa nk’agatonyanga k’urume kaguye ku butaka.
Nyamara ugirira bose impuhwe kuko ushobora byose,ukirengagiza ibyaha by’abantu kugira ngo babone kwisubiraho.
Ukunda ibiremwa byose kandi nta na kimwe uhigika mu byo waremye,kuko iyo ugira icyo wanga muri byo, utari kwirirwa ukirema.
None se ni ikihe kiremwa cyari kubaho utabishatse?Cyangwa se n’ikihe cyari kurokoka utakibeshejeho?

Utuma byose birokoka kuko ari ibyawe, wowe Mugenga w’ubugingo,Currently Selected:Ubuhanga 11: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
kandi n’umwuka wawe uzira gushanguka, uri mu biremwa byose.
Bityo ugenda buhoro buhoro uramira abaguye,ukababurira, ubibutsa ibibatera gucumura,kugira ngo bigobotore ikibi maze bakwemere, Nyagasani.
heading: Imana yorohera Abakanahani

text: Koko rero, abari batuye kera igihugu gitagatifu,
wageze aho ubanga ubitewe n’amarorerwa yabo, n’imigenzo mibi,ari yo bupfumu n’imihango yabwo.
Abo baburampuhwe bica abana babo,bagahuzwa no kurya inyama z’abantu,kugeza ku maraso n’amara,basigaye barahindutse imandwa z’ibisahiranda.
Abo babyeyi bica ibibondo bidashoboye kwirengera,washatse kubatsembesha ikiganza cy’abasekuruza bacu,
kugira ngo ubu butaka bukurutira ubundi bwose,bube koko ubukonde bukwiriye abana b’Imana.
Ariko abo na bo, kuko bari abantu,warabihanganiye ubanza kuboherereza imiyugiri,ngo ibabwire ko igitero cyawe kije,ari ukugira ngo ibarimbure buhoro buhoro.
Nyamara abo bagome,washoboraga kubateza urugamba rw’intungane,cyangwa ukabarimbuza icyarimwe inyamaswa z’inkazi,cyangwa se ijambo ryawe ridasubirwaho.
Ariko muri uko kubahana buhoro buhoro,wabahaga utyo uburyo bwo kwisubiraho.Nyamara ntiwari uyobewe ko kamere yabo yoramye,ubugome bwabo bakaba barabuvukanye,n’imico yabo ikaba idateze guhinduka,
kuko ari ubwoko bwavumwe kuva mu ntangiriro.Ibyo nanone ariko ntibyatewe n’uko hari uwo watinyaga,ngo ukurizeho kwihanganira ibicumuro byabo.
heading: Icyateye Imana kuborohera

text: Ni nde se watinyuka kukubaza ati «Wakoze ibiki?»Ni nde watambamira icyemezo cyawe?Ni nde se wakuregera ubucamanza,ngo ni uko warimbuye amahanga wiremeye?Ni nde wabasha guhinguka imbere yawe,ngo ararenganura abantu b’abagome?
Nta yindi mana uretse wowe, yakwita kuri bose,ngo ugombe kuyereka ko waciye imanza zitari zo.
Nta n’umwami cyangwa umutegetsi n’umwe,wabasha kuguhangara ngo ararengera abo wahannye.
Kuko uri intungane, ibyaremwe byose ubitegekana ubutabera;ugasanga guciraho iteka umuntu udakwiye guhanwa,biciye ukubiri n’ububasha bwawe.
Imbaraga zawe ni zo soko y’ubutabera bwawe,ubutegetsi ufite kuri byose bugatuma ubyitaho byose.
Ugaragaza imbaraga zawe, igihe bihaye kuzikerensa,ugacogoza ubwirasi bw’abemera ubwo bubasha bwawe.
Ariko kuko ari wowe Nyir’ububasha,uca imanza zitabera kandi ugategekana ubwiyoroshye.Kandi koko, ubushobozi urabusanganywe igihe cyose.
heading: Imana yigisha umuryango wayo

text: Ni uko nguko wigishije umuryango wawe,ko intungane igomba kuba incuti y’abantu,kandi watumye abana bawe bakwizera,kuko bashobora kwisubiraho, bamaze kugucumuraho.
Niba abari abanzi b’abana bawe, bakaba baragenewe gupfa,warabahannye ubafitiye impuhwe,ukabaha igihe n’uburyo bwo kwanga ububi bwabo;
wabura ute kuba waritondeye gucira imanza abana bawe,kandi waragiriye abakurambere babo amasezeranoatagira uko asa, ubigirishije indahiro!
Wabigenje utyo kugira ngo utwigishe,abanzi bacu ubahanana ubwiyoroshye,kugira ngo tuzirikane ubuntu bwawe igihe duca imanza,kandi n’igihe uducira imanza twiringire impuhwe zawe.
heading: Igihano cy’abasenga inyamaswa

text: Ni yo mpamvu, abari barigize ibyigomeke mu busazi bwabo,wabashyize ku nkeke kubera amahano yabo bwite.
Koko rero, bari barazimiriye kure mu mayira y’ubuyobe,kugeza aho bitirira imana,inyamaswa ziteye ishozi kandi zigayitse kurusha izindi,kugeza n’aho zibayobya nk’abana batagira ubwenge.
Nuko ubaha igihano cy’ubusabusa,mbese nk’icyo baha abana b’ibitambambuga.
Nyamara abatumvise ibyo bihano by’abana,bikururiye urubanza rubakwiye rw’Imana.

Bamaze kumererwa nabi kubera ibyo bikoko byabababazaga,babona ko bahanishijwe ibyo bo bitaga imana,bahita bamenya Imana y’ukuri bari baranze kwemera kuva kera.Ni cyo cyatumye rero bagwiririrwa n’urubanza rukaze.Currently Selected:Ubuhanga 12: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Koko rero, abo bantu bose batageze ku bumenyi bw’Imana,berekanye intege nke za kamere yabo;batwawe n’ibintu bigaragara ntibashobora kumenya Uriho,bitegereza ibyo bikorwa, ariko ntibabimenyeramo Uwabihanze.
heading: Ubugoryi bw’abasenga ibiremwa

text: Ahubwo bo birebeye umuriro, umwuka, umuyaga woroheje,urujeje rw’inyenyeri, imivumba y’amazin’ibinyarumuri byo mu kirere,baba ari byo bita imana zitegeka isi.
Ubwo bashutswe n’uburanga bwabyo bwatumye babifata nk’imana,ntibamenyeraho ko Umugenga wabyo abisumba kure,kuko Uwabiremye ari na we nkomoko y’uburanga.
Niba kandi ububasha bwabyo n’imbaraga zabyo byarabatangaje,bari guhera kuri ibyo bigaragara,bakumviraho ukuntu Uwabihanze abisumbya kure ububasha.
Koko rero, ubuhangange n’uburanga bw’ibyaremwebiducira amarenga atuma turangamira Uwabihanze.
Nyamara abo bantu ntibari bakwiye kugawa cyane,kuko wenda bayobaguritse bashakashaka Imana,kandi bifuza kuyigeraho.
Uko bagatuye rwagati mu biremwa byayo,bagaharanira kubimenya neza,ni na ko batwawe n’uburanga bwabyo,kuko ibyo babonaga basangaga ari byiza cyane!
Ariko kandi na bo ntibakwiye kubabarirwa,
kuko, niba baragize ubwenge bwo gusesengura imibereho y’ibyaremwe,ni kuki batashoboye kumenya hakiri kare Umugenga w’ibyo byose?
heading: Ugusenga ibigirwamana

text: Nyamara baragowe abo bantu biringiye ibintu bitagira ubuzima,ibyakozwe n’abantu bakabyita imana,nka zahabu na feza bacuranye ubuhanga,ngo babikuremo amashusho y’inyamaswa,cyangwa ibuye ritagira agaciro ryabajwe n’umuntu wa kera.
Tuvuge mbese nk’umubaji w’ibiti,uca ingeri ashobora kwikorera,akayishishurana ubuhanga bwinshi,akayikuramo igikoresho gisanzwe;
naho ibisigazwa by’uwo murimo we,akabitekesha ibyo kurya bimumaze inzara.
Ibango risigaye ridafite akamaro,kuko rigoramye cyangwa se rifite amasubyo;akarifata, akaribaza mu gihe yabuze ikindi akora,akaribaza atabyitayeho, maze akariha ishusho ry’umuntu,
cyangwa se iry’inyamaswa iteye ishozi.Hanyuma akarisiga irange,akariraba umutuku mu maso,agahisha atyo ubusembwa bwaryo.
Akarishakira akazu gakwiye gacukuye mu rukuta,akarifatisha icyuma,
agakora uko ashoboye kose ngo ritagwa hasi,kuko azi neza ko nta cyo ryishoboreye.Ni ishusho rikeneye inkunga.
Nyamara yashaka gusabira ibintu bye,urugo rwe cyangwa abana be,ntaterwe isoni no gutakambira icyo kintu kitagira ubuzima.Yashaka kumererwa neza, agatakambira ikitagira ubuzima;
yakwifuza kugira ubugingo, agatakambira icyapfuye;yashaka inkunga, akitabaza ikitishoboye na busa;mu ngendo ze, akiragiza ikitabasha no gutambuka;

naho ku byerekeye ibimutunga,inyungu ze n’imishinga ye,agasaba imbaraga ikitazifite na gato.Currently Selected:Ubuhanga 13: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Undi na we akitegura kwambuka amazi y’imivumba ikaze,maze agatakambira igiti,ndetse cyamunzwe kurusha ubwato bumutwaye.
heading: Urundi rugero rwo gusenga ibigirwamana

text: Koko rero, ubwo bwato bwakorewe kujya guhaha,kandi bwubakanwa ubuhanga n’umunyabukorikori.
Nyamara, Mubyeyi uzi guteganya, ni wowe ubwiyoborera,ni wowe wahanze umuhanda wabwo mu nyanja,mu mivumba rwagati uhashyira inzira nyabagendwa;
ugaragaza utyo ko ushobora kurinda amakuba yose,kugeza n’aho umwiga yashobora guturira inyanja.
Ntushaka ko ibikorwa by’Ubuhanga biba impfabusa,ari na cyo gituma abantu biragiza igiti kitagira shinge,bakabasha kwambuka inyanja yibirinduye,bari mu bwato budafashe, bakomoka ari bataraga.
Ni ko byagenze no mu ntangiriro,igihe abirasi n’ibihangange barimbutse;icyizere cy’isi cyahungiye mu bwato,maze kiyoborwa n’ikiganza cyawe,bituma ibihe bizaza biteganyirizwa urubyaro rushya.
Haragahirwa igiti cyahindutse igikoresho cy’ubutungane,
ariko havumwe ikigirwamana cyakibajwemo ndetse n’uwagikoze;we azire ko yagikoze,naho cyo ko ari ikintu gishanguka cyiswe imana;
kuko Imana yangira hamwe umugome n’ubugome bwe,
kandi igikorwa kikazahanirwa hamwe n’uwagikoze.
Koko rero, urubanza rw’Imana ruzibasira ibigirwamana by’amahanga,kuko byahindutse amahano mu biremwa by’Imana,bikabera abantu impamvu yo kugwa,n’umutego mu nzira y’abapfayongo.
heading: Inkomoko yo gusenga ibigirwamana

text: Inkomoko y’ubuhabara yaturutse mu kubaza ibigirwamana,maze uko kubivumbura kubahumanyiriza ubuzima.
Ntibyigeze bibaho kuva mu ntangiriro,kandi nta n’ubwo bizahoraho.
Ubwo ni ubwirasi bw’abantu bwabizanye ku isi,ariko n’igihe byagenewe cyo kuvanwaho kiri bugufi.
Umubyeyi wari wazahajwe n’icyunamo kimutunguye,yakoresheje igishushanyo cy’umwana we wari ukindutse;bityo uwahoze ari intumbi, se amwubaha nk’imana,kandi ashinga abe ayo mabanga n’iyo mihango;
maze uko ibihe bisimburana, uwo muco urakomera,kandi ukurikizwa nk’itegeko.Nanone kandi ku bw’itegeko ry’abatware,amashusho y’amabazanyo yaje gusengwa.
Koko, abatashoboraga kubashengerera kubera ko batuye kure,bagenekerezaga uko basa,maze umwami batari kumwe, bakamusimbuza ishusho,nuko bagashishikarira batyo kumuhakwaho nk’aho yahibereye.
Nguko uko n’ababaga batazi umwami na bo baje kumuramya,babitewe n’ishyaka ry’umunyabukorikori wari ubifitemo inyungu.
Uwo muntu ndetse, kugira ngo arusheho gushimisha umutegetsi we,yamukoreraga amashusho asumbya uburanga ubwo asanganywe,
nuko imbaga igahururira ubwiza bwayo,maze umwami bahaga icyubahiro cy’umuntu cyonyine,agahinduka atyo imana ikwiye gusengwa.
Nuko ubuzima bw’umuntu bugwa butyo mu mutego,bicwa n’ibyago n’agahato k’abatware,kuko bari bafashe ibuye cyangwa igiti,bakabiha izina risumba ayandi yose.
heading: Ingaruka z’uko gusenga ibigirwamana

text: Ntibahagijwe no kuyobagurika mu bumenyi bw’Imana,ndetse no guhora mu ngorane z’urudaca zitewe n’ubujiji,ibyago nk’ibyo batinyutse kubyita amahoro.
Kubera imihango yabo yo kwica abana,amabanga yabo afifitse, cyangwa ibisazi batewe n’umurengwe,
ntibacyubaha ubuzima cyangwa ubumanzi bw’abashakanye,ahubwo umwe arica undi urw’agashinyaguro, amugambanira,cyangwa se akamutesha icyubahiro, yohokera ubusambanyi.
Byose byabaye uruvangitirane:kumena amaraso n’ubwicanyi, ubujura n’ubuhendanyi,ubushukanyi n’ubuhemu, imidugararo n’ubugambanyi,
kumwaza abanyamurava, kwibagirwa ineza,ubwandure bw’imitima n’ubukubanyi,ubushyamirane mu bashakanye, ubusambanyi n’ubwomanzi.
Koko rero, gusenga ibigirwamana bitabaho ni intangiriro,impamvu n’iherezo ry’icyitwa ikibi cyose:
hari ukwishimisha birenze urugero, hari uguhanura ibinyoma,hari ukubaho mu bugome cyangwa kurahira ubusa.
Kubera ko biringira ibigirwamana bitagira ubuzima,bemera ko indahiro zabo z’ibinyomanta ngaruka mbi zizabatera.
Ariko rero bazahanishwa igihano kikubye kabiri,kuko biyibagije Imana, bagaragira ibigirwamana,kandi bakarahira ibinyoma, bahinyura icyitwa ubutungane.

Nta bwo ari ububasha bw’ibintu barahiriyeho,ahubwo ni urubanza rucirwa abanyabyaha,ruhana iteka ryose abaca ku mategeko.Currently Selected:Ubuhanga 14: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ariko wowe, Mana yacu, ugira ubuntu ukaba n’indahemuka,utinda kurakara, n’ibyo waremye byose ukabitegekana impuhwe.
heading: Ukwemera kurinda Israheli gusenga ibigirwamana

text: Ndetse n’iyo twacumuye tugumya kuba abawe,kuko tuzi ububasha bwawe, ariko kandi ntituzacumura,tuzirikana ko turi abawe.
Koko kukumenya ubwabyo, ni ubutungane bwuzuye,kumenya ububasha bwawe, bikaba isoko yo kudapfa.
Ntitwayobejwe n’ibyo umwuga mubi w’abantu wahimbye,n’umurimo udafite agaciro w’abasiga amarangi,ayo mashusho baharabitse amabara anyuranye;
kuyabona bikabyutsa irari ry’ibipfamutima,bityo bakihambira ku ishusho ritagira ubuzima ry’ikintu cyapfuye.
Aboramye mu bibi, bakunda kwizera bene ibyo,ni bo bakora ayo mashusho,bakayihambiraho, bakanayashengerera.
heading: Ubusazi bw’abakora ibigirwamana

text: Tuvuge nk’umubumbyi ukatana umwete urwondo rworoshye,arubumbamo buri gikoresho cyo mu rugo;ahereye kuri iryo bumba, akoramo inzeso n’ibibindibigenewe imirimo inyuranye.Umubumbyi abibumba byose ku buryo bumwe,ariko ni we ugena icyo buri kintu kizakora.
Hanyuma akegukira umurimo w’amanjwe:rya bumba akaribumbamo ikigirwamana kitagira shinge,kandi na we ejo bundi yaravuye mu gitaka,akazagisubiramo bidatinze, igihe azaba yambuwe ubugingo yatijwe.
Aho gutekereza urupfu azapfa byanze bikunze,ndetse n’imibereho ye y’igihe gito,arahiganwa n’abashongesha zahabu na feza,akigana abacura umuringa, maze akiratira kubumba ibitagira shinge.
Umutima we umeze nk’ivu,icyizere cye ntikirusha ubutaka agaciro,n’imibereho ye isuzuguritse kurusha ibumba,
kuko yasuzuguye Uwamuhanze,we wamushyizemo roho, akamuhuhamo umwuka w’ubuzima.
Ubuzima bwacu ni nk’umukino mu maso ye,imibereho yacu ikaba nk’isoko rigamije inyungu.Uwo muntu aravuga ati«Ni ngombwa gushaka inyungu muri byose,ndetse n’iyo yava mu kibi.»
Koko rero, ubumba ibigirwamana n’uduherezo tumeneka ubusa,arusha abandi kumenya ko acumura.
heading: Ugusenga ibigirwamana kw’Abanyamisiri kwamamara

text: Nyamara, abo banzi bashikamira umuryango wawe,bose ni ibipfamutima bikabije,n’ibiburabwenge bitambukije abana.

Bageze n’aho ibigirwamana byose by’amahanga babyita imana,kandi bidashobora gukoresha amaso kugira ngo bibone,cyangwa se amazuru kugira ngo bihumeke.Ntibishobora no gukoresha amatwi kugira ngo byumve,cyangwa intoki z’ibiganza kugira ngo bikorakore,ndetse n’ibirenge byabyo ntibishobore kugenda.
Kuko byo ubwabyo byakozwe n’umuntu,bikabumbwa n’ikiremwa cyatijwe umwuka.Koko kandi, nta muntu washobora kubumba imana isa na we.
We ni umunyarupfu, kandi ibiganza bye byahumanyenta kindi byakora, kitari ikiburabuzima.Asumba kure ibyo bintu asenga, kuko we yahawe ubuzima,ariko byo, ntibyabwigeze!
Basenga kandi n’ibikoko bikabije gutera ishozi,ndetse by’ibicucu kurusha ibindi.

N’iyo ubyitegereje, nta bwiza bwagushimisha ubisanganank’izindi nyamaswa;nta bwo Imana yigeze ibishima,nta n’umugisha yabihaye.Currently Selected:Ubuhanga 15: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ni cyo cyatumye bahanishwa ibiremwa bisa n’ibyo basenga,maze udukoko tutagira ingano turabajujubya.
heading: Imana igaburira Israheli, Abanyamisiri ikabateza inzara

text: Umuryango wawe, aho kuwuhana utyo, wawuhaye ibyiza,maze kugira ngo uwumare ipfa, uwuha inkware,ari zo biribwa biryoshye wawuteguriye.

Bityo Abanyamisiri, n’ubwo bashakaga kurya,batewe iseseme n’ibisimba wabateje,bituma batakifuza rwose n’icyo bakoza mu kanwa.Naho Abayisraheli bamaze gusonza igihe gito,basangira ibiribwa biryoshye bitangaje.
Byari bikwiye ko ababakandamizaga baterwa n’inzara idashira,bikaba bihagije ko abandi babona uko abanzi babo bajujubijwe.
heading: Inzige n’isazi byica Abanyamisiri; Abayisraheli bagakizwa n’inzoka y’umuringa

text: Ndetse n’igihe cy’ubukana bukaze bw’ibisimba bifite ubumara,bwagwiririye abana bawemaze bagapfa barumwe n’inzoka zibizingiyeho,uburakari bwawe ntibwakomeje kugera ku ndunduro.
Ahubwo byabaye kubaburira,ngo bagire ubwoba nibura igihe gito,kandi bagira n’ikimenyetso cy’umukiro,ngo kibe urwibutso rw’amategeko yawe.
Koko rero, uwahindukiraga wese akakireba yarakiraga,bidatewe n’icyo kimenyetso yarebaga,ahubwo biturutse kuri wowe, Mukiza wa bose.
Bityo rero, weretse abanzi bacu,ko ari wowe ukiza umuntu ikibi cyose.
Bo barumwe n’inzige n’isazi,bapfa bazize kutabona umuti wabakiza:kuko bari bakwiriye guhanishwa udukoko nk’utwo.
Naho abana bawe, n’amenyo y’inzoka zifite ubumarantiyagira icyo abatwara,kuko impuhwe zawe zabagobotse, zikabakiza.
Wabakubitaga iminyafu kugira ngo ubibutse amagambo yawe,ariko bakayikira vuba, ngo hato batibagirana bikabije,bakanyura ukubiri n’ubugiraneza bwawe.
Koko rero, nta cyatsi cyangwa undi muti byabakijije,ahubwo ni Ijambo ryawe, Nyagasani, ryo rikiza bose.
Ni wowe ufite ububasha ku buzima n’urupfu,ukajyana Ikuzimu, ukanavanayo;
umuntu we ashobora kwica ku bugome,ariko ntiyasubiza umwuka uwapfuye,kandi ntiyanagobotora uwagiye Ikuzimu.
heading: Urubura rwica Abanyamisiri; Abayisraheli bakagaburirwa manu

text: Guhunga ikiganza cyawe ni ibidashoboka.
Abagome bangaga kukumenya,bahondaguwe n’ukuboko kwawe gufite ububasha;imvura y’umurindi n’urubura bidasanzwe,hamwe n’amashahi akabije bibabuza uburyo,nuko umuriro urabatwika.
Igitangaje ni uko no mu mazi azimya byose,ari ho umuriro warushagaho kugira amakare,kuko isi irwanirira intungane.
Rimwe na rimwe umuriro waracogoraga,kugira ngo udatsemba ibisimba byatererejwe abagome,kandi ngo nibabibona biyumvisheko bakurikiranywe n’urubanza rw’Imana;
ubundi mu mazi rwagati hakagurumana birushije umuriro,kugira ngo ibimera mu mirima y’abagome birimbuke.
Nyamara umuryango wawe wawuhaye ifunguro ry’abamalayika,aho uri mu ijuru, abawe ubaha umugati uteguwe neza bataruhiye,umugati ufite uburyohe bwose kandi unogeye bose.
Ibyo wabahaga byagaragazaga ubugwaneza ugirira abana bawe,kuko byabaga binogeye nyir’ukubirya,bikamerera buri wese uko abyifuza.
Amasimbi n’amahindu byihanganiraga umuriro ntibishonge,kugira ngo abantu bamenye ukuntu imyaka y’abanziyarimbuwe n’umuriro wakiraga mu mahindu,ukagurumana rwagati mu mvura.
Kugira ngo kandi ufashe intungane kubona ikizitunga,uwo muriro nyine washiragamo ubukana.
Ibiremwa bikugaragiye, wowe Muremyi wabyo,birigurumbanya kugira ngo abagome bahanwe,ariko bigacururuka ngo abakwiringira bamererwe neza.
Ni yo mpamvu rero byashoboraga guhinduka ukundi,bigakera kuba igikoresho cy’ubuntu bwawe,bigahinduka ifunguro rusange,rihuje n’icyifuzo cy’abarikeneye.
Ni cyo gituma, Nyagasani,abana bawe wakunze bashobora kumvako umuntu adatungwa n’amoko menshi y’imbuto,ahubwo ko ijambo ryawe ari ryo ribeshaho abakwemera.
Icyabaga kitangijwe n’umuriro,cyashongeshwaga n’imirase yoroheje y’izuba,
kugira ngo bamenye ko bagomba kugusingizambere y’uko izuba rirasa, mugashyikirana kuva bugicya.

Nyamara ariko, icyizere cy’indashima kizashongank’urubura rwo mu itumba,kizaseseke nk’amazi adafite akamaro.Currently Selected:Ubuhanga 16: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Imigirire yawe ni intagereranywakandi biragoye kuyisobanukirwa,ni na yo mpamvu ab’injiji bayobye.
heading: Abanyamisiri barengwaho n’umwijima; Abayisraheli bakayoborwa n’inkingi y’umuriro

text: Abagome bashakaga gukandamiza igihugu gitagatifu,ni bo bahindutse imfungwa z’umwijima,baboheshwa iminyururu y’ijoro ridacya,bagaragurikira aho bafungiye mu mazu yabo,baba ibicibwa bitakirebwa n’umugambi w’Imana.
Bo bibwiraga ko bazaguma mu bwihisho,hamwe n’ibyaha bakoreye mu ibanga bizera ko bizibagirana;ariko batashywe n’ubwoba bukabije, baratatana,ndetse bagakangaranywa na za baringa.
Ubuvumo bubabundikiye ntibwabarinze ubwoba,urusaku rukabije rurahogera iruhande rwabo,bakabona na za baringa zijimyekandi zishavuye nk’iziri mu cyunamo.
Umuriro ukomeye cyanentiwari ukibasha gutanga urumuri;n’ubushashagirane bw’inyenyeri ntibwari bugishoborakumurikira iryo joro riteye ubwoba.

Igishyito cy’umuriro wiyatsaga ubwawo,ni cyo cyonyine barabukwaga kikabatera ubwoba,maze iryo bonekerwa ryaba rirangiyebagakomeza gukangarana,kandi bagasanga ibyo bamaze kubonabirushijeho kuba umwaku.
Amayeri y’ubupfumu nta cyo yari akimaze,kwibwira ko ari ho ubwenge buturuka byabateye ikimwaro.
Abavugaga ko umutima urwaye bashobora kuwukizaubwoba n’ibisazi,ni bo ahubwo bafashwe n’indwara y’ubwoba,budafite ishingiro.
Ndetse n’ubwo nta kintu gikanganye cyabaga gihari,ngo kibatere ubwoba,umuvuduko w’udusimba n’urusaku rw’ibigendesha inda,byonyine byari bihagije kugira ngo bakangarane,
bagapfa batengurwa kubera ubwoba,ntibatinyuke no kureba uwo mwijima,umuntu akabura aho awuhungira.
Koko, ubugome ni ikintu kigaragaza ububwa,kandi ni na bwo bwicira urubanza;kuko iyo bwugarijwe n’umutimanama buri gihe,bugenda bubona ingorane impande zose.
Ubwoba rero si ikindi,ni ukubura ubwenge butekereza.
Uko umuntu agenda abura ibitekerezo bishyitse,ni ko arushaho gukuririza impamvu atazi,zituma ahagarika imitima.
Bo rero, muri iryo joro ribi rwose,riturutse mu muheno w’Ukuzimu kutagira shinge,igihe bose bari batwawe n’ibitotsi,
bakurikiranwaga na za baringa zibatera ubwoba,ubundi bakazikama bitewe n’umutima wabo wacitse urukendero,kuko bari bagwiririwe n’ubwoba budasanzwe, bubatunguye.
Bityo, uwabaga ageze aho wese,yameraga nk’imfungwa ifungiye mu buroko budafungurwa.
Yaba umuhinzi, umworozi,cyangwa umukozi ufite akazi mu butayu,iyo yabaga aguwe gitumo, yakubitanaga na Nyamunsi,
kuko bose bari ku ngoyi imwe y’umwijima.Umuyaga uhuha n’indirimbo nziza z’inyoni mu mashami atohagiye,umuririmo w’amazi ahururana ingufu,

urusaku rw’amabuye akocagurana igihe ahirima,isiganwa ritagaragara ry’inyamaswa zisimbuka,umworomo w’ibikoko by’inkazi byo mu ishyamba,cyangwa nyiramubande yo mu bikombe by’imisozi,ibyo byose byarabakangaranyaga, bakajunjama.
Koko rero, isi yose yari imurikiwe n’urumuri rurabagirana,kandi igakomeza imirimo yayo nta nkomyi.

Ijoro ryari ribuditse kuri bo bonyine,rikaba ishusho y’umwijima wari ubateganyirijwe,ariko na bo bari bibereye umutwaro uremereye kurusha umwijima.Currently Selected:Ubuhanga 17: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Nyamara abatagatifujwe bawebari bamurikiwe n’urumuri rw’agatangaza;Abanyamisiri bumvaga ijwi ryabo ariko ntibababone,bakavuga ko bo bahiriwe kuko batari bakibabara,
bakabashimira ko batashatse kwihorera nyuma y’inabi bagiriwe,bakabasaba n’imbabazi z’uko babarwanyije.
Abawe rero, aho kuguma mu mwijima,wabahaye inkingi y’umuriro, ugurumana,kugira ngo ibayobore inzira batari bazi,inababere izuba ritababaza mu gihe bimukanaga ishema.
Naho Abanyamisiri bari bakwiye koko kutagira urumuri,bakabundikirwa n’umwijima,kuko bari baragize imfungwa abana bawebagombaga guha isi urumuri rudashira rw’Amategeko yawe.
heading: Ijoro ry’ibyago ku Banyamisiri ryabereye Abayisraheli iryo gukizwa

text: Kubera ko biyemeje kwica impinja z’abatagatifujwe,maze hakarokoka umwana umwe gusa mu bari bagenewe gupfa,wabahanishije kubambura benshi mu bana babo,ubarohera icyarimwe mu mazi y’umuvumba ukaze.
Iryo joro ryari ryaramenyeshejwe mbere abasokuruza bacu,kugira ngo ubwo bari bazi indahiro bishingikirije,barusheho kugira ubutwari.
Nuko umuryango wawe uritegerezamoagakiza k’intungane n’irimbuka ry’abanzi bawo.
Koko, igihe wahoraga abanzi bacu, ni bwo wadukijije,uraduhamagara ngo tuze tukugana.

Abasabaniramana bakomoka ku ntunganebaturaga ibitambo mu ibanga,bityo bemereza icyarimwe iri tegeko ry’Imana,rivuga ko abatagatifujwe bagomba gusangira amahirwe n’ibyago,nuko batera ibisingizo by’abasekuruza babo.
Icyo gihe, urusaku rudasobanutse rw’abanzi babo rwarabikirizaga,amajwi aganya y’abaririra abana babo akumvikanira kure.
Umucakara na shebuja bahanwaga kimwe,umuturage usanzwe akababara kimwe n’umwami.
Bose bari bapfushije abantu batagira inganokandi bazize urupfu rumwe,abakiri bazima ntibari bagihagije mu kubahamba,kuko uburiza bwabo bwari bwarimbutse mu kanya kangana urwara.
Nuko abari barakomeje kunangira umutima,babitewe no kwihambira ku bupfumu bwabo,babonye uburiza bwabo burimbutse, batangira kwemerako uwo muryango wari uw’abana b’Imana.
Igihe ituze ryari ritwikiriye ibintu byose,n’ijoro ririmbanyije,
ijambo ryawe ry’irinyabubasha nk’umurwanyi w’indatsimburwa,riva mu ijuru ku ntebe ya cyamirisimbukira mu gihugu cyavumwe,
ryitwaje inkota ityaye, ari ryo teka ryawe ridasubirwaho.Rihageze rirahagarara maze isi yose riyuzuza imirambo:ryakoraga ku ijuru, rigakandagira ku isi.
Ako kanya babonera mu nzozi mbi, ibintu bibakura umutima,n’ubwoba batari biteze burabakangaranya.
Buri muntu yarasambagurikaga nk’uwenda gupfa,ari na ko avuga icyo azize;
kuko inzozi zari zabashajije zabyerekanye mbere,ngo batava aho bapfa batazi icyo bazize.
heading: Aroni abagoboka bari mu butayu

text: Nyamara urupfu rwageze no ku ntungane,maze abantu benshi barimbukira mu butayu,ariko uburakari ntibwamara igihe kirekire.

Koko rero, umuntu w’indakemwa yihutiye kubarengera,yitwaza isengesho n’ububani by’igitambo gihongerera ibyaha,ari byo ntwaro z’ubutumwa bwe.Acubya umujinya w’Imana maze abona intsinzi y’icyago,yerekana atyo ko ari umugaragu wawe.
Ahosha ubukana, nyamara atari ku bw’imbaraga z’umubiricyangwa ku bubasha bw’intwaro;ahubwo ijambo aba ari ryo akesha gucubya Nyir’uguhana,yibutsa indahiro n’amasezerano byagiriwe abasokuruza.
Nuko igihe intumbi zakomezaga kugwira,uwo muntu arahagoboka maze ahagarika icyo cyorezo,agifungira inzira yajyaga mu bakiri bazima.
Ku ikanzu ye ndende, hashushanyijeho isi yose,ibigwi by’abasokuruza byanditseku mirongo ine y’amabuye atatse iyo kanzu,naho ku ikamba atamirije haganje ishema ryawe.

Umurimbuzi ngo abibone ni ko kugira ubwoba, asubira inyuma,bitewe n’ukwigaragaza konyine k’uburakari bwawe.Currently Selected:Ubuhanga 18: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ariko abo bagome, uburakari bwabahannyebwihanukiriye kugeza ku ndunduro,kuko Imana yari isanzwe izi ibyo bagiye gukora:
heading: Icyambu mu Nyanja y’umutuku

text: ko nibamara kwemerera umuryango wayo kugendano kuwohereza huti huti,bazahindura ibyo biyemeje, bakawukurikirana.

Koko rero, igihe bari bakiri mu cyunamokandi baririra ku mva z’ababo bapfuye,ikindi gitekerezo gihubutse kibazamo,maze abo bari bamaze kwingingira kubavira aho,barabakurikirana nk’aho bagiye batorotse.
Urubanza bari bakwiye rubageza kuri icyo gitekerezo,maze rutuma bibagirwa ibyari bimaze kubabaho,ku buryo imibabaro yabo bayongeraho ikindi gihano,
kandi ngo mu gihe umuryango wawe uri mu rugendo rutangaje,bo bahubirane n’urupfu rudasanzwe.
Koko rero, ibiremwa byose uko bingana muri kamere yabyo,byongeye kuremwa bundi bushya bikurikije amategeko yawe,kugira ngo abana bawe bakomeze kubaho.
Nuko babona igihu gitwikiriye ingando,ubutaka bwumutse butumburuka ahahoze amazi,Inyanja y’umutuku ihinduka inzira nyabagendwa,imivumba yibirinduraga ihinduka ikibaya cy’ibyatsi bitoshye,
ari na ho umuryango wawe wose wanyuze,urinzwe n’ikiganza cyawe,maze bibonera n’amaso yabo ibikorwa byawe by’agatangaza.
Nuko bakwirwa urwuri nk’amafarasi,basimbuka nk’utwana tw’intama,bagusingiza, wowe Nyagasani, Umukiza wabo.
Koko rero, bari bakibuka ibyababayeho bakiri mu Misiri,igihe isi ubwayo ivubuye imibu itabyawe n’udukoko,Uruzi rukavundura imitubu myinshi itavuye ku two mu mazi.
Hashize igihe, babona izindi nyoni zadutse ku buryo budasanzwe,ari bwo umururumba wabateraga gusaba ibiribwa biryoshye;
maze inkware zigenewe kubahaza, zihinguka mu nyanja.
heading: Abanyamisiri n’urwango banga abanyamahanga

text: Ariko abanyabyaha baguweho n’ibihano,bitabanjirijwe n’ibimenyetso by’imirabyo y’inkuba zikaze.Ntibarenganyijwe, ahubwo bahaniwe ubugome bwabo,kuko bari baragaragarije urwango runuka umunyamahanga.
Ni nk’Abanyasodoma banze kwakira abo batazi baje babagana,ndetse abashyitsi bigeze kubagirira neza, babahindura abacakara.
Ntibyaciriye aho, abo bantu bahaniweko bakiranye ubugome abanyamahanga.
Nyamara n’ubwo babanje kubakirana ibyishimo,kuko na bo bari abantu bafite uburenganzira,babirenzeho babicisha imirimo y’agahato.
Ni yo mpamvu bafashwe n’ubuhumyi,mbese nka ba bandi bari bageze ku muryango w’intungane,bakagotwa n’umwijima batazi aho uturutse,kandi bose bashakisha inzira yawubagezaho.
heading: Imana irema imibereho mishya

text: Nuko ibintu byose bihinduranya imimerere yabyo,mbese nk’uko kunyuranya amajwi k’umurya w’inangabihinduka injyana, ariko ugakomeza ijwi ryawo.Ibyo byarushaho kugaragara, umuntu yitegereje ibyabaye:
inyamaswa zo ku gasozi zahindutse izo mu ruzi,izogaga mu ruzi zigenda ku butaka;
mu mazi, umuriro urushaho kugurumana,bityo amazi abura ubushobozi bwayo bwo kuzimya;
kandi umuriro ntiwatwika umubiri woroshyew’inyamaswa zawunyuranagamo rwagati,ntiwashobora gushongesha icyo kiribwa cy’Imana,cyari kimeze nk’urubura rushonga bitaruhanyije.
heading: Umwanzuro

text: Koko, Nyagasani, wakijije umuryango wawe kandi urawubahisha;ntiwigeze uhwema kuwutera inkunga, igihe cyose n’ahantu hose.Currently Selected:Ubuhanga 19: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ubuhanga bwose bukomoka kuri Uhoraho,kandi buhorana na we ubuziraherezo.
heading: Ijambo ry’ibanze ry’uwahinduye iki gitabo / I. INYIGISHO ZINYURANYE ZEREKEYE UBUHANGA / Inkomoko y’ubuhanga

text: Umusenyi wo ku nyanja n’ibitonyanga by’imvura,cyangwa iminsi y’ibihe byose, ni nde washobora kubibarura?
Ni nde wapima ubuhagarike bw’ikirere n’ubugari bw’isi,agasobanukirwa n’inyenga, nkanswe ubuhanga?
Ubuhanga bwaremwe mbere ya byose,ubwitonzi buhangwa kera na kare.
Ni nde wahishuriwe imizi y’ubuhanga?Ibanga ry’imigambi yabwo, ni nde wigeze arimenya?
Umunyabuhanga ni umwe, kandi aratinyitse cyane,ni Utetse ku ntebe ye y’ubwami:
Uhoraho ni we ubwe waburemye,arabwitegereza, arabusesengura,abukwiza mu biremwa bye byose,
mu binyamubiri byose, akurikije ubuntu bwe,kandi abusendereza no mu bamukunda bose.
heading: Gutinya Uhoraho ni yo soko y’ubuhanga

text: Gutinya Uhoraho bitanga ikuzo n’ishema,bitera kwishima, bikanambika ikamba ry’umunezero.
Gutinya Uhoraho binezeza umutima,bitanga ibyishimo n’umunezero, ndetse no kuramba.
Utinya Uhoraho, byose bizamuhira,umunsi we wo gupfa nugera, azahabwa umugisha.
Gutinya Uhoraho, ni yo ntangiriro y’ubuhanga,kandi indahemuka ziremanwa na bwo mu nda ya ba nyina.
Bwaciye indaro mu bantu, ni inkingi ihoraho,kandi buzihambira ku rubyaro rwabo ubutabatezukaho.
Gutinya Uhoraho ni bwo buhanga buhanitse,ababwitangiye bubasenderezamo imbuto zabwo;
bwuzuza ibyiza byinshi mu mazu yabo,bugahunika imbuto zabwo mu bigega byabo.
Ikamba ry’ubuhanga ni ugutinya Uhoraho,ni bwo butanga kugubwa neza n’amagara mazima.
Uhoraho yarabwitegereje, arabusesengura,ubumenyi n’ubwenge abitanga umudendezo,kandi ahesha ikuzo ababwitangiye.
Imizi y’ubuhanga ni ugutinya Uhoraho,kandi ubutohagire bw’amashami yabwo butanga kuramba.
heading: Umujinya n’ukwihangana

text: Umujinya w’ubusa nta shingiro uba ufite,kuko umutwaro wawo urimbura nyirawo.
Umuntu witonda arihangana agategereza umwanya uboneye,maze amaherezo ibyishimo bikamugarukira;
ahisha amagambo ye, agategereza igihe,maze ubwenge bwe bukamamazwa na benshi.
heading: Kwicisha bugufi, gukunda no gutinya Uhoraho

text: Mu bigega by’ubuhanga, hahunitsemo amagambo y’ubwenge,ariko gukunda Imana bitera umunyabyaha ishozi.
Urifuza ubuhanga? Jya ukurikiza amategeko,maze Uhoraho azabukugabire.
Koko rero, ubuhanga n’ubumenyi ni ugutinya Uhoraho,kandi ikimushimisha ni ubudahemuka n’ubwitonzi.
Ntugateshuke ku gitinyiro cy’Uhoraho,cyangwa ngo umuyobokane umutima uryarya.
Uzirinde kuryarya abandi,kandi ujye ufata umunwa wawe.

Ntukikuze wowe ubwawe, utavaho ugwa,maze ukikururira ikimwaro.Koko rero, Uhoraho yatangaza amabanga yawe,akakoreka mu ikoraniro rwagati,kuko wanze kumutinya,kandi umutima wawe ukaba wuzuye amayeri.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 1: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices?
