Mwana, niba wiyemeje gukorera Uhoraho,tegura umutima wawe kuzihanganira ibigeragezo.
heading: Kudahemuka mu bigeragezo

text: Umutima wawe uzabe umunyamurava,kandi ugire ibitekerezo bihamye;ntugakangarane mu gihe cy’amakuba.
Uzamukomereho, woye kumutatira,bityo uzakuzwa ku munsi wawe wa nyuma.
Ibikubayeho byose, ujye ubyemera,kandi ujye wihanganira amagorwa aguca intege;
kuko zahabu isukurirwa mu muriro,n’intore zikagaragarira mu makuba.
Uziringire Uhoraho, azagutabara,uzajye unyura inzira iboneye kandi umwizere.
heading: Kwiringira Imana

text: Mwebwe abatinya Uhoraho, nimutegereze imbabazi ze,kandi ntimudohoke, hato mutazarimbuka.
Mwebwe abatinya Uhoraho, nimumwiringire,ibihembo byanyu ntibizigera bibura.
Mwebwe abatinya Uhoraho, nimwizere ibyiza bibagenewe,birimo ibyishimo bihoraho n’imbabazi.
Nimusubize amaso mu bisekuru bya kera, murebe:ni nde wiringiye Uhoraho, maze agakorwa n’ikimwaro?cyangwa ni nde watinye Uhoraho maze akamutererana?ni nde wamwiyambaje, akamusuzugura?
Koko rero, Uhoraho ni Nyir’imbabazi n’impuhwe,akiza ibyaha kandi agatabara mu gihe cy’amakuba.
Hagowe ibigwari n’abagiranabi,hamwe n’umunyabyaha urangwa n’uburyarya.
Hagowe uw’umutima mubi, kuko adafite ukwemera;ni yo mpamvu atazitabwaho!
Muragowe mwebwe mwadohotse!Ese Uhoraho naza muzifata mute?
Abatinya Uhoraho ntibasuzugura amagambo ye,kandi abamukunda bakomera ku nzira ze.
Abatinya Uhoraho bashaka ikimushimisha,kandi abamukunda bakanezezwa n’amategeko ye.
Abatinya Uhoraho bahorana umutima ukeye,kandi bakicisha bugufi imbere ye, bagira bati

«Reka twishyire mu maboko y’Uhoraho, twoye kwiringira abantu,kuko ari we Nyir’ububasha, akaba na Nyir’impuhwe.»Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 2: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Bana banjye, ndi so wababyaye, nimuntege amatwi;maze mukore ibizabahesha umukiro,
heading: Ni ngombwa kubaha ababyeyi

text: kuko Uhoraho ahimbariza se w’abana imbere yabo,kandi agashyigikira ubutegetsi bwa nyina ku bahungu be.
Uwubashye se, aba ahongereye ibyaha bye,
naho uhimbaje nyina aba ameze nk’uwihunikiye byinshi.
Uwubaha se azaronka ibyishimo mu bana be,kandi umunsi azaba yambaje, isengesho rye rizakirwa.
Uhimbaza se azaramba,kandi uwumvira Uhoraho azahumuriza nyina.
Utinya Uhoraho yubaha se,kandi agakorera ababyeyi be nk’aho ari ba shebuja.
Uzubahe so mu magambo no mu bikorwa,kugira ngo umugisha we uzagusakareho;
kuko umugisha wa se w’abana ukomeza amazu yabo,naho umuvumo wa nyina ukayarandurira mu mizi.
Ntukishimire ko so asuzuguritse,kuko ikimwaro kimukoze, bitaguhesha ishema.
Ikuzo ry’umuntu arikomora ku cyubahiro cya se,kandi iyo nyina w’abana asuzuguwe, bibabera umugayo.
Mwana wanjye, jya ushyigikira so ageze mu za bukuru,kandi ntukamutere agahinda mu buzima bwe.
N’iyo ubwenge bwe bwakendera, jya umugirira impuhwe,ntuzamusuzugure, ngo ni uko wowe ukiri umusore.
Koko rero, ineza ugiriye so ntiyigera yibagirana,ahubwo izakubera impongano y’ibyaha byawe.
Nugera mu makuba, Uhoraho azakwibuka,ibyaha byawe bishonge nk’amahindu yikanze umucyo.
Utererana se aba ari inkorashyano,naho ushavuza nyina aba ari ikivume imbere y’Uhoraho.
heading: Umutima wiyoroshya

text: Mwana wanjye, ibyo ukora bijye birangwa n’ubwiyoroshye,bityo uzakundwa kurusha abagaba byinshi.
Uko ugenda ukomera, ujye urushaho kwicisha bugufi,maze uzagire ubutoni imbere y’Imana.
Koko rero, Uhoraho ni we Nyir’ububasha,kandi ab’umutima wiyoroshya ni bo bamuhesha ikuzo.
Ntukararikire ibigukomereye cyane,kandi ibyo ubona ari insobe, ntukabisesengure.
Jya uzirikana ibyo wategetswe,kuko udakeneye ibintu bidafututse.
Ntukivange mu bikurenze,kuko n’ibyo weretswe ubwabyo bisumbye ubwenge bw’umuntu.
Koko rero, benshi barindagijwe n’ibyo bihimbiye,kandi imigambi mibi ibayobya ibitekerezo.
heading: Kwirinda ubwirasi

text: Umutima unangiye uzabona amakuba,kandi uteza ibyago azabigwamo.
Umutima unangiye uzashavuzwa n’agahinda,kandi umunyabyaha yungikanya ibicumuro.
Ingeso y’ubwirasi ntigira umuti,kuko urugemwe rubi rwayitoshyemo.
Umutima w’umunyabwenge uzirikana umugani,kandi umunyabuhanga yifuza umutega amatwi.
heading: Gufasha abakene

text: Amazi azimya ikibatsi cy’umuriro,gufasha abakene bigahanagura ibyaha.

Ugira neza aba yitega iminsi,maze yasumbirizwa akabona kiramira.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 3: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Mwana wanjye, ntukime umukene icyamutunga,kandi ugusabye, ntagahore aguhanze amaso.
Ntugashavuze ushonje,cyangwa ngo urakaze umutindi.
Ntugahuhure ufite umutima uhangayitse,kandi ntukarangarane imfashanyo y’umutindi.
Ntugasubize inyuma ugusaba ababaye,kandi ntukirengagize umukene.
Ntugahunze umukene amaso,kandi ntugatume hagira ukuvuma,
kuko nashavura akakuvuma,Uwamuremye azumva isengesho rye.
Uzabe incuti y’ikoraniro ryose,kandi n’umutegetsi umwunamire.
Ujye utega amatwi umukene,indamutso ye uyisubizanye ubwitonzi.
Ukandamizwa, uzamukize ikiganza cy’umukandamiza,kandi nuca urubanza, ntukagire ubwoba.
Imfubyi, uzazibere umubyeyi,na nyina wazo, umugenzereze nk’umugabo we;bityo uzaba umwana w’Umusumbabyose,na we azagukunde kurusha nyoko wakubyaye.
heading: Akamaro k’ubuhanga

text: Ubuhanga buhesha ikuzo abana babwo,kandi burinda ababushakashaka.
Ubukunda, aba akunda ubuzima,kandi ababwitabira bugicya, bazasagwa n’ibyishimo.
Ubwizirikaho, azahabwa ikuzo ho umurage,kandi aho yinjiye hose, Uhoraho amuha umugisha.
Ababwitabira basingiza Nyir’ubutagatifu,kandi ababwitangiye, Uhoraho arabakunda.
Uwumva ubuhanga azacira amahanga urubanza,kandi ubwitaho azabaho mu mutekano.
Ubwizera azabuhabwaho umurage,n’abamukomokaho bazabugabirwa.

Icyakora burabanza bukamunyuza mu mayira aziguye,bukamutera ubwoba agahinda umushyitsi,bukamurushya bumutegeka kubwihatira,kugeza ubwo busanga bushobora kumwizera,bumaze kumugerageza n’amategeko yabwo.
Hanyuma bukamugarukira, bukamushimisha,maze bukamuhishurira amabanga yabwo.
Iyo arorongotanye buramutererana,agakurizaho kurimbuka.
heading: Ubwitonzi n’ubutabera

text: Jya utegereza umwanya uboneye, wirinde icyaha,bityo wowe ubwawe ntuzigaya,
kuko hari isoni zikurura icyaha,hakaba n’isoni zigeza ku ikuzo n’ubutoni.
Ntugakabye ngo wicire urubanza rukaze,kandi nucogora, ntibizagutere impungenge.
Ntuzareke kuvuga mu mwanya uboneye,cyangwa ngo uhishe ubuhanga bwawe utinya gusekwa,
kuko imvugo ari yo iranga ubuhanga,n’amagambo akerekana ubumenyi.
Ntugahinyure ukuri,ahubwo jya ugira isoni z’ubujiji bwawe.
Ntukagire isoni zo kwicuza ibyaha byawe,kandi ntukagerageze kubuza uruzi gutemba.
Ntuzisebye imbere y’igicucu,kandi ntuzabere umunyembaraga.
Uzaharanire ukuri kugeza gupfa,Uhoraho Imana na we azakurwanirira.
Ntuzagaragareho kuba intwari ku karimi,maze ngo ube ikigwari n’indangare mu bikorwa.
Ntuzigire intare mu rugo rwawe,ngo ube ikigwari imbere y’abagaragu bawe.

Ikiganza cyawe, ntukakibumbure ari uko ugiye guhabwa,maze ngo nujya gutanga ukibumbe.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 4: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ntuzishingikirize umutungo wawe,ntuzibwire ngo «Mfite ibimpagije.»
heading: Nta mahoro y’umukire n’umunyabyaha

text: Ntukishinge ibyifuzo n’imbaraga zawe,ngo ukurikize irari ry’umutima wawe.
Ntukavuge ngo «Ni nde uzantegeka?»Kuko, nta shiti, Uhoraho yazaguhana.
Ntukavuge ngo «Ko nacumuye byantwaye iki?»kuko Uhoraho azi kwihangana.
Ntuziringire imbabazi ze,ngo wungikanye ibyaha.
Ntukibwire ngo «Imbabazi ze ni nyinshi,azambabarira umurundo w’ibyaha nakoze»;yego, arangwa n’impuhwe, ariko agira n’umujinya,kandi uburakari bwe burondera abanyabyaha.
Ntuzatindiganye mu kugarukira Uhoraho,ngo uhore ubyimurira ejo hazaza,kuko uburakari bw’Uhoraho buzagurumana bugutunguye,maze igihe cyo guhanwa nikigera, uzarimbuke.
Ntukiringire ubukungu bw’amahugu,kuko amakuba naza, nta cyo buzakumarira.
heading: Kwirinda uburyarya

text: Ntukagosore utarebye aho umuyaga uturuka,cyangwa ngo unyure mu mayira ubonye yose;ibyo ni iby’umunyabyaha urangwa n’uburyarya.
Ujye ugira ibitekerezo bihamye,kandi uvuge ijambo uzasubiraho.
Uzajye ushishikarira kumva,ariko nujya kuvuga, ubanze witonde.
Niba hari icyo uzi, subiza mugenzi wawe,ariko niba nta cyo, icecekere.
Ikuzo n’umugayo, byombi biba mu magambo,kandi ururimi rw’umuntu ni rwo rutuma arimbuka.
Uzirinde ko bakwita inzimuzi,cyangwa ngo amagambo yawe agire uwo abera umutego,kuko igisambo gikorwa n’isoni,n’indyarya igahanwa bikomeye.

Ntugacumure haba mu bikomeye, haba no mu byoroshye,kandi uwo mwari incuti, ntimuzahinduke abanzi.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 5: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Koko, uwabaye ruvumwa, isoni n’umugayo biramusanga;ni ko bizagendekera umunyabyaha urangwa n’uburyarya.
heading: Kwirinda ubwirasi

text: Ntukikuze ushingiye ku bitekerezo byawe bwite,hato utazavaho usogotwa nk’unyukanyutswe n’imfizi;
watagaguza amababi yawe, imbuto zawe zigahubuka,ugasigara uri agati kumye.
Umutima urarikiye ikibi usema nyirawo,ukamuha amenyo y’abanzi.
heading: Ubucuti nyakuri

text: Nyir’imvugo nziza agwiza incuti,kandi ijambo rinyuze umutima ryongera urugwiro.
Jya ugirana umubano n’abantu benshi,naho uzakugira inama, uzafate umwe ku gihumbi.
Nushaka kugira umuntu incuti, jya ubanza umugerageze,kandi ntukihutire kumwimariramo.
Koko rero, hari ukubera incuti mu byishimo,amakuba yaza, akakwigarika.
Hari n’ubwo uwari incuti ahinduka umwanzi,akakumenera ibanga rikagukoza isoni.
Hari n’undi ukubera incuti mugasangira utwawe,maze amakuba yaza, akakwitarura.
Iyo ukungahaye, akwiyegurira wese,akisanzurana n’abagaragu bawe,
ariko iyo uguye, arakurwanya,akirinda ko muhuza amaso.
Jya ugendera kure abanzi bawe,kandi witondere n’incuti zawe.
Incuti y’indahemuka ni ubuhungiro buhamye,uyibonye aba yaronse umukiro.
Incuti y’indahemuka nta cyo wayinganyakandi nta munzani wapima akamaro kayo.
Incuti y’indahemuka ni nk’umuti ubeshaho,abatinya Uhoraho bazayibona.
Utinya Uhoraho aba agize ubucuti bwiza,kuko incuti izakubanira uko uyimereye.
heading: Kwitoza gukunda ubuhanga

text: Mwana wanjye, uzakunde ubumenyi kuva mu buto bwawe,bityo uzarinda usazana ubuhanga.
Jya ubwitaho nk’uhinga agatera,maze utegereze imbuto zabwo ziryoshye;yego, uzabugeraho bikuvunnye,ariko ntuzatinda gusogongera ku byiza byabwo.
Ni koko, ab’injiji bubabera umutwaro w’ikirenga,umunyamutima muke ntabwizirikaho;
bumuremerera nk’urutare,ntatindiganye kubwiyaka.
Ni koko, ubuhanga buberanye n’izina ryabwo,nta bwo buhangarwa n’imbaga nyamwinshi.
Tega amatwi, mwana wanjye, wakire inyigisho yanjye,woye kwihunza inama zanjye.
Uzajye ushinga ikirenge mu ntambwe zabwo,n’ijosi ryawe urigere mu runigi rwabwo,
kandi utege intugu ubwiremeke,woye kwinubira ingoyi zabwo.
Uzabwiyegurire n’umutima wawe wose,ukurikize inzira zabwo n’imbaraga zawe zose.
Uzabukurikire ubushakashake, buzakwiyereka,kandi numara kubushyikira, ntuzaburekure;
kuko amaherezo uzabubonamo uburuhukiro,bukaguhindukiramo ibyishimo.
Ingoyi zabwo zizaguhesha ubuhungiro,naho inigi zabwo zikubere umwambaro w’ikuzo.
Koko rero, umutwaro wabwo ni nk’umutako wa zahabu,naho ingoyi zabwo zaboheshejwe imishumi y’umuhemba.
Uzabwisesuraho nk’umwambaro w’ikuzo,ubwitamirize nk’ikamba ry’umunezero.
Mwana wanjye, nubishaka uzihugura,kandi nubishyiraho umutima, uzahinduka umunyabwenge.
Niba ushishikarira kumva, uzamenya,kandi nutega amatwi, uzaba umunyabuhanga.
Ujye wisunga ikoraniro ry’abasheshe akanguhe,kandi niba hari umunyabuhanga, umwizirikeho.
Imvugo yose iturutse ku Mana, ujye uyumva,kandi imigani y’abanyabwenge ntikagucike.
Nubona umuntu w’umunyabwenge, ujye umugana bugicya,uhore usiragira imbere y’urugi rw’umuryango we.

Ujye uzirikana amategeko y’Uhoraho,kandi ntugahweme kwita ku mabwiriza ye,na we ubwe azagukomeza umutima,maze ubuhanga wifuza uzabugabirwe.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 6: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ntukagire nabi, nawe inabi itazakugwirira.
heading: Izindi nama zinyuranye

text: Uzamaganire kure akarengane, na ko kazaguhunga.
Mwana wanjye, ntugatere imbuto mu mabimba y’akarengane,kuko wazagasarura incuro ndwi.
Ntugasabe Uhoraho ngo akugire igikomerezwa,n’umwami ntukamushakeho intebe y’icyubahiro.
Ntukigire intungane imbere y’Uhoraho,cyangwa ngo wigire umunyabuhanga imbere y’umwami.
Uzirinde kuba umucamanza,hato utazananirwa guhashya akarengane,maze ukabura umurava kubera gutinya abakomeye.
Ntuzahemukire ikoraniro ry’umugi,cyangwa ngo witeshe agaciro imbere ya rubanda.
Ntukongere icyaha mu kindi,kuko nta na kimwe utazaherwa igihano.
Ntuzibwire ngo «Ubwinshi bw’ibitambo byanjyebizanyura Uhoraho Umusumbabyose, bimwurure.»
Ntukabe ikigwari mu masengesho yawe,kandi ntukiyibagize gufasha abakene.
Ntugaseke umuntu washavuye ku mutima,kuko gucisha bugufi abantu no kubakuza bifite Nyirabyo.
Ntuzaremere ibinyoma umuvandimwe wawe,kandi uzirinde no kubeshyera incuti.
Uzirinde ikinyoma cyaguturukaho,nta kamaro kigira na busa.
Ntugasakuze mu ikoraniro ry’abasheshe akanguhe,kandi nusenga, ntugasukiranye amagambo.
Ntukange imirimo inaniza,habe n’uwo guhinga imirima, wagenwe n’Umusumbabyose.
Ntukishyire mu rugaga rw’abanyabyaha,ujye wibuka ko uburakari bw’Uhoraho budaheranwa.
Jya wicisha bugufi ukomeje,kuko umuriro n’inyo ari byo gihano cy’utemera.
Ntuzagurane incuti feza,cyangwa ngo umuvandimwe w’ukuri umugurane zahabu ya Ofiri.
Ntugahunge umugore mwiza kandi w’umunyamwete,kuko ubugwaneza bwe buruta zahabu.
Ntugatoteze umugaragu ukorana umurava,cyangwa umucancuro witanga wese.
Uzakunde umucakara w’umunyabwenge,woye kumwima uburenganzira afite bwo kwicungura.
heading: Ababyeyi n’abana

text: Niba ufite amatungo, ujye uyaragira,kandi agufitiye akamaro, uyakomereho.
Niba ufite abana, jya ubahana,kandi kuva mu buto bwabo, ubatoze kutarega ijosi.
Niba ufite abakobwa, ujye wita ku mubiri wabo,kandi wirinde kujya uhora ubasekera.
Nushyingira umukobwa wawe, uzaba ugeze ku gikorwa nyacyo,ariko uzamuhe umugabo uzi ubwenge.
Niba ufite umugore ukunyura umutima, ntuzamusende,ariko niba wumva umwishisha, ntuzamwizere.
Uzahimbaze so n’umutima wawe wose,kandi ntuzibagirwe ibise bya nyoko.
Ujye wibuka ko bakubyaye,ubwo se wagenza ute ngo ubiture ibyo bagukoreye?
heading: Kubaha abaherezabitambo

text: Jya utinya Uhoraho n’umutima wawe wose,wubahe n’abaherezabitambo be.
Uzakunde Uwakuremye n’imbaraga zawe zose,kandi woye gutererana ibyegera bye.

Uzatinye Uhoraho, kandi uhe icyubahiro umuherezabitambo,maze umuhe umugabane we nk’uko byategetswe,ari byo umuganura ku byo wejeje,ibyatuweho igitambo cyo kwigorora,ituro ry’inkoro, ibyatuweho igitambo cy’ubutungane,n’ibindi byose bigerurwa ku maturo matagatifu.
heading: Abakene n’abatishoboye

text: No ku bakene, jya utanga utitangiriye itama,kugira ngo usenderezwe imigisha.
Ubuntu bwawe bujye bugera ku bazima bose,abapfuye na bo ntukabime ineza yawe.
Ntugatererane abarira,kandi ujye ushyigikira abashavuye.
Ntugatinye gusura umuntu urwaye,ibikorwa nk’ibyo bizaguhesha igikundiro.

Mu migenzereze yawe yose ujye uzirikana amaherezo yawe,bityo nta bwo uzigera ucumura.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 7: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ntuzatongane n’umuntu w’igikomerezwa,hato atazavaho aguhitana.
heading: Ubwitonzi mu mibanire n’abantu

text: Ntuzatongane n’umukire,atazavaho akuganjisha igitugu,kuko zahabu yaroshye benshi,inarindagiza imitima y’abami.
Ntuzatongane n’umunyarusaku,kandi umuriro wagutwika ntukawongeremo inkwi.
Ntuzashyengere umupfayongo,hato atazasuzugura abasokuruza bawe.
Ntuzatwame umunyabyaha wicuza,wibuke ko twese nta we udacumura.
Ntuzasuzugure ugeze mu zabukuru,kuko ahari natwe tuzasaza.
Ntukishimire ko hari uwapfuye,ujye uzirikana ko twese ari yo maherezo.
Ntugasuzugure ikiganiro cy’abanyabuhanga,kandi ujye uzirikana ubutitsa imigani baciye;kuko ari bo uzakomoraho ubumenyi,n’ubushobozi bwo gukorera abakomeye.
Ntukihunze ikiganiro cy’abasaza,kuko na bo baba barigiye kuri ba se;ni bo uzacaho ubwengen’ubushobozi bwo gusubiza neza mu gihe kiboneye.
Ntuzakongeze umuriro w’umunyabyaha,hato utazavaho witwikira mu kibatsi cyawo.
Ntukagume imbere y’umunyagasuzuguro,kuko icyakuva mu kanwa cyose, yakigutegesha.
Ntuzagurize ukurusha ubushobozi,kandi nugira uwo uguriza, ujye umenya ko uhombye.
Ntuzishingire ibirenze ubushobozi bwawe,kandi niwishingira ujye wibuka kwishyura.
Ntuzaburane n’umucamanza,kuko icyubahiro cye kizatuma bamubera.
Ntuzagendane n’imparamagara hato atazagukoraho,kuko azakora ibimuje mu mutwe,maze ubusazi bwe bubarohe mwembi.
Ntuzatongane n’umunyamushiha,ntimuzagendane mu butayu,kuko kumena amaraso atabikangwa;yazagutsinda aho utagira kivurira.
Ntuzajye inama n’umupfayongo,kuko atazashobora kuzigama ibanga ryawe.
Ikigomba kuba ibanga ntukagikorere imbere y’umunyamahanga,kuko utaba uzi akazamuvamo.

Ntuzahishurire umutima wawe ubonetse wese,kuko atabigushimira.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 8: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ntugafuhire umugore uguherereye,atazakurizaho kukugirira nabi.
heading: Kwitondera abagore

text: Ntuzitegeze umugore ubonetse wese,hato atazavaho akunyunyuza imitsi.
Ntuzegere umugore w’indaya,wakurizaho kugwa mu mitego ye.
Ntuzatindane n’umuririmbyikazi,utazafatirwa mu bishuko bye.
Ntuzarangamire umukobwa w’inkumi,hato mutazahanirwa hamwe.
Ntuzigabize abagore b’indaya,wabatsemberaho umurage wawe.
Ntukarangaguzwe mu mayira y’umugi,cyangwa ngo ubungabunge mu duce twawo twiherereye.
Amaso yawe uzayarinde umugore mwiza,woye kuyatumbira uburanga bw’umuvantarakazi;uburanga bw’umugore bwarindagije benshi,n’urukundo ruhagurumanira nk’umuriro.
Uramenye ntukicare iruhande rw’umugore ufite umugabo,ntimuzasangire divayi mu birori,hato umutima wawe utazamurarikira,maze watwarwa, ukagana inzira ikuroha.
heading: Imibanire y’abagabo

text: Ntuzate incuti mumaranye igihe,kuko ije vuba, itaba iyigejejeho.incuti ije vuba ni nka divayi y’umushyuhira:yireke ibanze ihore, uzayinywa igushimishe!
Ntukagirire ishyari umunyabyaha kubera amahirwe ye,kuko utaba uzi amakuba amutegereje.
Ntugashishikazwe n’ibinyura abatemera,kuko, ndetse no kuri iyi si, batazagenzerezwa nk’intungane.

Ujye ugendera kure umuntu ushobora kwica,bityo ntuzaterwa impungenge n’urupfu.Numwegera, ujye wirinda kumukosereza,hato atazagutesha ubugingo.Ubimenye, hari imitego myinshi igukikije,kandi umeze nk’umuntu ugenda hejuru y’inkike.
Uzakore uko ushoboye ushyikirane n’abaturanyi bawe,kandi ujye inama n’abanyabuhanga.
Ujye ukunda kuganira n’abanyabwenge,buri gihe muvugane ibyerekeye amategeko y’Umusumbabyose.
Uzajye usangira n’intungane,ushakire ishema mu gutinya Uhoraho.
Ibikozwe n’abanyabukorikori b’abahanga,ntibizabura ababirata,n’umutware wa rubanda azashimwakubera amagambo ye yuje ubwitonzi.

Umugabo w’inzimuzi aba gitinywa mu mugi we,kandi amagambo y’umupfayongo amutera icyangiro.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 9: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Umutware w’umunyabuhanga ajijura imbaga ye,kandi ubutegetsi bw’umunyabwenge burangwa n’umurava.
heading: Abategetsi

text: Uko umutegetsi ateye, ni na ko ibyegera bye bimera,imyifatire y’umutware w’umugi, ni yo abaturage bakurikiza.
Umwami w’injiji aroha imbaga ye,kandi umugi ukomezwa n’ubwenge bw’abawutegeka.
Ingoma zose zo ku isi ziri mu kiganza cy’Uhoraho,iyo igihe kigeze, azihitiramo uzazigirira akamaro.
Amahirwe y’umuntu ari mu kiganza cy’Uhoraho,ni we umutegetsi akomoraho ikuzo rye.
heading: Kwirinda ubwirasi

text: Ntuzagirire inzika mugenzi wawe,kabone n’iyo yagucumuraho ate,kandi uzirinde kugira icyo ukorana impirita n’umujinya.
Ubwirasi butera ishozi Uhoraho n’abantu,ari we, ari na bo, banga icyitwa akarengane cyose.
Ubwami buva mu gihugu bujya mu kindi,kubera akarengane, urugomo n’umurengwe n’ubukire.
Umuntu yakwiratana iki kandi ari igitaka n’ivu?N’iyo akiri muzima, amara ye aba yuzuyemo ibyaboze.
Indwara itinze, inanira muganga,uwari umwami none, ejo akazapfa.
Iyo umuntu apfuye, umunani asigaranani imonyo, ibishorobwa n’inyo.
Ubwirasi busatira umuntu iyo yihungije Uhoraho,n’iyo umutima we witanyije n’Uwawuremye.
Koko rero, intangiriro y’ubwirasi ni icyaha,ukihambiriyeho, agusha ishyano;ni yo mpamvu Uhoraho yahanishije ibyago bikomeye abirasi,hanyuma akabatsemba.
Uhoraho yahanantuye abakomeye abakura ku ntebe zabo,yimika abiyoroshya mu mwanya wabo.
Uhoraho yaranduye imizi y’abirasi,ashyira abiyoroshya mu kigwi cyabo.
Uhoraho yarimbuye ibihugu by’abirasi,abiyogoza abihereye ku muzi;
bimwe yabihinduye ubutayu, atsemba abantu baho,maze atuma bibagirana ku isi.
Nta bwo ubwirasi bwaremewe abantu,n’umujinya usenya ntubereye abavuka ku mugore.
heading: Abantu bakwiye icyubahiro, n’abakwiye gusuzugurwa

text: Ubwoko bwubahwa ni ubuhe? Ni ubwa kamere muntu.Ubwoko bwubahwa ni ubuhe? Ni ubw’abatinya Uhoraho.Ubwoko busuzugurwa ni ubuhe? Ni ubwa kamere muntu.Ubwoko busuzugurwa ni ubuhe? Ni ubw’abica amategeko.
Umutware yubahwa mu bavandimwe be,n’abatinya Uhoraho bakubahwa imbere ye.
Ari umukire, ari ikirangirire cyangwa umukene,ishema ryabo bose ni ugutinya Uhoraho.
Ntibiboneye gusuzugura umukene w’umunyabwenge,nk’uko nanone bidakwiye kubahiriza umunyabyaha.
Ibikomerezwa, abacamanza, n’abakire, bose bahabwa ikuzo,ariko muri bo nta we uruta utinya Uhoraho.
Umugaragu w’umunyabuhanga azagaragirwa n’abantu bigenga,kandi nta muntu ujijutse uzabyinubira.
heading: Kwicisha bugufi no kwiyubaha

text: Ntukigire umunyabuhanga igihe uri ku murimo ushinzwe,kandi ntukishimagize ubutindi bwakugarije.
Uwakoranye umwete akaronka ibintu umudendezoaruta ugenda yishongora kandi atagira ikimutunga.
Mwana wanjye, ujye wishimagiza mu rugero,kandi wishime ukurikije icyo wamaze.
Uwiyononera ubwe, ni nde wamushima?Uwisuzugura ubwe, ni nde wamurata?
Umukene ashimirwa ubumenyi bwe,naho umukire agashimirwa umutungo we.

Ushimwa akiri umukene, yakira hacura iki?Uwo basuzugura akize se, nakena ntibazarushaho?Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 10: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ubuhanga bw’umukene bumuhesha ishema,agahabwa icyicaro mu bakomeye.
heading: Isura y’umuntu si wo mutima we

text: Ntuzashimire umuntu uburanga bwe,cyangwa ngo ugire uwo wangira isura ye.
Mu biguruka byose, uruyuki ruri mu bito cyane,ariko ubuki bwarwo ni ubwa mbere mu kuryoha.
Ntukishimagize kubera imyenda wambaye,cyangwa ngo wikuze ku munsi w’amahirwe;kuko ibikorwa by’Uhoraho ari agahebuzo,kandi byihishe abantu.
Benshi mu bakandamijwe bagabanye ingoma,hari n’abambaye ikamba nta wabikekaga.
Benshi mu bakomeye bagushije ishyano,hari n’ab’ibirangirire bategejwe rubanda.
heading: Ubwitonzi mu magambo

text: Ntukagire uwo wamagana utarashishoza,jya ubanza utekereze, ubone gucyaha.
Ntugasubize utarumva neza icyo bavuze,kandi ntukagire uwo uca mu ijambo.
Ntugahinyure ibintu bitakugenewe,kandi ntukicarane n’abanyabyaha ngo mujye inama.
heading: Kwiringira Imana yonyine

text: Mwana wanjye, ntugahagurukire imishinga ikurenze,iyo ikubanye myinshi, ntubura aho ugayirwa;n’iyo wakora impande zose nta bwo wayishyikaho,wanaramuka uyihunze, ntiwazayihonoka.
Hari abantu bakora bakikota, bakaruha,ariko ntibibabuze kurushaho gukena.
Hari n’abanyantege nke bakeneye ubunganira,nta mbaraga bakigira, n’ubutindi bwarabugarije,ariko amaso y’Uhoraho akabarebana impuhwe,akabakura mu kimwaro cyabo,
maze bakegura umutwe,ku buryo abantu benshi babatangarira.
Amahirwe n’ibyago, ubugingo n’urupfu,ubukene n’ubukire, byose bikomoka kuri Uhoraho.
Impano y’Uhoraho ihorana n’abantu bamwemera,kandi ubugwaneza bwe ntibuhwema kubayobora.
Hari n’abakizwa no kwikota n’ubugugu,dore igihembo cyabo uko giteye:
bazibwira ngo «Nabonye agahenge, reka ndye utwanjye»,ariko bazaba bibeshya ku gihe basigaje,urupfu ruzabagwa gitumo, maze byose babisigire abandi.
Ibyo wiyemeje gukora ujye ubitunganyaubikomereho mu buzima bwawe bwose,kandi uzasazire ku murimo wawe.
Ntugatangazwe n’ibikorwa by’umunyabyaha,ujye wiringira Uhoraho ubishyizeho umutima,kuko Uhoraho bitamugoragukiza umukene mu kanya gato.
Umugisha w’Uhoraho, ni cyo gihembo cy’umwiringira,kandi umugisha we usagamba mu mwanya muto.
Ntuzavuge ngo «Ese ubundi nkeneye iki,ibindi bintu ntegereje ni ibihe?»
Ntuzavuge ngo «Mfite ibimpagije,ni ibihe byago se byashobora kungwirira?»
Igihe cy’ihirwe, amakuba aribagirana,igihe cy’amakuba, umunezero na wo ukibagirana;
kuko ku munsi w’imperuka, bizorohera Uhorahokugenzereza buri wese akurikije imyifatire ye.
Isaha imwe y’amakuba yibagiza umunezero,kandi ibikorwa by’umuntu bigaragara arundutse.
Ntuzashime amahirwe y’umuntu akiriho,kuko iyo arundutse, ari ho amenyekana.
heading: Kwirinda umugome

text: Ntukinjize iwawe umuntu ubonetse wese,kuko imitego y’abagome ari myinshi.
Umutima w’umwirasi uhora ubunga,nk’inkware yafatiwe mu rudandi,kandi ahora akureretse, ateze kukurimbura.
Ibyiza abihinduramo ibibi, agakunda gutega imitego,n’ibyari biboneye akabyanduza.
Agashashi k’umuriro kabyara inkongi,n’umuntu w’umunyabyaha atega imitego yica.
Ujye wirinda umugome kuko aba agambiriye ikibi,utinye ko yagusiga ubwandu butazakuvaho.

Nucumbikira umunyamahanga azaguteza impagarara,agomeshe abantu bo mu nzu yawe.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 11: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Nugira neza, jya umenya uwo uyigiriye,maze uziturwe ibyiza wakoze.
heading: Abagiraneza ni bo bakwiye guhabwa

text: Uzagirire neza umuntu wubaha Imana, uzabihemberwa;natayikwitura ubwe, Umusumbabyose azakwitura.
Nta neza ikwiye kugirirwa umuntu wihambira ku kibi,cyangwa uwanga gufasha abakene.
Uzajye uha umuntu utunganira Imana,ariko woye gufasha umunyabyaha.
Uzagirire neza uwicisha bugufi,ariko ugomera Imana ntuzagire icyo umuha.Uzamwime ikimutunga, umutsembere, hato atazakwiganzura,maze ineza yose wamugiriye, ukayihomba kabiri.
Koko rero, n’Umusumbabyose yanga abanyabyaha,kandi azahana abamugomera.
Uzajye uha umugiraneza,ariko woye gufasha umunyabyaha.
heading: Kwirinda abanzi

text: Incuti nyayo wayimenya ute kandi uri mu munezero?umwanzi we ntiyihishira iyo uri mu makuba.
Iyo umuntu anezerewe, abanzi be bahekenya amenyo,naho iyo yasumbirijwe, n’uwari incuti ye aramwigurutsa.
Ntuziringire na rimwe umwanzi wawe,uko ingese ziharura umuringa, ni ko umujinya uba umusya.
N’iyo yakwicisha bugufi akagenda yunamye,umutima wawe uzabe maso umugendere kure.Uzamugenzereze nk’unagura ibyuma,umenye ko ingese ze zitazamubaho akaramata.
Ntuzamwiyegereze, yaguhirika akakwicarira ku ntebe.Ntuzamwicaze iburyo bwawe, yaharanira icyicaro cyawe,icyo gihe wasobanukirwa n’amagambo yanjye,ukicuza icyatumye utayakurikiza.
Ni nde wababazwa n’umuntu wakinishije inzoka ikamuruma,cyangwa n’abakomerekejwe n’inyamaswa ari bo bazitegeje?
Ni kimwe rero n’umuntu wisunga umunyabyaha,akivanga mu bicumuro bye.
Mumarana isaha atuje,ariko wamara kugenda, agatombokwa.
Akanwa k’umwanzi karangwa n’amagambo asize umunyu,ariko mu mutima we, aba agambiriye kukuroha mu rwobo.Umwanzi ahora asa n’ugufitiye impuhwe,ariko iyo aguciye akaho, amaraso yawe ntiyamuhaza.
Amakuba nagutera, uzamubona imbere yawe,yiyerurutse ngo aragufasha, naho aragutega imitego.

Azazunguza umutwe, akome amashyi yishimye,yiyongorere, maze mu maso he hahinduke ukundi.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 12: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ukoze amakakama, aramwanduza,n’ucuditse n’umwirasi, ahinduka nka we.
heading: Kutireshyeshya n’abagusumba

text: Ntukihe umutwaro ukabije kuremera,kandi ntuzacudike n’umuntu ukurusha amaboko n’umutungo.None se ikibindi cy’ibumbacyacudika gite n’ingunguru y’icyuma?Ingunguru yazakigwira, ikakijanjura.
Umukire arenganya abandi akaba ari we urakara!Umukene arakandamizwa, akaba ari we wihohora!
Niba umufitiye akamaro, azakunyunyuza imitsi,ariko iyo nta cyo ukimumariye, aragutererana.
Niba hari icyo utunze, muzabana,akikurireho nta cyo yikanga.
Niba agukeneye azakubeshyabeshya,agusekere kandi akwizeze byinshi,azakubwira amagambo asize umunyu,agira ati «Ese ukeneye iki?»
Azagukoza isoni akoresheje ibirori bye,nawe wikokoreho utwawe, umutumire kabiri cyangwa gatatu,amaherezo ariko azakunnyega, agutererane;nakubona akuzungurize umutwe.
Uritonde, utazavaho ushukwa,ugasuzugurwa kubera ubupfayongo bwawe.
Umukungu nagutumira iwe, ntugahite umwitaba,bityo azongera kugutumira.
Ntugashake kwibonekeza utazavaho wigizwayo,kandi ntukiheze, hato utazibagirana.
Uzirinde kumuvugisha nk’aho mureshya,cyangwa ngo wiringire amagambo ye menshi,kuko, iyo ayadondobekanya, aba ariho akugerageza,agaseka ari na ko akugenzura.
Nta mpuhwe agira, we utazi kwifata mu magambo,kandi ntazitesha kuguhondagura no kukuboha.
Jya witegereza kandi ukenge,kuko ugendana n’urupfu rwawe.
Ikinyabuzima cyose gikunda icyo bimeze kimwe,n’umuntu agakunda mugenzi we.
Ibinyamubiri byose bibana bikurikije ubwoko bwabyo,umuntu na we agasanga mugenzi we.
None se ikirura cyacudika gite n’intama?N’umunyabyaha ntiyacudika n’umuntu ukunda Imana.
Ni ayahe mahoro yaba hagati y’impyisi n’imbwa?Ni ayahe mahoro yaba hagati y’umukire n’umukene?
Uko indogobe zo mu butayu ziribwa n’intare,ni na ko abakene baribwa n’abakire.
Uko umukire yanga gucishwa bugufi,ni na ko umukire aterwa ishozi n’umukene.
Iyo umukire atsikiye, incuti ze ziramusagasira,naho umukene yagwa, incuti ze zikamutererana.
Umukire iyo anyereye, benshi baza kumutabara,yavuga amahomvu, bakayamushimira,ariko umukene iyo anyereye, baramutonganya,yavuga ukuri, bakamwima umwanya.
Umukire aravuga, bose bagaceceka,ijambo rye bakaryogagiza cyane,umukene yavuga, bati «Uriya ni nde?»yagira icyo atsitaraho, bakamuhutaza.
Ubukire buba bwiza iyo butarangwaho icyaha,naho ubukene buba bubi iyo buvanze n’ubwirasi.
Umutima w’umuntu umuhindura isura,ugatuma mu maso he hacya cyangwa hakijima.

Umutima wishimye urangwa n’isura ikeye,nyamara ushaka guhimba imigani agomba gutekereza cyane.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 13: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Hahirwa umuntu utarigeze acumuza umunwa we,kandi akaba adashengurwa n’agahinda k’ibyaha bye!
heading: Amahirwe y’intungane

text: Hahirwa umuntu udashinjwa n’umutima we,kandi ntabe yarahinyutse mu kwizera kwe!
heading: Ubugugu si bwiza

text: Umuntu uriganya ntaberanye n’ubukire,none se umuntu urarikira, umukiro wamumarira iki?
Uhunika yihotora aba ahunikira abandi,n’umutungo we ni bo uzatengamaza.
Uwigirira nabi se, ni nde yagirira neza?nta n’ubwo azanezezwa n’umutungo we.
Nta muntu mubi nk’uwizonga ubwe,iyo ni yo ngaruka y’ubugome bwe.
Naramuka agize neza, ni uko azaba yacitswe,kandi amaherezo yerura ubugome bwe.
Umuntu ufite ijisho rihora rirarikiye, aba ari mubi,ahunza abantu amaso, akabasuzugura.
Ijisho ry’umunyabugugu ntirinyurwa n’umugabane we,kandi ubuhemu bwumisha umutima.
Umunyabugugu atsimbarara ku mugati,no ku meza ye ukahabura.
Mwana wanjye, uko umutungo wawe ungana kose, ujye wishimisha,kandi umurikire Uhoraho amaturo amukwiriye.
Ujye wibuka ko urupfu rutazatinda,kandi ko utazi igihe uzatabarukira.
Ujye ugirira neza mugenzi wawe utarapfa,kandi umuhe uko ufite utitangiriye itama.
Ntukiheze ku munsi w’ibyishimo,cyangwa ngo wibuze icyo umutima ushaka.
Ese umutungo waruhiye, ntuzawusigira abandi,ibyo wagezeho bakabigabana bakoresheje ubufindo?
Ujye utanga nawe wakire, ushimishe umutima wawe,kuko ikuzimu utazongera kuhashakira amaraha.
Icyitwa umubiri cyose gisaza nk’umwenda,kuko ari ryo tegeko ridakuka: hapfa uwavutse.
Nk’uko ku giti gifite amababi menshi,amwe ahunguka, andi agatoha;no ku bisekuruza by’abantu ni ko bimeze:kimwe kirasaza, ikindi kikavuka.
Igikorwa cy’umuntu icyo ari cyo cyose,kijyana na nyiracyo.
heading: Umunyabuhanga arahirwa

text: Hahirwa umuntu uzirikana ubuhanga,akabutekereza mu bwenge bwe,
kandi agashishikarira amayira yabwo,ngo yibande ku mabanga yabwo!
Abwoma mu nyuma nk’umuhigi,agahora abutegeye mu mayira yabwo yose;
ahengereza mu madirishya yabwo,akumviriza ku miryango yabwo.
Arara hafi y’inzu yabwo,agatera imambo mu nkuta zabwo,
maze akahashinga ihema rye,bityo, agatura iwabo w’amahirwe.
Abana be, abashyira mu gicucu cyabwo,na we akaguma mu nsi y’amashami yabwo,
bukamurinda icyocyere,maze agasangira na bwo ikuzo.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 14: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Utinya Uhoraho ni ko agenza,kandi ukurikiza amategeko yigarurira ubuhanga.
Bumusanganira nk’umubyeyi,bukamwakira nk’umugeni w’isugi,
bukamugaburira umugati w’ubwenge,kandi bukamuhembuza amazi y’ubumenyi.
Arabwishingikiriza, ntadandabirane,abutsimbararaho ntashwarwe.
Buramuzamura agasumba bagenzi be,kandi yagera mu ikoraniro, bukamubumbura umunwa.
Aronka ibyishimo, agasendera umunezero,kandi agahabwa izina ry’ikirangirire ho umurage.
Ibicucu ntibizigera bibutunga,kandi abanyabyaha ntibazabubona na rimwe.
Ubuhanga butura kure y’ubwirasi,kandi abanyabinyoma ntibabutekereza.
Umunyabyaha ntakwiriye kubusingiza,kuko atabugabiwe n’Uhoraho.
Koko rero, ibisingizo biberanye n’umunyabuhanga,kandi Uhoraho ni we abikesha.
heading: Umuntu arigenga

text: Ntukavuge ngo «Uhoraho ni we wanteye gucumura»,kuko icyo yanga atagikora.
Ntuzavuge ngo «Ni we wanyobeje»,kuko umunyabyaha nta cyo yamumarira.
Uhoraho yamagana ibiterashozi byose,kandi nta na kimwe muri byo gikundwa n’abamutinya.
Mu ntangiriro, ni we waremye muntu,amwegurira umutimanama we.
Nubishaka, uzakurikiza amategeko,ukorane umurava ikimushimisha.
Yagushyize imbere umuriro n’amazi,aho uzahitamo, ni ho uzerekeza ikiganza.
Imbere y’abantu hari ubuzima n’urupfu,kandi buri wese azahabwa ikimunyuze.
Koko rero, ubuhanga bw’Uhoraho ni bwinshi,ni Umushoborabyose kandi abona byose.
Amaso ye ayahoza ku bamwubaha,kandi we ubwe azi ibyo abantu bakora byose.

Nta we yigeze ategeka kuba umuhakanyi,kandi nta n’uwo yahaye uburenganzira bwo gucumura.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 15: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ntukifuze kugira abana benshi b’imburamumaro,kandi ntugashimishwe no kugira abana b’abahakanyi.
heading: Abana b’abahakanyi

text: N’aho bangana iki, ntukishimeniba nta gitinyiro cy’Uhoraho baranganwa.
Ntukishinge igihe bazamara ku isi,kandi ntukiringire umubare wabo,kuko umwe mwiza aruta benshi,no gupfa bucike, bikaruta kubyara abahakanyi.
Koko rero, umunyabwenge umwe atuma umugi utunganirwa,naho umuryango w’ibyigenge ukarimbuka.
heading: Igihano cy’abanyabyaha

text: Amaso yanjye yabonye byinshi nk’ibi,amatwi yanjye yumva ibikabije kurushaho.
Umuriro wakiye mu ikoraniro ry’abanyabyaha,uburakari bw’Uhoraho bugurumanira inyoko y’abagome.
Ntiyigeze ababarira ibihangange bya kerabyamwivumbuyeho byishimye imbaraga zabyo.
Ntiyababariye umugi Loti yari atuyemo,bamuteraga ishozi kubera ubwirasi bwabo.
Ntiyagiriye impuhwe umuryango warohamye,ukiratana ibyaha byawo.
Nta n’ubwo yababariye ba bantu ibihumbi magana atandatu,bigometse bakanangira umutima wabo.
Ndetse n’iyo haza gusigara umugome umwe,byari kuba igitangaza iyo adahanwa;yego, Uhoraho arangwa n’impuhwe, ariko akanarakara,agira imbabazi nyinshi, ariko ntabuze n’umujinya.
Kubabarira kwe no guhana, byombi birangana,azacira urubanza muntu akurikije ibikorwa bye.
Umunyabyaha ntazacikana ibyibano bye,kandi n’uwihanganye akemera Imana ntazamwarwa.
Uhoraho azita ku neza yose,buri wese ahabwe ibihwanye n’ibikorwa bye.
Ntuzibwire ngo «Nzihisha Uhoraho,mu ijuru hariya, ni nde uzibuka ko mbaho?Sinzamenyekana muri rubanda nyamwinshi,ese ubundi, ndi iki mu byaremwe byose?»
Itegereze urebe ijuru n’ubushorishori bwaryo,inyenga n’isi birarindimuka iyo Uhoraho abyegereye;
yareba imisozi n’inkingi z’isi,bigahinda umushyitsi, bigashya ubwoba.
Nyamara ibyo byose, umutima ntubitekereza,n’inzira z’Uhoraho nta we ukizitaho.
Nk’uko umuyaga w’inkubi nta we uwubona,n’ibyinshi mu bikorwa bye ntibigaragara.
Ibikorwa by’ubutungane bwe, ni nde ubyamamaza,cyangwa ni nde ubitegereje?
Ariko umupfayongo aribwira ati«Isezerano rye ryaribagiranye!»Nguko uko umuntu w’igicucu n’uw’indindagire batekereza,bo bihambira ku mateshwa yabo.
heading: Uhoraho ni we waremye ibiriho

text: Tega amatwi, mwana wanjye, ngutoze ubumenyi,kandi uzirikane amagambo yanjye mu mutima wawe;
Nzaguhishurira ubumenyi nitonze,nkumenyeshe ubwenge uko buri kose.
Mu ntangiriro, Uhoraho yahanze ibiremwa bye,ahita abigenera umwanya ubikwiye.
Ibyo mu kirere abitunganyiriza inzira,bizahora bikurikira uko ibisekuru bisimburana.Nta bwo byigera byumva inzara cyangwa umunaniro,kandi ntibihagarika na rimwe umurimo wabyo.
Nta na kimwe kigongana n’ikindi,kandi ntibyigera bisuzugura ijambo rye.
Nyuma y’ibyo Uhoraho yitegereje isi,ayisenderezaho ibyiza bye;

yayihundajeho ibinyabuzima by’amoko yose,kandi ni yo bizasubiramo.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 16: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Uhoraho yabumbye muntu mu gitaka,kandi ni cyo azamusubizamo.
heading: Iremwa rya muntu

text: Yageneye abantu iminsi n’igihe byo kubaho,kandi abaha ububasha ku biri ku isi byose.
Yabahaye imbaraga nk’ize,abarema mu ishusho rye.
Ibinyamubiri byose yabitegetse kubatinya,kugira ngo bagenge inyoni n’ibisimba byo mu ishyamba.
Yabahaye ururimi, amaso n’amatwi,ndetse n’umutima wo gutekereza.
Yabasenderejemo ubumenyi n’ubwenge,abasobanurira ikibi n’icyiza.
Yashyize urumuri rwe mu mitima yabo,kugira ngo abereke agaciro k’ibiremwa bye,
bityo bahimbaze izina rye ritagatifu,kandi bamamaze ibikorwa bye by’agatangaza.
heading: Isezerano

text: Yabahaye kandi ubumenyi,abagabira n’itegeko ribeshaho.
Yagiranye na bo isezerano rihoraho,abahishurira amabwiriza ye.
Amaso yabo yabonye ububengerane bw’ikuzo rye,amatwi yabo yumva ijwi rye ritagereranywa.
Yarababwiye ati «Mujye mwirinda ubuhemu ubwo ari bwo bwose»,kandi buri muntu amuha amategeko yerekeye mugenzi we.
heading: Ubutabera n’impuhwe z’Imana

text: Inzira zabo zihora imbere ye,ntizigera zihisha amaso ye.
Buri gihugu yagihaye umutware,ariko Israheli yo ni umugabane w’Uhoraho.
Ibikorwa byabo byose bimuhora imbere nk’izuba,kandi amaso ye ahora ayahanze inzira zabo.
Ubuhemu bwabo ntibumwihisha,ibyaha byabo byose bihora imbere y’Uhoraho.
Umuntu ugiriye neza mugenzi we,Uhoraho amushyiraho ikimenyetso kidasibangana,azahora amwitaho nk’imboni z’amaso ye.
Hanyuma azahaguruka abahembe,ishimwe ryabo arishyire ku mutwe wabo.
Naho abicuza, abaha kwisubiraho,kandi agatera inkunga abagishidikanya.
heading: Ukwicuza

text: Garukira Uhoraho wange ibyaha,iyambaze uruhanga rwe ureke kumucumuraho.
Garukira Umusumbabyose, wiyame ubuhemu,kandi wamaganire kure igiterashozi cyose.
Mu by’ukuri se, hari uwasingiriza Uhoraho ikuzimu,mu kigwi cy’abazima batamusenga?
Uwapfuye hari uwo yashobora kurata kandi aba atakiriho?Ufite amagara n’ubugingo ni we usingiza Uhoraho.
Urukundo rw’Uhoraho ni rwinshi,kandi impuhwe agirira abamugarukira ntizigira ingano!
Koko rero, umuntu ntashobora gutunga byose,kuko mwene muntu adahoraho iteka.
Ni iki kirusha izuba kumurika?Ariko na ryo rirahumba!Naho se ku muntu ugizwe n’umubiri n’amaraso,agaharanira ikibi, hazacura iki?

Izuba ryo risumba ingabo zose zo mu kirere,naho abantu, bose ni igitaka n’ivu.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 17: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Iyakare yaremye byose mu buryo bumwe.
heading: Ububasha n’impuhwe z’Imana

text: Uhoraho wenyine ni we uzitwa intungane.
Nta muntu yigeze ashinga kwamamaza ibikorwa bye,ni nde wacengera ubuhangange bwe?
Imbaraga n’icyubahiro bye ni nde wabibara?Ni nde washobora kurondora impuhwe ze?
Nta cyo umuntu yagabanyaho, nta n’icyo yakongeraho;ntibishoboka gusobanukirwa n’ibitangaza by’Uhoraho.
Iyo umuntu yibwira ko abirangije, ni ho aba akibitangira,kandi iyo ahagaze gato, yibaza aho yari ageze.
Umuntu ni iki? Ese amaze iki?Mbese icyamubera cyiza cyangwa kibi, ni ikihe?
Umubare w’iminsi umuntu abaho nturenga imyaka ijana.
Utwaka twe duke mu bihe by’iteka,twagereranywa n’agatonyanga k’amazi mu nyanja,cyangwa n’akabuye k’umusenyi.
Ni yo mpamvu Uhoraho abihanganira,akabasenderezaho impuhwe ze.
Aritegereza, kandi azi ko amaherezo yabo ari amakuba,na we akongera impuhwe ze.
Impuhwe za muntu zigaragarira kuri mugenzi we,naho iz’Uhoraho zigaragarira ku kinyamubiri cyose.Aracyaha, agahana, akigisha,maze agacyamura ubushyo bwe nk’umushumba.
Agirira impuhwe abakira inyigisho,hamwe n’abitabira amategeko ye.
heading: Kumenya gutanga

text: Mwana wanjye, ineza yawe ntukayigerekeho incyuro,kandi ibyo utanze ntukabyongereho gucunaguza.
Ese urume ntirucubya umuyaga wumisha imyaka?Ni na ko ijambo ryiza riruta icyo utanze.
Ntubona se ko ijambo ryiza riruta amaturo yose?Kandi byombi biranga umugiraneza.
Umupfayongo yamagana umukene nta cyo amuhaye,kandi umunyerari ariza uwo yagabiye.
heading: Guteganya no kwitonda

text: Mbere yo kuvuga jya ubanza usobanuze,kandi ujye kwivuza indwara itarakurembya.
Mbere y’uko bagucira urubanza, jya ubanza wisuzume,bityo igihe bazakugenderera, uzababarirwa.
Jya wicisha bugufi mbere y’uko urwara,kandi nugwa mu cyaha, wicuze!
Icyo warahiriye jya ugikorera igihe,kandi ntugategereze urupfu kugira ngo witunganye.
Mbere yo gutangaza umuhigo, jya ubanza witegure,ntukabe nk’umuntu ushuka Uhoraho.
Ujye wibuka uburakari bw’iminsi y’imperuka,wibuke n’igihano urindiriye, Uhoraho naguhunza amaso.
Mu gihe cy’umwijuto ujye wibuka inzara,maze mu minsi y’ubukire, uzirikane ubukene n’ubutindi.
Kuva mu museso kugeza nimugoroba, igihe kirahindagurika,ibintu byose biyoyoka vuba imbere y’Uhoraho.
Umunyabwenge ahora akenga,iminsi y’ibyaha yagera, akirinda gucumura.
Umuntu uzi ubwenge aba asobanukiwe n’ubuhanga,akamenya no gushima ababuronse bose.
Abavugana ubwenge, ubwabo ni abahanga,ni bo baca imigani y’inshoberamahanga.
heading: Kwirinda irari ry’ibintu

text: Ntukishinge irari ry’ibintu rikurimo,ujye wikuramo umururumba.
Niwemera umutima wawe ukicwa n’irari ry’ibintu,rizaguha amenyo y’abasetsi.
Ntukishimire kurohama mu maraha,maze ngo wizirike ku bayaharanira.

Ntukikeneshe uguza ngo ukunde ujye mu birori,kandi mu bubiko bwawe nta na mba ufite.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 18: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Umukozi w’umusinzi azicwa n’ubutindi,usuzugura utuntu duto buhoro buhoro arakena.
Divayi n’abagore birindagiza abanyabwenge,uwishinga indaya na we, ntakimutera isoni;
azaribwa n’inyo n’ibishorobwa,kandi icyihebe kizatsembwa.
heading: Kwirinda uburondogozi

text: Upfa kwizera uwo abonye aba ari umupfu,kandi ucumura, ni we ubwe uba yihemukiye.
Uwishimira ikibi, azahanwa,
naho uwanga uburondogozi aba yikijije icyago.
Ntukamene ibanga, utazabiryozwa;
yaba incuti cyangwa umwanzi, ntuzagire uwo uribwira,keretse wenda niba byagutera gucumura,naho ubundi ntuzarihishure.
Yego, bagutega amatwi, ariko bakakugendera kure,maze igihe cyagera bakakwanga urunuka.
Nugira icyo wumva, kizaguheremo;humura! Si byo bizatuma uturika!
Igicucu gipfa kumva akajambo ntikibe kicyifashe,boshye umugore uri ku nda.
Ijambo riri mu nda y’igicucu,risa nk’umwambi watebeye mu kibero.
heading: Kutihutira gucira urubanza mugenzi wawe

text: Jya ubanza usobanuze mugenzi wawe,kuko wenda aba nta cyo yakoze,kandi niba yaranagikoze, ntazasubira.
Jya ubanza usobanuze mugenzi wawe,kuko wenda aba nta cyo yavuze,kandi niba yaranakivuze, ntazabyongera.
Jya ubanza usobanuze mugenzi wawe,kuko abantu bakunda gusebanya,kandi ntukishinge ibyo abantu bavuga.
Hariho utsikira atabigambiriye;ese ubundi ni nde utaracumura n’ururimi rwe?
Jya ubanza usobanuze mugenzi wawe mbere yo kumutugarika,bityo uzaba ukurikije itegeko ry’Umusumbabyose.
heading: Ubuhanga nyakuri

text: Ubuhanga bwose ni ugutinya Uhoraho,kandi ubuhanga bwose bujyana no kubaha itegeko.
Kumenyera ikibi si bwo buhanga,kandi inama z’abanyabyaha ntiziranganwa ubwitonzi.
Hari ubwenge bukora ishyano,kandi ubuze ubuhanga aba ari igicucu.
Umuntu ufite ubwenge buke ariko agatinya,aruta uwuzuye ubwitonzi agaca ku mategeko.
Hari ubwenge buhambaye ariko bukarangwa no kuriganya,nyirabwo, iyo ashaka kuburana ibye, akoresha ubuhemu.
Hari n’ugenda ashengurwa n’agahinda,ariko mu mutima we huzuye amariganya:
yubika amaso, akica amatwi,utamutahura, akakuyogoza;
imbaraga ze nke ni zo zimubuza guhemuka,ariko yabona uburyo agacumura.
Koko indoro y’umuntu ni yo imuranga,umunyabwenge umumenya mushyikiranye;

umwambaro w’umuntu, inseko ye,emwe n’ingendo ye byerekana uko ateye.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 19: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Hari ucunaguza umuntu ariko bidakwiye,kandi uwicecekeye akenshi agaragaraho ubwenge.
heading: Kumenya umwanya wo kuvuga n’uwo guceceka

text: Gucunaguza umuntu biruta kumugirira uburakari budashira.
Uwemeye ibicumuro bye aba akize umugayo.
Uwirata ko azarenganura abandi akoresheje igitugu,asa n’ikiremba cyasamariye kurongora inkumi.
Uwicecekera agaragaraho ubuhanga,naho umunyarusaku atera ishozi.
Hari uwicecekera kuko nta gisubizo afite,hakaba n’uwicecekera ateze umwanya ukwiye.
Umunyabuhanga araceceka agategereza umwanya uboneye,naho umwirasi n’igicucu ubacika bawubona.
Ugenzwa n’amagambo aragayika,kandi ukoresha igitugu arangwa.
heading: Iby’isi ni amabanga

text: Hari ubwo umuntu yungukira mu byago,ubundi agahombera aho yari ateze umukiro.
Hari ibyo utanga bikakubera imfabusa,ariko hakaba n’ibyo utanga bikakugarukira incuro ebyiri.
Hari umugayo uturuka ku ikuzo,hakabaho n’abegura umutwe nyuma yawo.
Bamwe bibwira ko baguze ibintu ku giciro gito,nyamara babihenzweho ukubye karindwi.
Umunyabuhanga bamukundira amagambo ye,ariko amashyengo y’ibicucu abipfira ubusa.
Ibyo umupfayongo azaguha, nta cyo bizakumarira,kuko aba aguhanze amaso, agutegerejeho ibirenze;
atanga bike, ariko akabigucyurira cyane,agenda avuza induru nk’umumotsi,atiza none, ejo agatiruza;umuntu nk’uwo akwiye kwangwa!
Umupfayongo aravuga ati «Nta ncuti ngira,ineza yanjye nta we uyinshimira;
abarya ibyanjye ntibajya bamvuga neza.»Ariko se, ni kangahe aba yihaye amenyo y’abasetsi?
heading: Imigani inyuranye

text: Kunyerera ku mbuga biruta kunyerera mu mvugo;ni yo mpamvu abagiranabi barimbuka vuba.
Umuntu w’ikiburaburyo avuga ibiterekeranye,bidatana n’akanwa k’injiji.
Umugani uvuye mu kanwa k’igicucu ntiwemerwa,kuko kitawucira igihe.
Hari uwo ubutindi bubuza gucumura,maze yaruhuka, ntagire icyo yicuza.
Hari uyoba kubera gutinya amaso y’abandi,akagendanirako kubera isoni atewe n’igicucu kimubangamiye.
Ipfunwe ritera umuntu kwizeza mugenzi we ibidashoboka,akaba yikururiye atyo umwanzi bigezo.
Ikinyoma ni umwanda uhindanya umuntu,kandi ntikiva ku munwa w’injiji.
Igisambo kiruta umubeshyi,ariko bombi umurage bazahabwa ni ukurimbuka.
Imyifatire y’umubeshyi itesha agaciro,kandi ikimwaro ntikimuvaho.
Amagambo y’umunyabuhanga amuteza imbere,kandi umuntu ushyira mu gaciro anyura abategetsi.
Uhinga imirima agira ikirundo cy’ingano,unyura abategetsi ababarirwa amakosa ye.
Amaturo y’amoko yose ahuma amaso y’abanyabuhanga,agafunga umunwa wabo, ntibashobore kugira uwo batonganya.
Ubuhanga bwihishe n’umutungo utagaragara,byombi bimaze iki?
Umuntu uhisha ubucucu bwearuta uhisha ubuhanga bwe.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 20: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Mwana wanjye se, waba waracumuye? Ntuzongere,ahubwo usabe imbabazi z’ibyaha wakoze.
heading: Guhunga icyaha

text: Jya uhunga icyaha nk’uko uhunga inzoka,kuko nucyegera, kizakuruma;amenyo yacyo ni nk’ay’intareacuza abantu ubuzima.
Ubuhemu bwose, ni nk’inkota ityaye impande zombi,kandi igikomere cyabwo nticyomorwa.
Ubwirasi no kwikuza bihombya umutungo,bityo rero inzu y’umwirasi izarimbuka.
Isengesho riva mu kanwa k’umukene, Uhoraho araryumva,na we akamuha igisubizo bwangu.
Uwanga guhanwa agenda mu nzira z’umunyabyaha,ariko utinya Uhoraho yisubiraho mu mutima we.
Indondogozi yigaragariza kure,ariko umunyabwenge amenya ko yayobye.
Uwubakisha inzu ye feza z’abandi,asa n’urunda amabuye ateganyiriza imva ye.
Ikoraniro ry’ibyigenge riba ari nk’inkwi zumye,bose bazakongokera mu kibatsi cy’umuriro.
Inzira y’abanyabyaha iratengeneje, nta buye ririmo,ariko amaherezo yayo ni mu nyenga y’ikuzimu.
heading: Umunyabuhanga n’igicucu

text: Ukurikiza itegeko, arwanya irari rye ribi,kandi gutinya Uhoraho bivamo ubuhanga.
Umuntu utazi ubwenge ntashobora kwigishwa,ariko hariho n’ubwenge bugusha mu gahinda.
Ubumenyi bw’umunyabuhanga ni nk’amasumo adakama,kandi inama ze ni isoko y’ubuzima.
Umutima w’igicucu ni nk’ikibindi cyamenetse,nta bumenyi na buke buwugumamo.
Iyo umunyabwenge yumvise ijambo ryuje ubuhanga,ararishima kandi akongeraho irye;nyamara iyo icyohe kiryumvise, kirarizinukwa,kikarijugunya inyuma yacyo.
Amagambo y’igicucu araremera nk’umuzigo w’umugenzi,ariko umunwa w’umunyabwenge urangwa n’ineza.
Imvugo y’umunyabwenge iba ikenewe mu ikoraniro,n’amagambo ye, buri wese ayazirikana mu mutima we.
Ubuhanga bw’igicucu ni nk’inzu yasenyutse,n’ubumenyi bw’imburabwenge bukaba amahomvu.
Igicucu cyibwira ko kwitonda ari ukwihambira amaguru,cyangwa kwizirika ikiganza cy’iburyo.
Igicucu iyo giseka, cyatura ijwi,ariko umunyabwenge akamwenyura yihoreye.
Umuntu uteganya, ubwitonzi bumubera nk’umutako wa zahabuakabwambara nk’igitare ku kaboko k’iburyo.
Igicucu cyihutira kwiroha mu nzu,naho umuntu wiyubashye avunyishiriza kure.
Umupfayongo ahengeza mu nzu akiri ku muryango,naho umuntu wiyubashye aba agumye hanze.
Kumviriza ku muryango ni uburere buke,kandi umuntu uzi ubwenge bimutera isoni.
Umunwa w’indondogozi usukagura amagambo adahwitse,ariko abanyabwenge babanza kuyatekereza bitonze.
Umutima w’ibicucu uba mu kanwa kabo,naho umunwa w’abanyabuhanga ukaba mu mutima wabo.
Iyo umugome avuma Sekibi,ni we ubwe uba yivuma.
Inzimuzi irisebya ubwayo,ikiyangisha mu baturanyi.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 21: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Umunebwe asa n’ibuye bikuruseho,bose bamuha induru yo kumunnyega.
heading: Umunebwe

text: Umunebwe asa n’ikirundo cy’imyanda,umuteruye wese akunguta intoki.
heading: Abana babi

text: Umugabo ubyaye umuhungu w’injiji bimutera isoni,ariko iyo ari umukobwa ni we ubwe wisebya.
Umukobwa w’umunyamutima aronka umugabo,naho ushira isoni atera agahinda uwamubyaye.
Umugore w’inshinzi akoza isoni se n’umugabo we,maze bombi bakamugaya.
Imvugo itaziye igihe isa no kwigamba k’uwapfushije,ariko umunyafu n’igihano bihora ari isoko y’ubuhanga.
heading: Igicucu kigomba gufatwa gite?

text: Kwigisha igicucu ni nko gusubiranya injyo,cyangwa gukangura uwazitswe n’ibitotsi.
Uganira n’igicucu aba avugana n’usinziriye:Iyo barangije kiramubaza kiti «Harya twavugaga iki?»
Jya uririra umupfu, aba yabuze urumuri burundu,jya uririra igicucu, kiba cyarabuze ubwenge.Uwapfuye jya umuririra buke, aba yabonye uburuhukiro,ariko kubaho kw’igicucu, birutwa no gupfa kikavaho.
Kwiraburira uwapfuye bimara iminsi irindwi,ku gicucu n’umugomeramana bo,bimara iminsi y’ubuzima bwose.
Ntukavugane menshi n’igicucu,kandi ntukisunge umuntu w’injiji.Uzamugendere kure, bizakurinda ingorane,bityo ntuzandura ngo wamwegereye.Uzamwirinde, uzaruhuka,kandi ubucucu bwe ntibuzagutera ingorane.
Ni iki kiremera kurusha intosho?Izina ryacyo se ryaba irihe, atari ikiburabwenge.
Umusenyi, umunyu n’ibyuma,bitwarika kurusha umuntu w’igicucu.
Ibiti bikoze igisenge cy’inzu,nta bwo bitandukanywa n’umutingito w’isi;ni kimwe n’umutima uzirikana umugambi wizwe neza,nta bwo uzaba ikigwari igihe nikigera.
Umutima wishingikirije icyemezo cy’ukuri,usa n’isima ivanze n’umusenyi ku rukuta runogereje.
Nk’uko inkingi ziteye hejuru y’umusozi,zihungabanywa n’umuyaga,ni na ko umutima w’ikigwari utekereza amafuti,ugahungabanywa n’ubwoba ubwo ari bwo bwose.
heading: Ubucuti

text: Utokoje ijisho, arivusha amarira,yakangara umutima ugahishura ibitekerezo byawo.
Uteye ibuye inyoni, arazirukana,uhemukiye incuti aba yishe umubano.
Niba warageze incuti yawe inkota,ntukihebe, mushobora kwigorora.
Niba waravuze incuti yawe nabi,ntukihebe, mushobora kuziyunga;ariko rero incuti yose izaguhunga,niba uri umunyarugomo, umwirasi, inzimuzi cyangwa mariganya.
Jya utera mugenzi wawe kukwizera akiri umukene,bityo, namara gutengamara, muzanezerwa hamwe.Naba ari mu gahinda, uzamugume iruhande,kugira ngo, igihe azahabwa umurage, nawe uzagabane.
Umuriro wo mu ziko ubanzirizwa n’ubushyuhe n’umwotsi,kimwe n’uko mbere yo kumena amaraso, habanza ibitutsi.
Sinaterwa isoni no kurengera incuti,kandi nzanga kuyihisha ngo itambona;
bityo ningira ibyago ari yo biturutseho,uzabimenya wese azayirinda.
heading: Kuba maso

text: Ni nde uzagenzura ururimi rwanjye,umunwa wanjye akawutoza kwitonda,kugira ngo bitambera impamvu yo gutsitara,n’imvugo yanjye ikandoha?Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 22: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Uhoraho, mubyeyi kandi mutegeka w’ubuzima bwanjye,ntuntererane mu manjwe y’umunwa wanjye,ntiwemere ko antera kuyoba.
Ni nde uzagorora ibitekerezo byanjye,n’umutima wanjye akawutoza ubuhanga,kugira ngo ndatsimbarara ku mafuti y’ubujiji,cyangwa nkihanganira ibyaha byanjye,
kugira ngo ibicumuro byanjye bitiyongera,ibyaha byanjye bikagwira,bityo nkagwa imbere y’ababisha,abanzi banjye bakampa urw’amenyo?
Uhoraho, mubyeyi kandi Mana y’ubuzima bwanjye,undinde kugira amaso arebana ubwirasi,
kandi irari ry’ibintu uryigize kure yanjye.
Singatwarwe n’icyitwa ubusambanyi cyose,kandi ntukantererane mu byifuzo byanjye bibi.
heading: Kwitondera indahiro

text: Bana banjye, nimwumve inyigisho yerekeye imvugo yanyu;uzayikurikiza nta bwo azakorwa n’ikimwaro.
Umunyabyaha afatwa n’amagambo ye ubwe,usebanya n’umwirasi na bo bakagwa mu mutego wayo.
Umunwa wawe, ntukawumenyereze indahiro,ntugahoze mu kanwa izina rya Nyir’ubutungane!
Koko rero, nk’uko umukozi uhora agenzurwaatabura icyo akemangwaho,n’udahwema kurahira no kuvuga izina ry’Uhorahontashobora kubura icyaha.

Umuntu ukunda kurahira, aba yuzuye uburiganya,kandi icyorezo gihora cyugarije inzu ye.Iyo atubahirije indahiro, icyaha kiramuhama,yayisuzugura, akaba acumuye kabiri;yaba yararahiye mu binyoma, ntazababarirwe;koko rero, inzu ye izahora yuzuyemo amakuba.
heading: Jya wirinda amagambo adakwiye

text: Hari imvugo yagereranywa n’urupfu,ntihazagire aho iboneka mu murage wa Yakobo!Ibyo byose bigomba kuba kure y’abemera,ntibazivurugute mu byaha.
Umunwa wawe ntukawumenyereze imvugo iteye isoni,kuko bene ayo magambo ajyana n’icyaha.
Ujye wibuka so na nyoko,nuba uri mu nteko y’abakomeye,ejo utaziyibagirirwa imbere yabo,ukagenza nk’igicucu;bikakuviramo kwifuza kuba utaravutse,maze ukavuma umunsi wavutseho.
Umuntu wamenyereye amagambo asebanya,nta na rimwe mu buzima bwe bwose azemera gukosorwa.
heading: Ibyaha by’ubusambanyi

text: Hari amoko abiri y’abantu bungikanya ibyaha,ubwa gatatu bugatera umujinya.

Irari ryokera nk’umuriro ugurumana,ntirizima ritaragera ku cyo ryaharaniraga.Umuntu utegeza umubiri we ubusambanyi,azabikomeza kugeza ubwo atwitswe n’umuriro.Umuntu ukunda iraha, ibiribwa byose biramuryohera,azatuza ari uko apfuye.
Umuntu ucumuriye ku buriri bwe bwite,aribwira ngo «Ni nde umbona?Umwijima uranyoroshe, n’inkuta zirampishe,ko nta we umbona, naba ntinya iki?Umusumbabyose ntazibuka ibyaha byanjye.»
Amaso y’abantu ni yo aba atinya,ntamenye ko amaso y’Uhoraho amurikaincuro igihumbi kurusha izuba,akabona imigenzereze yose y’abantu,kandi agacengera amabanga yabo yihishe.
Mbere y’uko ibintu byose biremwa, yari abizi,bikomeza bityo na nyuma y’ihangwa ryabyo.
Uwo muntu azahanirwa mu mayira y’umugi,afatirwe aho atakekaga.
Ni na ko bizagendekera umugore uta umugabo we,akamuzanira umwana yabyaranye n’undi.
Mbere na mbere aba yasuzuguye itegeko ry’Umusumbabyose,akongera agacumura ku mugabo we,hanyuma akiyandavuriza mu busambanyi,maze akabyarana abana n’abandi bagabo.
Uwo mugore azaregwa mu ikoraniro,abana be bahanwe.
Abana be ntibazashora imizi,kandi amashami ye ntazera imbuto.
Bazasigara bamuvuma,kandi ikinegu cye cyoye gusibangana.

Abazabaho nyuma ye, bazamenyerahoko nta kiruta gutinya Uhoraho,kandi ko nta kiryohakurusha kwita ku mategeko y’Uhoraho.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 23: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ubuhanga buvuga igisingizo cyabwo,bukivugira rwagati mu ikoraniro.
heading: Igisingizo cy’ubuhanga

text: Mu mbaga y’Umusumbabyose bubumbura umunwa,maze imbere ya Nyir’ububasha bukisingiza, bugira buti:
«Jyewe nakomotse mu munwa w’Umusumbabyose,maze nsendera ku isi nk’umwuka.
Jyewe, nashinze ihema ryanjye mu kirere,intebe yanjye y’ubwami yari mu nkingi y’agacu.
Jyewe jyenyine nazamutse ikirere cy’ijuru,kandi ntembera mu nyenga y’ikuzimu.
Nategetse imivumba yo mu nyanja, ntegeka isi yose,n’amahanga yose, n’ibihugu byose.
Muri ibyo byose nashatse aho nduhukira;ese natura mu mugabane wa nde?
Nuko Umuremyi wa byose ampa itegeko,Uwandemye antegeka gushinga ihema ryanjye,arambwira ati ’Shinga ihema ryawe kwa Yakobo,uhabwe umugabane wawe muri Israheli.’
Yandemye mbere y’ibihe byose, kuva mu ntangiriro,kandi kugeza ubuziraherezo sinzareka kubaho.
Naramukoreye imbere ye mu ihema ritagatifu,naje gutura ntyo muri Siyoni;
ni na ko yampaye kuruhukira mu mugi w’inkundwakazi,none nkaba ntwara muri Yeruzalemu.
Nashinze imizi mu muryango ufite ikuzo,mu mugabane w’Uhoraho, mu murage we.
Narahakuriye nka sederi yo muri Libani,cyangwa umuzonobari wo ku misozi ya Herimoni.
Nakuze nk’umukindo wo muri Enigadi,cyangwa ibiti by’i Yeriko bihunzeho indabo nziza.Nakuze nk’umuzeti utohagiye mu kibaya,nzamuka ngororotse nk’igiti cy’inturusu.
Umubavu wanjye umeze nk’uw’ibiti bihumura,nsakaza impumuro nziza nk’iya manemane yatoranijwe,ndusha ibindi byose bihumura,iyo noshereje ububani mu Ihema.
Jyewe nagabye amashami nk’ay’igiti cy’umushishi,kandi amashami yanjye yera ikuzo n’ishema.
Kimwe n’umuzabibu, nejeje imbuto z’ubugwaneza,kandi umusaruro wanjye ni ikuzo n’ubukungu.
Nimunsange mwebwe abanyifuza,muzahazwa n’ibyiza byanjye.
Koko rero, kunyibuka biryohera kurusha ubuki,umurage wanjye ukaryoha kurusha umushongi w’ubuki.
Abandiyeho bongera gusonza,kandi abanyoyeho bakongera kugira inyota.
Unyumvira ntazagira ikimwaro,kandi abakora ibyo mbategetse, ntibazacumura.»
heading: Ubuhanga n’Amategeko

text: Ibyo byose biri mu gitabo cy’Isezerano ry’Imana Isumbabyose,ni ryo Tegeko Musa yadusigiye,rikaba n’umurage mu miryango ya Yakobo.
Ngiryo itegeko risakaza ubuhanga nk’uruzi rwa Fisoni,cyangwa urwa Tigiri ku mwero w’imbuto;
rigasendereza ubwenge nk’uruzi rwa Efurati,cyangwa Yorudani mu gihe cy’isarura.
Ritangaza inyigisho nk’uruzi rwa Nili,cyangwa urwa Gihoni mu gihe cy’isoroma.
Uwazindutse ntiyarimenya ryose,n’uwaje nyuma ntaramara kuricengera,
kuko ibitekerezo byaryo birusha inyanja ubugari,n’umugambi waryo ukarusha inyenga uburebure.
heading: Umugambi w’umwanditsi

text: Jyewe, ndi nk’umuyoboro uturuka mu ruzi,ndi nk’umugezi ngatemba ngana urwuri.
Naravuze nti «Nzavomerera ubusitani bwanjye,mvomere umurima wanjye»;none dore umuyoboro wanjye wabaye uruzi,uruzi na rwo ruhinduka inyanja!
Nzabengeranisha inyigisho umuseke ugikeba,nyikwize hose kugeza iyo gihera.
Nzongera namamaze inyigisho nk’uhanura,nyisigire ibisekuru bizaza.

Murabona ko atari jye wivunikiye jyenyine,ahubwo nagokeye n’abayishakashaka bose.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 24: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Hari ibintu bitatu umutima wanjye wifuza,bigashimisha Imana n’abantu:ubwumvikane mu bavandimwe, ubucuti mu baturanyi,n’umubano mwiza w’umugabo n’umugore.
heading: Ibintu biboneye n’ibigayitse

text: Hari n’amoko atatu y’abantu, umutima wanjye wazinutswe,n’imibereho yabo ikantera umujinya:abo ni umukene w’umwirasi, umukire w’umubeshyi,cyangwa umusaza w’umusambanyi akaba n’igicucu.
heading: Ikamba ry’abasaza

text: Niba mu buto bwawe nta cyo wigeze uhunika,uzatunga iki mu busaza bwawe?
Byizihira abasaza kumenya gushyira mu gaciro,nk’uko abakuru na bo baberwa no gutanga inama!
Mbega ukuntu ubuhanga bwizihiye abasaza,kimwe n’ubushishozi n’inama ku banyamurava!
Ikamba ry’abasaza, ni uko ari inararibonye,naho ishema ryabo, ni ugutinya Uhoraho.
heading: Ibintu icyenda bitera ubwuzu

text: Hari ibintu icyenda ntekereza mu mutima wanjye,ngasanga biteye ubwuzu,icya cumi na cyo reka nkivugishe ururimi rwanjye.Hahirwa umuntu ushimishwa n’abana be,akanabona abanzi be barimbuka akiriho.
Hahirwa umuntu ubana n’umugore w’umutima,akaba ataracumura ku rurimi rwe,kandi ntabe yaragaragiye udakwiye kumuhaka!
Hahirwa umuntu waronse ubwitonzi,akanabugeza ku bafite amatwi amwumva!
Uwaronse ubuhanga aba akomeye!Ariko ntaba asumba utinya Uhoraho.
Gutinya Uhoraho bisumba byose,none se ubyibandaho, wamunganya nde?
heading: Umugore gito

text: Ibikomere byose birihanganirwa, uretse ibyo ku mutima!Ubugome bwose burihanganirwa, uretse ubw’umugore!
Ibyago byose birihanganirwa, uretse ibivuye ku banzi!Akarengane kose karihanganirwa, uretse agatewe n’umwanzi.
Nta bumara bukara kurusha ubw’inzoka,nta n’umujinya mubi kurenza uw’umugore.
Nahitamo guturana n’intare cyangwa inzoka nini,aho kubana n’umugore gito.
Ubugome bw’umugore bumuhindura isura,akijima agasa n’ikirura.
Umugabo we yicarana na bagenzi be,akaboroga ndetse atabishaka.
Uburyarya bwose buba budakabije ugereranije n’ubw’umugore;amagorwa y’umunyabyaha arakamuhama.
Umugore w’indondogozi avuna umugabo utuza,uko umusozi w’urusenyi unyereza umusaza.
Ntuzashukwe n’uburanga bw’umugore,ntihazagire n’umwe ukurarura.
Iyo umugore ari we utegeka umugabo,usanga biteye umujinya, ishozi n’ikimwaro cyinshi.
Umugore gito ashavuza umutima,akawukomeretsa, kandi akawutera gusuherwa;umugore udashakira umugabo we amahoroamumaramo imbaraga, akamuca intege.
Icyaha cyatangiranye n’umugore,kandi ni we waduteye kuzapfa twese.
Uko wima amazi aho yamenerauzabe ari ko wangira umugore kurondogora.
