Hahirwa umugabo ubana n’umugore w’umutima,iminsi yari kuzamara izikuba kabiri.
heading: Umugore w’umutima n’uw’icyomanzi

text: Umugore w’umunyamwete ashimisha umugabo we,imyaka y’ubuzima bwe yose, azayirangiza mu mahoro.
Umugore w’umutima ni umugabane utagereranywa,maze ukagabirwa utinya Uhoraho.
Baba bakize cyangwa bakennye, umutima wabo uhora ukeye,maze igihe cyose uruhanga rwabo rugahora rwishimye.

Hari ibintu bitatu umutima wanjye utinya,kandi icya kane, kikankangaranya bitavugwa.Hari igisebyo gikwira umugi n’imbaga yivumbagatanyije,hakaba no kuvuga undi ibinyoma,ibyo byose bivunana kurusha urupfu!
Nyamara ariko, umugore wagiriye undi ishyari,ashengura umutima w’umugabo we,mbese nk’aho yapfushije umuntu,kandi ibyo byose, ni ibyago biterwa n’ururimi!
Umugore gito asa n’ikimasa cyivumbuye umuzigo,umwibandaho asa n’upfumbata manyenga.
Umugore w’umusinzi ni agateramujinya,ntashobora guhisha iryo shyano.
Ubushizi bw’isoni bugaragarira ku bigohe no mu maso,ni byo biranga umugore w’icyomanzi.
Umukobwa ushamaduka, jya umurinda ukomeje,ejo atazabura igitsure, akagendanira ko.
Jya wirinda kurangamira amaso ashira isoni,kandi ntugatangare nagukururira mu kibi.
Nk’uko umugenzi wanyotewe yasama,akanywa amazi abonye yose,icyomanzi na cyo aho gisanze ihema kirahicara,kugira ngo kihakirire abahisi n’abagenzi.
Ineza y’umugore inyura umugabo we,n’ubushishozi bwe bukamwongerera imbaraga.
Umugore utuza aba ari ingabire y’Uhoraho,kandi uwarezwe neza nta we wamugereranya.
Umugore utiyandarika arangwa n’ineza ihebuje,kandi nta munzani wapimirwaho umutima utararikira.
Nk’uko izuba rirasira ku misozi y’Uhoraho,ni na ko uburanga bw’umugore butaka inzu iteguye neza.
Nk’uko itara rimurikira ku kinyarumuri gitagatifu,ni na ko amaso abengeranira ku mubiri uteye neza.
Nk’uko inkingi za zahabu ziteye ku mfatiro za feza,ni na ko amaguru meza atereye ku dutsinsino dukomeye.
heading: Ibintu bishavuza

text: Hari ibintu bibiri bishavuza umutima wanjye,n’ikindi cya gatatu kintera umujinya:ni umuntu w’intwari usazana ubutindi,n’abanyabwenge basuzugurwa;hakaba n’uhunga ubutungane akagana icyaha,uwo nyine Uhoraho amuteganyirije kumwicisha inkota.
heading: Ingorane z’ubucuruzi

text: Umucuruzi yirinda icyaha bimugoye,bene uwo muntu ntashobora kubaho adacumura.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 26: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Benshi bacumura kubera irari ry’inyungu,kandi ushaka gukira ahunza amaso.
Nk’uko urumambo rwinjirira hagati y’aho amabuye ahurira,ni na ko icyaha kinugika hagati yo kugura no kugurisha.
Udashishikarira gutinya Uhoraho,inzu ye izarindimuka bidatinze.
heading: Ijambo ni ryo risuzuma umuntu

text: Iyo umuntu amaze kuvuga, amafuti ye arigaragaza,mbese nk’uko iyo bamaze kugosora, hasigara incenshu.
Icyokezo gisuzuma ibibindi by’umubumbyi;n’ikigeragezo cy’umuntu kiba mu biganiro bye.
Imbuto z’igiti zigaragaza umurima giteyemo,n’ijambo rihishura ibitekerezo by’umutima w’umuntu.
Ntukagire uwo urata mbere y’uko avuga,kuko ari ho abantu basuzumirwa.
heading: Gushakashaka ubutungane

text: Nukurikirana ubutungane uzabugeraho,maze ubwambare nk’igishura cy’ikuzo.
Inyoni zibana n’izo zihuje ubwoko,n’ukuri kukagana abagukurikiza.
Uko intare irereka umuhigo wayo,ni ko n’icyaha kigenzereza abatunzwe n’uburiganya.
heading: Ikiganiro cy’ibicucu

text: Amagambo y’umuntu ukunda Uhoraho ahoramo ubuhanga,ariko igicucu gihora gihindagurika nk’ukwezi.
Hagati y’imburabwenge, ntukahamare igihe,ahubwo jya utindana n’abantu bashyira mu gaciro.
Ikiganiro cy’ibicucu gitera ishozi,n’ibitwenge byabo biba bigamije amaraha y’icyaha.
Amagambo y’utukana yorosora umusatsi ku mutwe,maze yatangira intonganya, bose bakipfuka mu matwi.
Intonganya z’abirasi zisesa amaraso,no kumva ibitutsi byabo bikamena amatwi.
heading: Kumena ibanga byica ubucuti

text: Umena ibanga yiyima icyizere,ntiyongere kugira incuti y’inkoramutima.
Kunda incuti yawe, uyibere indahemuka,ariko nuyimenera ibanga, ntukayiruke inyuma.
Nk’uko bica umuntu bakamuhwanya,ni ko nawe uzaba utsembye isano na mugenzi wawe.
Nk’uko umuntu areka inyoni yari afashe mu kiganza ikaguruka,nawe waretse mugenzi wawe aragenda, ntuzamushyikira.
Ntuzirirwe umushakashaka kuko yageze kure cyane,yarahunze nk’impara irokotse umutego!
Mu by’ukuri igikomere kirapfukwa,abantu batukana bakigorora,ariko uwamennye ibanga ntagira igaruriro.
heading: Uburyarya

text: Uwica ijisho aba agambiriye ikibi,kandi nta washobora kukimubuza.
Iyo muri kumwe akubwira agushyeshyenga,n’amagambo yawe akayatangarira;ariko wakwerekera irya agahindura imvugo,imvugo yawe akayihinduramo umutego.
Ibyo nanga ni byinshi, ariko nta cyarusha uwo,kandi Uhoraho na we aramwanga.
heading: Umuntu ahanirwa icyo yakoze

text: Uteye ibuye mu kirere aba ariteye ku mutwe we,kandi ubugome bufata ubugiriwe n’ubugize.
Ucukura urwobo azarugwamo,naho utega umutego uzamufata.
Ugira nabi, inabi izamwokama,kandi ntazamenya n’aho iturutse.
Kunnyegana no gutuka abandi, ni iby’umwirasi,ariko igihano kiramwubikiye nk’intare.
Abashimishwa n’uko abakunda Uhoraho bayobye,bazagwa mu mutego,kandi ububabare buzabazahaza mbere yo gupfa.
heading: Inzika

text: Inzika n’umujinya, na byo ni ibintu biteye ishozi,kandi umunyabyaha aba yarabizobereyemo.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 27: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Uwihorera ku bandi, Uhoraho na we azamwihoreraho,kuko ibyaha byose abibara yitonze.
Jya ubabarira mugenzi wawe ibicumuro bye,bityo nusenga, n’ibyaha byawe bizahanagurwa.
Umuntu urakarira undi akaritsira,yasaba ate Uhoraho ngo amurokore?
Bite se? Yaba atababarira mugenzi we,kandi agatakambira Uhoraho kubera ibyaha bye!
We ubwe, ko agira inzika, kandi ari umubiri ashoreye,ni nde wamubabarira ibyaha bye?
Jya wibuka amaherezo ya byose, maze ureke kwangana;ubwo ugenewe kuzapfa no kubora, ubahiriza amategeko.
Jya wibuka amategeko, woye kugirira inzika mugenzi wawe,wibuke isezerano ry’Umusumbabyose, wange ubuhemu.
heading: Intonganya

text: Jya wirinda intonganya, bizatuma udacumura kenshi,ubise umunyamujinya ukurura intonganya.
Umunyabyaha atera impagarara mu ncuti,agateza amakimbirane mu biberagaho mu mahoro.
Umuriro wakishwa n’inkwi ziwurimo,intonganya na zo zigakururwa no kutamenya kwigarura;uburakari bw’umuntu bukurikiza imbaraga ze,kandi uko akize, ni ko arushaho kurakara.
Impagarara zihutiyeho ziteza inkongi,intonganya zihubukiwe zimena amaraso.
Iyo uhushye igishirira kiraka,wagiciraho kikazima:byombi kandi biba bikozwe n’umunwa wawe.
heading: Ingaruka z’ururimi rubi

text: Ari indondogozi, ari n’indyarya, mubavume,kuko batsembye benshi biberagaho mu mahoro.
Akarimi k’indyarya kagushije benshi,kabatatanyiriza mu mahanga menshi,kashenye imigi ikomeye,karundura n’amazu y’ibikomerezwa.
Akarimi k’indyarya kasendesheje abagore b’umutima,kabatesha ibyo babaga bavunikiye.
Ukishinga, ntaba akiruhutse ukundi,ntashobora kubaho mu mahoro.
Inkoni itera igikomere,ariko ururimi rushengura amagufa.
Benshi bashiriye ku bugi bw’inkota,ariko ni bo bake ku bazize ururimi.
Hahirwa urugendera kure,akaba ataraterwa inkeke na rwo,atarikorera umuzigo warwo,cyangwa ngo aboherwe mu ngoyi zarwo,
kuko umuzigo warwo uremera nk’icyuma,naho ingoyi zarwo zigakomera nk’umuringa.
Ururimi rwica nabi,rurutwa n’inyenga y’ikuzimu.
Nyamara nta cyo ruzatwara abakunda Uhoraho,nta bwo bazatwikwa n’umuriro warwo.
Abataye Uhoraho bo bazawugwamo,ubagurumanemo ubutazima;ruzabashumurizwa nk’intare,rubice urw’agashinyaguro nk’ingwe.
Itegereze, uzitize amahwa isambu yawe,ubike neza feza na zahabu byawe,
maze amagambo yawe uyashakire igipimo n’umunzani,kandi umunwa wawe uwutereho urugi n’ingufuri.

Ujye witonda ururimi rutazagutera gucumura,ukavaho ugwa mu maboko y’abaguhigira.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 28: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Uguriza mugenzi we aba ari umunyampuhwe,kandi umuteye inkunga aba akurikije amategeko.
heading: Inguzanyo

text: Jya uguriza mugenzi wawe igihe abikeneye,kandi nawe wishyure mu gihe cyagenwe.
Jya ukomera ku ijambo ryawe, woye kwivuguruza,bityo, igihe cyose uzabona icyo ukeneye.
Benshi bibwira ko ibyo bagurijwe ari nk’ibitorano,bigatuma batera ingorane ababafashije.
Iyo nta cyo araguha, mugenzi wawe uramuhobera,ukamuvugisha witonze kubera feza ye;ariko igihe cyo kumugarurira ibye cyagera, ukazarira,ukamwishyura amagambo y’ishavu,umuganyira ko wagize ibyago.

N’iyo waba utunze byinshi,uwakugurije nunamwishyuraicya kabiri cy’umwenda wari umurimo,yashobora kuvuga ko agize Imana.Naho nubura ubwishyu uzaba unyereje umutungo we,abe yikururiye umwanzi nta mpamvu,umwitura imivumo n’ibitutsi,kandi aho kubahana, muzasuzugurana.
Benshi banga kuguriza abandi, atari ubugome,ahubwo ari ugutinya guhemukirwa.
heading: Imfashanyo z’abakene

text: Ariko rero, ujye witondera umukene,ntugatindiganye igihe cyo kumufasha.
Ujye ukurikiza amategeko, utabare umukene,kandi kuko akennye, ntukamwirukane amara masa.
Feza yawe, yifashishe umuvandimwe cyangwa incuti,itazagwira ingese mu nsi y’ibuye, igapfa ubusa.
Jya ukoresha ibyawe ukurikije amategeko y’Umusumbabyose,bizakubyarira inyungu iruta zahabu!
Mu bigega byawe, ujye ubikamo imfashanyo z’abakene,ni zo zizakurinda ibyago byose
kurusha ingabo nini cyangwa icumu riremereye;umwanzi nagutera zizakurwanirira.
heading: Kwishingira

text: Umugiraneza yishingira mugenzi we,ariko utakigira isoni, aramutererana.
Ntukibagirwe ineza y’ukwishingiye,kuko aba yaragutangiye ubuzima bwe.
Umunyabyaha asesagura ibyo akesha uwamwishingiye,uw’umutima udashima yirengagiza uwamugobotse.
Kwishingira abandi byahombeje abakire benshi,birabahungabanya nk’umuvumba wo mu nyanja;
byatumye ibikomerezwa byinshi bihunga,bijya kubuyera mu bihugu by’amahanga.
Umunyabyaha wiyemeje kwishingira abandi,ariko agamije inyungu, azacirwa urubanza yihamagariye.
Ujye ufasha mugenzi wawe uko wishoboye,kandi nawe ubwawe witonde, utazisiga iheruheru.
heading: Ba iwawe aho gusembera

text: Icya ngombwa mu buzima, ni amazi n’umugati,hamwe n’umwambaro n’inzu yo kwikingamo.
Kubaho gikene mu kazu k’ibyatsi kawe,biruta kudamararira iw’abandi.
Jya wishimira bike cyangwa byinshi byawe,bityo nta we uzagusuzugura ko ubeshejweho n’abandi.
Kuva mu nzu ujya mu yindi biteye agahinda!Aho ugiye kuraraguza, ntuhagira ijambo.
Ugucumbikiye, umuhereza ibyo kurya no kunywa, ukabigayirwa,ndetse ukumva n’amagambo agusebya, ngo
«Ngwino, wa mwage we, utegure ameza,kandi niba hari ibyo kurya, umpe nirire!
Hoshi, wa mwage we, bisa abakurusha icyubahiro;umuvandimwe wanjye yaje kunsura, nkeneye iyi nzu.»

Ngibyo ibintu bibabaza umuntu uzi guteganya:gucyurirwa ubusembere no guterwa inkeke n’umwishyuza.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 29: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ukunda umwana we amucishaho umunyafu,kugira ngo amaherezo azamwishimire.
heading: Uburere bw’abana

text: Urera neza umwana we abibonamo inyungu,bikamutera ishema muri bagenzi be.
Uwigisha umwana we, atera umwanzi ishyari,yagera mu ncuti ze akanezerwa.
N’iyo se w’umwana yapfa, ntaba agiye uruhenu,kuko aba asize imbuto basa.
Iyo akiriho, ashimishwa no kumubona,maze yapfa ntajyane agahinda.
Aba asigiye abanzi be uzamuhorera,naho abakunzi basigaranye uzabitura ineza.
Utetesha umwana we, azamupfuka ibikomere,kandi uko amwumvise ataka, asuhuze umutima.
Ifarasi yananiranye, ntiyumvira,n’umwana batereye iyo, aba umunyagasuzuguro.
Nutetesha umwana wawe, azaguhindisha umushyitsi,nukina na we, azagutera agahinda.
Ntugasekane na we, hato mutazashavurana,bikakuviramo guhekenya amenyo.
Ntukamureke ngo yigenge akiri muto,
uzamugorore akiri umwana,hato atazanangira umutima, akagusuzugura.
Jya uhana umwana wawe kandi umurere neza,ejo atazagushingana ijosi.
heading: Ubuzima buzira umuze

text: Umukene ufite ubuzima buzira umuze kandi ukomeye,aruta umukire washegeshwe umubiri wose.
Amagara mazima aruta zahabu iyo ari yo yose,kandi umubiri ukomeye uruta umutungo nyamwinshi.
Nta bukire buruta ubuzima bw’umubiri,nta n’ibyishimo bisumba iby’umutima.
Gupfa ukavaho biruta guhora uganya,n’iruhuko ridashira rikaruta kurwara idakira.
Gutereka ibiribwa hejuru y’imva,ni nko kugerageza gutamika uwabumbye umunwa.
Ituro rihawe ikigirwamana riba rimaze iki,kandi kitarya ntikinahumurirwe?N’umuntu ukurikiranywe n’Uhoraho, ni ko ameze,
abonesha amaso ye akaganyira,nk’uko ikimara gipfumbase inkumi gisuhuza umutima.
heading: Ibyishimo by’umutima

text: Umutima wawe ntukawutere agahinda,cyangwa ngo wibabaze ubwawe mu bitekerezo.
Ibyishimo by’umutima, ni bwo buzima bw’umuntu,kandi umunezero ni wo umutera kuramba.
Umutima wawe ujye uwitaho, uwurinde gushavura,ugendere kure agahinda;koko rero agahinda kivuganye benshi,kandi nta cyo kamaze.
Ishyari n’uburakari bitera gukenyuka,n’impungenge zigatuma umuntu asaza imburagihe.

Ibyishimo by’umutima bituma umuntu aryoherwa,kandi ibyo ariye byose bikamunyura.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 30: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ibitotsi bike biterwa n’ubukungu bushegesha umubiri,kandi impungenge zigendana n’ubukire zibuza gusinzira.
heading: Inyungu y’ubukire n’ingaruka mbi zabwo

text: Inkeke yo gushaka kwirwanaho ibuza kugoheka,n’indwara y’igikatu ibuza gusinzira.
Umukire aharanira kurunda umutungo,mu gihe cyo kuruhuka akanezezwa n’amaraha.
Umukene aharanira gushakashaka icyamutunga,hanyuma yaruhuka, ubutindi bukamwokama.
Ukunda zahabu ntazitwa intungane,kandi ukurikiranye inyungu, izamuyobya.
Benshi zahabu ni yo yabateye kurimbuka,mbese bari kubihonoka bate?
Koko rero, zahabu ni umutego ku bayirarukira,ukanafata ab’ibicucu bose.
Hahirwa umukire bazasanga ari indakemwa,kandi akaba atiruka inyuma ya zahabu!
Yaba se ari nde, ngo tumurate?kuko yakoze ibitangaza mu muryango we.
Uwageragejwe atyo agatsinda,bizamubera impamvu yo gukuzwa;yashoboraga gucumura, ntiyabikora,no kugira nabi, arabireka.
Umutungo we uzakomera usagambe,n’imbaga yose irate ineza ye.
heading: Kwifata mu birori uko bikwiye

text: Niba wicaye ku meza y’igikomerezwa,uzirinde kubumbura umunwa,ntuzavuge ngo «Mbega ibiryo biri hano!»
Wibuke ko ari icyahakugira ijisho rirangwa n’irari ry’ibintu.Mu byaremwe, ikirusha ijisho ububi ni iki?Ni yo mpamvu ripfa kurizwa n’ubusa.
Aho uwagutumiye areba, ntukahageze ikiganza,kandi uzirinde kugonganira na we ku isahani.
Uragenzereze abo muri kumwe nk’uko na we wabyifuza,kandi utekereze mu byo ukora byose.
Ujye urya gipfura ibyo baguhaye,kandi wirinde kuvundanya, byagutera icyangiro.
Uzarangize mbere, werekane uburere bwiza,kandi ntukabe indahaga ngo bumirwe.
Nuba wicaranye n’abandi benshi,ntukabanze gukora mu biryo.
Umuntu warezwe neza ntagombera byinshi,n’iyo aryamye ntarara abuya.
Kurya mu rugero, bituma umuntu asinzira neza,yanabyuka mu gitondo akumva akomeye;naho kubabazwa n’ibitotsi bike, ibirutsi, n’imisonga:ngibyo ibihembo by’indahaga.
Niba bakurishije ku gahato,haguruka, ujye kure uruke, bizakorohereza ububabare.
Tega amatwi, mwana wanjye, ntukansuzugure,maze akari kera uzumve ibyo nkubwira.Mu byo ukora byose, ujye ushyiraho umwete,bityo nta ndwara izagutera.
Ukunda gutumira abantu, benshi baramuramya,kandi ibyiza byinshi bamuvugaho, biba ari ukuri.
Naho uzwiho ko agungumiriza, mu mugi baramwinubira,kandi ubugugu bamuvugaho buba ari bwo.
heading: Ibyiza bya divayi n’ingaruka mbi zayo

text: Ntukavuge ko divayi nta cyo yagutwara,kuko divayi yishe benshi.
Iziko rishegesha icyuma mu bushyuhe bwaryo,ni na ko divayi igenzereza abasinda bakirata.
Divayi ni ubuzima ku muntu,iyo uyinyoye mu rugero.Ubuzima bumariye iki umuntu utagira divayi?Kandi yararemewe gushimisha abantu!
Divayi unywereye mu gihe ukayihaga,inezeza umutima.
Divayi wanyoye ukarenza urugero,kubera intego cyangwa ushotorana, igushengura umutima.
Ubusinzi bwongera umujinya w’igicucu,kugeza ubwo gikoze ishyano,bugabanya imbaraga, bugakurura inguma.

Niba mu birori mwanyweye divayi cyane,ntugatonganye mugenzi wawe,ntuzamusuzugurire ko yanezerewe,ntuzamubwire amagambo amutoneka,cyangwa ngo umuhungabanye umwishyuza.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 31: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Niba ari wowe bashinze kuyobora ibirori, ntukikuze;mu bandi, uzabe nk’umwe muri bo,ubiteho, ahasigaye wicare.
heading: Wakwifata ute mu birori?

text: Nurangiza umurimo wari ushinzwe, uzegere amezakugira ngo wishime hamwe na bo,banagushimire umurimo washoje neza.
Vuga wowe, musaza, kuko bikubereye,ariko ubigire ku rugero, kandi uhe umwanya n’indirimbo.
Niba hari ijambo muriho mwumva, ntukaricemo,kandi ntugahugukire kuvuga igihe kitari cyo.
Urufaya rw’indirimbo mu birori banywamo divayini nk’ibuye ry’agaciro riri ku mutako wa zahabu.
Indirimbo inyuze amatwi iherekeje uburyohe bwa divayi,isa n’ibuye ry’indobanure riri ku mpeta ya zahabu.
Musore, nibaguha ijambo nawe uzavuge,usubize incuro ebyiri nibakubaza.
Jya uvunagura amagambo yawe, uvuge byinshi muri make.Ujye wifata nk’uzi byinshi, ariko akamenya no guceceka.
Nuba uri kumwe n’abakomeye, ntukireshyeshye na bo,kandi undi nafata ijambo, wowe wirinde kuvuga.
Nk’uko umurabyo ubanziriza inkuba,n’umuntu wiyoroshya baramushimagiza,ataragira n’icyo avuga.
Igihe nikigera, ujye uhaguruka, ntukazarire,wihutire gutaha, kandi ntuzerere.
Imuhira, ujye wishimisha ukore ikikunyuze,ariko woye gucumura mu magambo y’ubwirasi.
Kandi ibyo byose, ubishimire Uwakuremye,akaguhundagazaho ibyiza bye.
heading: Gutinya Uhoraho

text: Utinya Uhoraho yakira inyigisho ze,kandi abamushakashaka rikirasa, bamuronkaho ubutoni.
Ukurikiza itegeko, riramunyura,naho uriganya, rikamubera impamvu yo kugwa.
Abatinya Uhoraho bazaronka ubutungane,maze ibikorwa byabo byiza, bibengerane nk’urumuri.
Umunyabyaha ntiyemera guhanwa,kandi ahora afite impamvu ziberanye n’icyo we ashaka.
Umuntu w’umujyanama ntasiba gutekereza,umugome n’umwirasi bo nta cyo bakangwa.
Ntukagire icyo ukora nta nama,bityo ntuzicuza ibikorwa byawe.
Ntukagende mu nzira y’imikuku,bityo ntuzatsitara ku mabuye.
Ntukiringire inzira iharuye neza,
kandi witondere n’abana bawe.
Mu byo ukora byose, ujye ukurikiza umutimanama wawe,kuko ari wo utuma wubahiriza amategeko.

Uwemera itegeko yita ku mabwiriza yaryo,uwiringira Uhoraho, nta kibi kizamubaho.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 32: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Utinya Uhoraho, nta cyago kimutera,n’iyo ikigeragezo cyaza yarokoka.
Uwanga itegeko ntaba ari umunyabuhanga,naho urikurikiza aryarya ameze nk’ubwato mu muhengeri.
Umuntu uzi ubwenge yizera itegeko,mbese nk’uko yakwizera igisubizoahawe n’amabuye y’ubufindo.
Jya utegura amagambo yawe, bazakumva,ukoranye ubumenyi bwawe, maze usubize.
Umutima w’igicucu uteye nk’uruziga,kimwe na rwo uhora uzenguruka.
Incuti innyegana imeze nk’ifarasi y’ingaboikoba ushaka kuyurira wese.
heading: Uhoraho ni we ugenga imibereho y’abantu

text: Ni kuki umunsi urusha undi urumuri,kandi urumuri rw’iminsi yose ruva ku zuba?
Ubuhanga bw’Uhoraho ni bwo bwayitandukanije,busobanura ibihe by’umwaka n’iminsi mikuru ibiranga;
imwe yarayamamaje, arayitagatifuza,indi ayishyira mu mubare w’iminsi isanzwe.
Abantu bose bavuye mu gitaka,kandi Adamu yaremeshejwe ibumba.
Uhoraho yabavanguye akoresheje ubuhanga bwe bwinshi,anabanyuza inzira zinyuranye:
bamwe muri bo, abaha umugisha, arabakuza,arabatagatifuza, abagira ibyegera bye,abandi arabavuma, abacisha bugufi,abakura mu mwanya barimo.
Nk’uko ibumba riba riri mu kiganza cy’umubumbyi,akarikoresha uko yishakiye,n’abantu bari mu kiganza cy’Uwabaremye,maze akabahemba akurikije ubutabera bwe.
Ikibi giteganye n’icyiza,n’urupfu ruteganye n’ubuzima,n’umuntu ukunda Uhoraho aba ateganye n’umunyabyaha.
Wiyumvishe ko n’ibikorwa by’Umusumbabyose ari ko biteye,birabangikanye bibiri bibiri, kimwe kikajyana n’ikindi.
heading: Umugambi w’umwanditsi

text: Jyewe naje nyuma, ndashishozank’umuntu uhumba nyuma y’isarura.
Umugisha w’Uhoraho watumye nza bwangu,nuko ngenza nk’umusaruzi nuzuza umuvure.
Mwemere ko atari jye jyenyine wigokeraga,ahubwo naruhiye abashakashaka inyigisho bose.
Nimunyumve rero, bakuru b’umuryango,namwe batware b’ikoraniro, nimuntege amatwi!
heading: Ntuzatagaguze umutungo wawe utarapfa

text: Yaba umwana cyangwa umugore,yaba umuvandimwe cyangwa incuti,ntuzagire uwo wemerera ko agutegeka ukiriho,kandi ntuzagabire umutungo wawe undi muntu,kuko wongeye kubikenera, wagomba kumwinginga.
Nuba ukiriho, ukaba ugihumeka,ntuzagire uwo wemerera kuguhaka,
kuko ikiruta ari uko abana bawe bagutakambira,aho kugira ngo wowe ubategere ibiganza ubasaba.
Ibyawe byose ujye ubitunganya uko ubishaka,kandi wirinde icyagusebya.
Umunsi wawe niwegereza, mbese wenda gupfa,uzabibaheho umurage.
heading: Uko abacakara bagomba gufatwa

text: Indogobe ihabwa ubwatsi, igakubitwa, igatwara imizigo,umugaragu ahabwa umugati, agakosorwa kandi agakora.
Jya ukoresha umucakara wawe, maze uruhuke;niyirirwa anebwa, azashaka kwigenga.
Ingoyi n’ibiziriko bitsikamira ijosi,n’umugaragu w’umugome akwiye inkoni n’ibiboko.
Jya umuhatira gukora, atazaba imburamukoro,kuko kubura umukoro byigisha ibyaha byinshi;
jya umuha akazi kaberanye na we,niyanga kumvira umubohe amaguru.
Nyamara ntukagire uwo urengereza urugero,kandi ntuzagire icyo ukora umurenganya.
Niba utunze umugaragu, ajye amera nkawe ubwawe,kuko uba waramugabanye wese n’amaraso ye.
Niba utunze umugaragu, jya umufata nk’umuvandimwe,kuko uba umukeneye mbese nkawe ubwawe.

Wamara se kumutoteza, akaguhunga,wamushakira mu zihe nzira?Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 33: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Umuntu w’igicucu yizera ibinyoma n’ibintu bitazabaho,kandi inzozi zitera abapfayongo kwiyemera.
heading: Amahomvu y’inzozi

text: Kwiringira inzozi, ni nko gushaka gufata igicu,cyangwa kwiruka inyuma y’umuyaga.
Indorerwamo n’inzozi bifite icyo bihuriraho:uruhanga ubonamo ni ishusho, si umuntu nyakuri.
Mu kintu cyanduye havamo igisukuye gute,cyangwa se ikinyoma cyabyara ukuri gite?
Kuragura, gucuragura n’inzozi, ni ibintu by’amahomvu,bimeze nk’ibitekerezo by’umugore uri ku nda.
Keretse Umusumbabyose naramuka agusuye mu nzozi,naho ubundi ntukaziteho,
kuko inzozi zaroshye benshi,baragwa kubera kuziringira.
Itegeko rigomba gukurikizwa nta kinyoma,kandi ubuhanga bwuzuye buba mu budahemuka.
heading: Akamaro k’ingendo

text: Umuntu wagenze aba yarize byinshi,kandi inararibonye ivuga ibyo izi.
Utarageragezwa aba azi ibintu bike,ariko uwagenze aba yuzuye ubushobozi.
Nabonye byinshi mu ngendo zanjye,nsobanukirwa n’ibiruta ibyo nshobora kuvuga.
Kenshi naguye mu makuba yampitana,ngakizwa n’uko nzi ibintu n’ibindi.
heading: Uhoraho arinda abamutinya bakamukunda

text: Abatinya Uhoraho bazaramba,kuko amizero yabo aba ashingiye ku Ubakiza.
Utinya Uhoraho nta cyo yikanga,ntahinda umushyitsi, kuko Imana ari yo mizero ye.
Hahirwa umutima w’umuntu utinya Uhoraho!None se si we uba wishingikirijeho akawushyigikira?
Amaso y’Uhoraho ahora ayahanze abamukunda,akababera umurinzi ukomeye n’inkingi itajegajega;ahosha inkubi y’umuyaga n’izuba ry’amanywa y’ihangu,abakiza imitego, akanababuza guhanuka.
Ni we ukangura umutima, akamurikira amaso,aravura, agatanga ubuzima n’umugisha.
heading: Ibikorwa binyura Umusumbabyose

text: Utuye igitambo cy’ibyibanoaba atanze ituro ritakirwa,kandi amaturo y’indakoreka ntashimisha.
Umusumbabyose ntanyurwa n’amaturo y’abamwanga,kandi ntababarira ibyaha akurikije umubare w’ibyishwe.
Utuye igitambo yanyaze mu mukumbi w’abakene,aba yiciye umwana mu maso ya se.
Akagati k’abakene ni ko kabatunze,ukabanyaze aba ari umwicanyi.
Unyaze mugenzi we ikimutunga, aba amwishe,naho uwima umukozi igihembo cye, aba amennye amaraso.
Umwe arubaka undi agasenya,ariko se bombi baba bungutse iki uretse umuruho?
Umwe arasenga, undi akavuma,ubwo se Umutegetsi azumva ijwi rya nde?
Uwiyuhagira amaze gukora intumbi, akongera akayikora,ubwo aba yiyuhagiriye iki?

Ni kimwe n’umuntu usiba kurya kubera ibyaha bye,hanyuma akongera agacumura,ubwo se ni nde uzumva isengesho rye?Kuba yaricishije bugufi se, byamwunguye iki?Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 34: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Uwubahirije itegeko aba atanze amaturo menshi,ukurikije amabwiriza aba atuye igitambo cy’ubuhoro,
uwagiriye undi neza aba atanze ituro ry’ifu y’inono,kandi ufashije abakene, aba atuye igitambo cyo gushimira.
Igishimisha Uhoraho ni ukwamagana icyaha,kandi kwanga akarengane, ni nk’igitambo cyo kwicuza.
Ntuzahinguke imbere y’Uhoraho imbokoboko,ahubwo ayo maturo yose jya uyatanga kubera itegeko.
Ibinure by’itungo ry’intungane bibobeza urutambiro,n’impumuro yaryo ikagera ku Umusumbabyose.
Igitambo cy’intungane kirakirwa,kandi kigahora ari urwibutso rutazibagirana.
Ujye ukuza Uhoraho n’umutima ukeye,kandi ntugatsimbarare ku muganura w’ibyo wejeje.
Ibyo utanga byose bijye birangwa n’umucyo,kandi uturane ibyishimo kimwe cya cumi cy’ibyo utunze.
Jya uha Uhoraho ukurikije uko na we yaguhaye,ubikorane umutima ukeye, uko wifite,
kuko Uhoraho azakwitura,akabikwishyura ukubye karindwi.
Ntukagire ibyo utanga ugamije gushukana, ntiyabyakira,kandi ntukishingikirize igitambo cy’uburiganya.
Koko rero, Uhoraho ni umucamanza,nta bwo areba umuntu,
nta we yihanganira arenganya umukene,kandi yumva isengesho ry’urengana.
Ntiyirengagiza amaganya y’imfubyi,cyangwa ay’umupfakazi umutakambiye.
Amarira y’umupfakazi se ntatemba ku matama ye,kandi induru ye ntiba irega umuteye kurira?
heading: Ububasha bw’isengesho

text: Ukorera Uhoraho uko abishaka, arashimwa,kandi isengesho rye rigera mu bushorishori bw’ijuru.
Isengesho ry’uwicisha bugufi ricengera mu bicu,ntarihwemera kugeza ubwo rigera mu ijuru;
ntashirwa atari uko Uhoraho amusuye,ngo arenganure intungane, anasakaze ubutabera.
heading: Igihano cy’amahanga

text: Uhoraho ntazatinda,kandi ntazabihanganira,
kugeza ubwo azarimbura abantu batagira impuhwe,akihorera ku mahanga;
kugeza ubwo azatsemba imbaga y’abirasi,agakuraho ingoma y’abakoresha akarengane;
kugeza ubwo azitura buri muntu akurikije ibikorwa bye,agahemba abantu akurikije imigambi yabo;
kugeza ubwo azacira urubanza umuryango we,akawunezeza awugirira impuhwe.

Tubabarire witegereze, Mutegetsi, Mana ya byose,maze amahanga yose uyasakazemo igitinyiro cyawe.
heading: Isengesho ryo gusabira Israheli ngo irokorwe

text: Hagurukira ibihugu by’abanyamahanga,kugira ngo babone ububasha bwawe!
Nk’uko wabagaragarije ubutabera bwawe igihe uduhannye,ubu natwe tugaragarize ububasha bwawe bubarwanya,
kugira ngo bamenye, nk’uko natwe twamenye,ko nta Mana yindi ibaho itari wowe, Uhoraho.
Erekana ibimenyetso bishya, ukore ibindi bitangaza,uheshe ikuzo ikiganza cyawe, n’ukuboko kwawe kw’indyo.
Vugurura umujinya wawe, ukwize uburakari bwawe,maze utsembe umwanzi, urimbure umubisha.
Gira bwangu, wibuke ibyiza waturahiriye,bajye barata ibikorwa byawe bitangaje.
Umuriro w’umujinya wawe nutwike abacitse ku icumu,maze abatoteza umuryango wawe barimbuke.
Janjagura imitwe y’abatwara amahanga,bo bavuga ngo «Ni twe twenyine dutegeka!»
Korakoranya imiryango yose ya Yakobo,uyisubize umurage wabo nk’uko byari bimeze mbere.
Uhoraho, babarira umuryango witiriwe izina ryawe,ari wo Israheli wigiriye nk’uburiza bwawe.
Girira impuhwe Yeruzalemu, umurwa wawe mutagatifu,yo wahisemo ngo uyigire uburuhukiro bwawe.
Kwiza muri Siyoni ibigwi by’ibikorwa byawe byahebuje,n’umuryango wawe uwusesekazeho ikuzo ryawe.
Rwanirira abo wagize aba mbere mu biremwa byawe,wuzuze ibyahanuwe mu izina ryawe.
Uzahembe abakwizeye,n’abahanuzi bawe babe abanyakuri.
Uhoraho, umva isengesho ry’abagutakambira,ukurikije umugisha Aroni yahaye umuryango wawe,
bityo abatuye isi bose bamenye ko uri Uhoraho,ukaba n’Imana ubuziraherezo!
heading: Ubushishozi

text: Igifu cyakira amoko yose y’ibiribwa,ariko hari ibikiryohera kuruta ibindi.
Akanwa gashima umuhigo ari uko kanuriwe,nk’uko umutima w’ubwenge utahura amagambo y’ibinyoma.
Ufite umutima utanyurwa ahorana agahinda,ariko inyaryenge imenya kuwucubya.
heading: Guhitamo umugore

text: Umugore yemera umugabo ubonetse wese,ariko hari abakobwa baruta abandi.
Uburanga bw’umugore butera umucyo mu maso,kandi burenze ibyo umugabo yifuza byose.
Iyo arangwa n’umutima mwiza n’ituze,umugabo we asumba bene muntu bose.
Uronse umugore aba atangiye gukungahara,ni umufasha we basa, inkingi yishingikiriza.
Isambu itazitiye, irasahurwa,n’ahatari umugore, umugabo araboroga, akohoha.
Ni nde wakwiringira umujura kabuhariwe,uva mu mugi akirukira mu wundi?
N’umuntu utagira aho aba,akarara aho bwije, ni ko ameze!Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 36: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Incuti yose iravuga ngo «Nanjye ndi incuti yawe»,ariko hari uba ari incuti ku izina gusa.
heading: Incuti y’ukuri n’ingirwancuti

text: Ese si ishavu rishengurakubona mugenzi wawe cyangwa incuti ahinduka umwanzi?
Mbega ingeso mbi! Ese waremewe hekugira ngo wuzuze isi yose ikinyoma?
Hari incuti inezezwa n’uko mugenzi wayo yishimye,ariko amakuba yaza ikamurwanya!
Hari n’undi ugokana n’incuti ye,n’umwanzi yatera, agafata ingabo!
Ntukibagirwe incuti mu mutima wawe,kandi nukira ntukayirengagize.
heading: Umujyanama mwiza n’umubi

text: Buri mujyanama ashimagiza inama ze,ariko hari abishakira indonke.
Ujye witondera umujyanama,ubanze umenye icyo agukeneyeho,kuko azafata icyemezo kimufitiye akamaro,maze akakuroha.
Azakubwira ati «Uri mu nzira nziza»,hanyuma akwitarure ngo arebe uko bikugendekera.
Ntukagishe inama abaguhigira;imigambi yawe, jya uyihisha abagufitiye ishyari.

Ntukagishe inama umugore kuri mukeba we,ntukagishe inama ikigwari ku by’intambara,ntukagishe inama umucuruzi ku by’ubugurane,ntukagishe inama umuguzi ku by’ubuguzi,ntukagishe inama umunyeshyari ku by’inyiturano,ntukagishe inama umuntu wikunda ku byerekeye ineza,ntukagishe inama umunebwe ku byerekeye umurimo,cyangwa umucancuro ku byerekeye gusoza umurimo,n’umugaragu w’umunebwe ku byerekeye akazi gakomeye;ntuziringire inama z’abo bantu.
Ahubwo ujye wibanda ku muntu wubaha Imana,uziho ko akurikiza amategeko,umutima we ukaba ukunyura,kandi, waramuka utsinzwe, akababarana nawe.
Kandi ujye utsimbarara ku nama y’umutima wawe,kuko nta wundi wawurusha kukubera indahemuka.
Koko rero, umutima w’umuntu akenshi uramuburira,kuruta ndetse abarinzi barindwi bagenzurira ahirengeye.
Kandi mbere y’ibyo byose, senga Umusumbabyose,kugira ngo akuyobore mu kuri.
heading: Ubuhanga nyakuri n’ubuhanga budafashe

text: Ijambo ni ryo ribimburira igikorwa cyose,kandi mbere yo kugira icyo ukora, ujye ugisha inama.
Umuzi w’ibitekerezo uba mu mutima,na wo ugashibuka amashami ane:
ikibi n’icyiza, urupfu n’ubuzima,byose bikaba bitegekwa n’ururimi!
Hari abantu b’abahanga mu guhugura abandi,kandi na bo ubwabo nta cyo bimariye.
Uwigira umunyabuhanga mu magambo aba ateye ishozi,kandi azabura ibimutunga byose,
kuko Uhoraho atamutonesheje,kandi nta buhanga aranganwa.
Hari abanyabuhanga babikuye ku mutima,amagambo y’ubwenge abava mu kanwa, aba akwiye kwizerwa.
Uri umunyabuhanga koko, ahugura umuryango we,kandi imbuto z’ubwenge bwe zikwiye kwizerwa.
Umunyabuhanga aba yarahundagajweho imigisha,kandi abamubonye bose bamwita umuhire.
Ubuzima bw’umuntu bumara iminsi ibaze,ariko iminsi ya Israheli ntizashira bibaho.
Umunyabuhanga agirirwa icyizere mu muryango we,kandi izina rye rihoraho iteka.
heading: Kutarenza urugero

text: Mwana wanjye, kugira ngo ubeho neza, ujye wisuzuma ubwawe,urebe icyakugirira nabi maze ukirinde.
Koko rero ibintu byose ntibiberanye na bose,kandi bose si ko babikunda byose.
Ntukararikire amaraha yose,cyangwa ngo uhubukire ibiryo,
kuko ibiryo byinshi bitera indwara,kandi kurya ntuhage bitera kuribwa mu mara.

Abantu benshi bishwe no kugira ipfa,naho uhora yirinda gukabya, akomeza ubuzima bwe.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 37: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ujye wubahira muganga ibyo yagukoreye,kuko na we Uhoraho yaramuremye.
heading: Kwivuza bigomba kujyana no gusenga

text: Muganga akiza indwara abihawe n’Umusumbayose,maze umwami akamugabira ibintu.
Ubumenyi bwa muganga buramugaragaza,maze abakomeye bakamutangarira.
Uhoraho ni we waremye ibyatsi bivamo imiti ku butaka,umuntu uzi ubwenge ntayisuzugura.
Ese nta bwo ari igiti cyatumye amazi aryohera,kikamenyekanya gityo ububasha bukirimo?
Uhoraho kandi ni we wahaye abantu ubumenyi,kugira ngo bishimire ibyo yaremye bitangaje;
ni byo bifasha muganga kuvura no gukiza ububabare,uzi imiti arabivangavanga.
Bityo ibikorwa bye ntibigira iherezo,kandi amahoro amuturutseho agasakara ku isi.
Mwana wanjye, nurwara, ntuzirangareho,ahubwo uzasenge Uhoraho, ni we uzagukiza.
Irinde icyaha, ibiganza byawe bibe ibiziranenge,umutima wawe uwusukureho ibyaha byose.
Uzature ububani, n’ifu y’ingano ho urwibutso,umurike ituro ritubutse, utitangiriye itama,
hanyuma uhe umwanya muganga kuko Uhoraho yamuremye,kandi ntuzamuhunge kuko umukeneye.
Hari ubwo koroherwa ari bo uzabikesha,
kuko na bo basenga Uhoraho,kugira ngo abahe ubushobozi bwo kuvura no gukiza,maze bakurokorere ubuzima.
Naho ucumura ku Uwamuremye,arakagwa mu maboko ya muganga!
heading: Kwiraburira uwapfuye

text: Mwana wanjye, ujye uririra uwo wapfushije,utere indirimbo y’ishavu nk’umuntu washegeshwe.Uzashyingure umurambo we uko bikwiye,kandi uzakomeze kubahiriza imva ye.
Uzarire uhogore, wihondagure mu gatuza,umwiraburire nk’uko abikwiye,uzamare umunsi umwe cyangwa ibiri hato batazagusebya,hanyuma wihanagure amarira.
Koko rero guhorana agahinda bikurura urupfu,kandi umutima ushavuye ucika intege.
Icyago ntigitana n’agahinda,nyamara nta wakwihanganira ishavu ridashira.
Ntugatere umutima wawe agahinda,ujye ukirinda, wibuke ko byose bifite iherezo.
Ntuzabyibagirwe, nta garuriro!Nyakwigendera uwo nta cyo waba umumariye,kandi nawe ubwawe waba wigiriye nabi.
Sobanukirwa n’icyo akubwira kuko nawe bikureba:«Ejo yari jyewe, uyu munsi ni wowe!»
Uwapfuye yabonye ikiruhuko, ntugakomeze kumwibuka,akuka nigahera, jya wemera ko agiye.
heading: Abanyabukorikori

text: Ubuhanga bw’umunyamategeko bwiyongera igihe adahuze,kandi udahihibikana mu mirimo azaba umunyabuhanga.
Uwirirwa ayoboye icyuma gihinga yaba ate umunyabuhanga?Aterwa ishema no gufata inkoni,akayobora ibimasa ari na byo bahorana,nta kindi avuga kitari amatungo!
Umutima we wibanda ku guca imingoti,na we akarara ashaka ubwatsi bw’inyana ze.

Ni na ko bigendekera abubatsi n’ababaji bose,bakora amanywa n’ijoro,kimwe n’abashushanya ku makashe,bagashishikazwa no kunyuranya ibishushanyo biyariho;buri wese yibanda kwigana igishushanyo mbonera,akarara amajoro atengeneza akazi ke.

Ni kimwe n’umucuzi wicaye iruhande rw’ibuye acuriraho,akitegereza icyuma kimaze gushya;indimi z’umuriro zikamwotsa,akarwana n’ubushyuhe bwo mu ziko,urusaku rw’inyundo rukamumena amatwi,kandi agahanga amaso ku rugero rw’icyo acura;umutima we ushishikarira gutunganya ibyo akora,akarara amajoro abinonosora neza.
Ni kimwe n’umubumbyi wicaye imbere y’ikibindi cye,akakizengurutsa impande zose,agahora azirikana icyo gikorwa cye,kugira ngo akirangize mu gihe cyagenwe.
Akaragisha ibumba amaboko ye,akarikatisha ibirenge ngo rinoge,umutima we wibanda mu kukinogereza,akarara amajoro asukura icyocyezo.
Abo bose bizera amaboko yabo,kandi buri wese aba ashoboye umwuga we.
Batariho, nta mugi wakubakwa,nta wahatura, nta n’uwahagenda.
Ariko ntibatumirwa mu nama y’umuryango,mu ikoraniro ntibahagaragara,ntibicara ku ntebe y’umucamanza,kandi ntibasobanukiwe n’amategeko.

Si bo barangwaho ubumenyi n’ubuhanga buhanitse,ntunabasanga mu bahimbye imigani.Nyamara ni bo bakomeza umurimo uzahoraho w’Umuremyi,kandi n’isengesho ryabo riberanye n’umwuga bakora.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 38: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Ariko rero ibyo nta ho bihuriye n’utoza umutima wekuzirikana itegeko ry’Umusumbabyose.
heading: Igisingizo cy’umunyamategeko

text: Ashakisha ubuhanga bw’abakera bose,umwanya abonye akawugenera ubuhanuzi,abika amagambo y’abantu b’ibyamamare,
agacengera amabanga y’imigani,agashakisha inyigisho iri mu nshoberamahanga,kandi agahora akurikirana ubuhanga bubihishemo.
Abakomeye abakorera ibyo bamushinze,akamenyekana atyo mu batware.Azenguruka ibihugu by’amahanga,kuko aba ashaka kumenya ikibi n’icyiza mu bantu.
Azinduka mu museso, agatoza umutima wekurangamira Uhoraho, Umuremyi we;asengera imbere y’Umusumbabyose,akabumbura umunwa amwinginga,akamutakambira kubera ibyaha bye.
Nyagasani Uhoraho nabishaka,azasenderezwa umwuka w’ubwenge,avuge amagambo y’ubuhanga,maze mu isengesho rye ahimbaze Uhoraho.
Azarangwa n’inama ziboneye n’ubumenyi buhanitse,kandi azirikane amabanga y’Imana.
Azakwiza ibikubiye mu nyigisho yahawe,anezezwe n’Itegeko ry’Isezerano ry’Uhoraho.
Benshi bazarata ubwenge bwe,kandi ntibuzibagirana;ntibazamwibagirwa na rimwe,izina rye rizahoraho uko ibisekuru bizasimburana.
Amahanga azarata ubuhanga bwe,mu ikoraniro bazamamaze igisingizo cye.
Nabaho igihe kirekire, izina rye rizaruta ayandi menshi,napfa vuba akaruhuka, ibyo bizaba bimuhagije.
heading: Igisingizo cy’ubuhanga Imana iyoborana isi

text: Ndashaka kongera kuvuga ibitekerezo byanjye,kuko bikinyuzuyemo nk’ukwezi kwazoye.
Bana batagatifujwe, nimuntege amatwi,maze mukure nk’ururabyorwameze ku nkombe y’amazi.
Nimukwize impumuro nziza nk’ububani,maze mugwize ururabo nk’amalisi;nimuhanike amajwi muririmbire icyarimwe,mushimire Uhoraho ibikorwa bye byose.
Nimukuze izina rye,mumushimire mumusingiza,mumuririmbire n’iminwa yanyu n’inanga zanyu.maze muzavuge mu gisingizo, muti:
Ibikorwa by’Uhoraho byose ni byiza byahebuje,kandi buri tegeko yatanze rizubahirizwa mu gihe cyaryo.Ntimukibaze ngo «Iki ni iki? Ni kuki kiriya?»,kuko ibintu byose bizasobanuka igihe nikigera.
Kubera ijambo rye amazi yarahagaze, ararundana,avuze rimwe, ibigega by’amazi biraremwa.
Iyo ategetse, icyo yifuza kirakorwa,nta n’umwe ushobora kugabanura umukiro atanga.
Ibikorwa by’ikinyamubiri cyose biri imbere ye,kandi nta washobora kwihisha amaso ye.
Ijisho rye rireba ibuziraherezo,kandi imbere ye, nta gitangaje kibaho.
Ntimukibaze ngo «Iki ni iki? Ni kuki kiriya?»kuko buri kintu cyose gifite icyo cyaremewe.
Umugisha we usendera nk’uruzi,ugakwira ku isi nk’umwuzure,
amahanga yahawe uburakari bwe ho umurage,ni cyo cyamuteye guhindura amazi umunyu.
Inzira ze zibonereye intungane,nk’uko zibogamiye indakoreka.
Ibyiza byaremewe abeza kuva mu ntangiriro,n’ibibi biremerwa abanyabyaha.
Ibya mbere bya ngombwa mu buzima bw’umuntu,ni amazi, umuriro, icyuma, n’umunyu,ifu y’ingano, amata, n’ubuki,divayi, amavuta, n’imyambaro.
Ibyo bintu byose bigirira akamaro abemera Imana,naho abanyabyaha bikababera bibi.
Hari imiyaga yaremewe guhana,iyo Uhoraho yarakaye arayireka igateza ibyorezo byinshi,maze igihe cyo gusenya ikagenda irimbura byose,bityo igahosha umujinya w’Uwayiremye.
Umuriro, urubura, inzara, n’icyorezo,na byo byose byaremewe guhana.
Imikaka y’inyamaswa, manyenga, impiri,kimwe n’inkota ihana abanyabyaha, ikabarimbura,
byose bishimishwa no gukurikiza amategeko ye!Kandi ku isi, bihora bitegereje ko bikenerwa,maze igihe cyagera, ntibirenge ku ijambo rye.
Ni yo mpamvu kuva mu ntangiriro nafashe icyemezo,naratekereje maze ndandika,
nti «Ibikorwa by’Uhoraho byose ni byiza,kandi abihera igihe icyo bikeneye.»
Ntimukavuge rero ngo «Iki gisumbije ububi kiriya»,kuko ikintu cyose kizamenywa mu gihe cyacyo.

None rero, nimuririmbe kandi musingize izina ry’Uhoraho,n’umunwa wanyu wose, n’umutima wanyu wose!Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 39: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Amagorwa menshi yaremewe buri muntu wese,ingoyi iremereye iri kuri bene Adamu,kuva bava mu nda ya ba nyina,kugeza igihe bazasubirira mu gitaka kibabyaye bose.
heading: Amagorwa ya muntu

text: Icyo bahora batekereza, kikabakura umutima,ni inkeke baterwa n’umunsi w’urupfu rubategereje.
Kuva ku wicaye ku ntebe y’ikirenga,kugera ku wivuruguta mu gitaka no mu ivu,
kuva ku wambaye iby’umuhemba n’ikamba,kugeza ku wifubika utwambaro tutameshe,bose barangwa n’uburakari, ishyari, n’impungenge,inkeke, ubwoba bw’urupfu, inzika n’intonganya.
Buri wese, ndetse n’iyo aryamye ku buriri bwe,ibitotsi by’ijoro ntibimworohereza inkeke asanganywe.
Asinzira buke, na bwo ntaruhuke,ibitotsi bikamuhondobereza nk’aho yiriwe akora,agakuka umutima kubera inzozi yarose,mbese agahahamuka boshye umusirikare ucitse ku icumu.
Iyo ibyo birangiye arakanguka,agatangazwa n’igishyika yari afite.
Hari ibintu byagenewe ikinyamubiri cyose,kuva ku muntu kugeza ku nyamaswa,cyakora abanyabyaha bizababaho incuro ndwi;
ibyo ni urupfu, amaraso, intonganya, n’inkota,ibyago, inzara, ibitotezo n’ibyorezo!
Ibyo byose byaremewe kurwanya indakoreka,ni zo zatumye haza umwuzure.
Ikintu cyose kivuye mu gitaka, kigisubiramo,n’ibivuye mu mazi bigasubira mu nyanja.
heading: Umutungo nyawo n’umutungo udafashe

text: Icyitwa ruswa cyose n’akarengane bizacibwa,ariko ubudahemuka buzahoraho iteka.
Umukiro w’abahendanyi ukama nk’umugezi,ukayoyoka nk’inkuba zihindiye mu mvura.
Urambura ibiganza agatanga azishima,naho abanyabugugu bazapfa bashireho.
Abagomeramana ntibagaba amashami,kuko imizi yabo ishorera ku rutare rushinyitse.
Urubingo rumera mu mazi yose no ku nkombe z’uruzi,rurandurwa mbere y’ikindi cyatsi cyose.
Umunyampuhwe ameze nk’ubusitani bwahawe umugisha,kandi imfashanyo atanga zizahoraho iteka.
Umuntu witunze kimwe n’umunyamwuga babaho neza,ariko uwavumbuye ikintu cy’agaciro, arabaruta bombi.
Kugira abana no gushinga umugi bitera kwamamara,ariko ibyo byombi birutwa n’umugore w’umuziranenge.
Divayi n’indirimbo binezeza umutima,ariko guharanira ubuhanga bikabiruta byombi.
Umwirongi n’inanga biryoshya indirimbo,ariko byombi ururimi rwuje ineza rurabiruta.
Ikimero n’uburanga binyura amaso,ariko byombi umurima utoshye urabirusha.
Incuti ihura na mugenzi wayo mu gihe gikwiye,ariko ikiruta ni umugore uhura n’umugabo we!
Abavandimwe n’abatabazi bakenerwa cyane mu makuba,ariko gutanga imfashanyo y’abakene bikarusha kugoboka.
Zahabu na feza bituma umuntu agendana ishema,ariko inama nziza ikundwa kurusha ibyo byombi.
Ubukungu n’imbaraga biha umutima gushyika hamwe,ariko gutinya Uhoraho bikabirusha byombi.Utinya Uhoraho nta cyo abura,kandi nta nkunga yindi yirirwa ashaka.
Gutinya Uhoraho ni nk’ubusitani busesuyeho imigisha,kwibera mu gicucu cyabwo bisumba ikuzo ryose.
heading: Kudasabiriza

text: Mwana wanjye, mu buzima bwawe uzirinde gusabiriza,gusabiriza birutwa no gupfa ukavaho.
Umuntu urarikira ibiri ku meza y’abandi,ubuzima bwe ntibuba bufashe;umuhogo we wanduzwa n’ibiribwa by’abanyamahanga,ari byo umuntu ufite ubumenyi kandi warezwe neza yirinda.

Umuntu utagira isoni aryoherwa no gusabiriza,ariko amaherezo mu nda ye hazagurumana umuriro.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 40: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Wa rupfu we, kugutekereza bitera inkeke,bihangayika umuntu wibera mu bye mu mahoro,utagira icyo akangwa agahirwa na byose,kandi ntananirwe kurya!
heading: Urupfu

text: Nyamunsi we, iteka uciyeribera umuntu w’umutindi utagira imbaraga,cyangwa umusaza washegehwe n’iminsi, uhorana inkeke,akivumbura, kandi yaracitse n’intege!
Ntugatinye iteka urupfu ruzagucira,ujye wibuka abagutanze gupfa, n’abazapfa nyuma yawe.
Ngiryo itegeko Uhoraho yatanze ku kinyamubiri cyose;ni kuki rero wakwanga icyagenwe n’Umusumbabyose?Wabaho imyaka icumi, ijana cyangwa igihumbi,ikuzimu nta we uzagutonganyiriza igihe wamaze!
heading: Igihano cy’abagomeramana

text: Abana b’abanyabyaha bazahinduka urubyiruko ruteye ishozi,ni na bo buzuye mu ngo z’abagomeramana.
Umurage abanyabyaha basigira abana babo uzarimbuka,kandi ikimwaro cyokame urubyaro rwabo.
Umubyeyi ugomera Imana atukwa n’abana be,kuko ari we utuma basuzugurwa.
Muragowe, mwebwe abarwanya Imana,kuko mwanze gukurikiza amategeko y’Umusumbabyose.
Nimuvuka, muzaba muvukiye umuvumo,muzapfa, umuvumo ni wo mugabane wanyu.
Icyavuye mu gitaka cyose, kizagisubiramo,n’abagomeramana ni uko: baravumwa, bakarimbuka.
heading: Kuvugwa neza

text: Umubiri w’umuntu ni ubusa,ariko uwaranzwe n’ubutungane, izina rye ntiryibagirana.
Jya uhangayikwa no kudasebya izina ryawe,kuko ari ryo uzasigarana kurusha ubukungu bwa zahabu.
Ubuzima bwiza bumara igihe,ariko izina rivugwa neza rihoraho iteka.
heading: Isoni nyazo n’umwiryo

text: Bana banjye, mujye muzirikana inyigisho zanjye!Ubuhanga buhishe n’umutungo utagaragara,ibyo byombi biba bimaze iki?
Umuntu uhisha ubucucu bwe,aruta uhisha ubuhanga bwe.
None rero, mujye mukozwa isoni n’ibyo ngiye kurondora;si byiza kugira isoni kubera impamvu izo ari zo zose,kandi abantu bose ntibabona byose kimwe.
Dore ibyo uzirinda kuko byagukoza isoni imbere y’abandi:gusambana, byazigukoza imbere ya so na nyoko,kubeshya, imbere y’umutware n’undi ukomeye,
kugwa mu cyaha, imbere y’abacamanza,no guca ku itegeko, imbere y’ikoraniro ry’umuryango,
kurenganya, imbere ya bagenzi bawe n’incuti zawe,kwiba imbere y’abo muturanye.
Ibyo byose kandi byagukoza isoni imbere y’Imana,Nyir’ukuri kose, ikaba na Nyir’Isezerano!(Uririnde kandi n’ibindi byagukoza isoni, nko:)gushinga inkokora ku mugati,
kugira uwo utuka aguha cyangwa umuha,kwica amatwi abantu bagusuhuza,
kurangamira umugore w’indaya,kwirengagiza uwo mufitanye isano,
kwikubira umugabane ugenewe undi,guhanga amaso umugore washyingiwe,
guterana ubuse n’umuja wawe,— ntuzegere n’uburiri bwe! —
kubwira incuti zawe amagambo azisebya,— ntukagire uwo utuka, umaze kumuha! —
gusubira mu magambo wumvise,no kumena ibanga.

Bityo rero uzamenya neza isoni nyazo,kandi uzaronke ishimwe kuri buri muntu wese.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 41: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Naho ibi bikurikira byo, ntibizagutere isoni,cyangwa ngo ubikurizeho impamvu yo gucumura.
Birimo: gukurikiza itegeko ry’Umusumbabyose n’Isezerano rye,kurenganura umuntu n’iyo yaba ari umugomeramana,
gufatanya na bagenzi bawe kwishyura ibyo mwaguze ku rugendo,kuraga ibyawe incuti zawe,
gukoresha umunzani n’ibipimo bitiba,kuronka byinshi cyangwa bike,
kunguka uguze n’abacuruzi,guhana abana bawe wihanukiriye,no gukubita umugaragu mubi,kugeza ubwo imbavu ziva amaraso.
Umugore gito ashoborwa n’ingufuri,ahanyurwa na benshi, naho ujye ukinga.
Jya ubara kandi upime ibyo ubikije,ibyo ugabye cyangwa ugabiwe, byose ubyandike.
Ntugatinye guhana umupfayongo n’igicucu,cyangwa umusaza washegeshwe n’iminsi, uregwa ubusambanyi.Gutunganya ibyo byose bizaguha kumenya isoni nyazo,kandi bikuviremo gushimwa n’abantu bose.
heading: Impungenge umwari atera se

text: Buri gihe umwari atera se impungenge,igishyika amugirira ntigituma agoheka:iyo akiri inkumi, ashobora kugumirwa,iyo arongowe, ashobora gusendwa.
Akiri isugi, ashobora guhumanywa,agatwarira inda kwa se;iyo afite umugabo, ashobora guhemuka agasambana,cyangwa yashyingirwa akagumbaha.
Umwari ushamadutse, jya umugenzura ukomeje,hato atazavaho agusekesha mu banzi,ukaba iciro ry’imigani mu mugi, imbaga yose ikaguhururira,kandi akagukoza isoni mu ikoraniro ry’imbaga.
heading: Kwitondera abagore

text: Umuntu uwo ari we wese ntukamukundire uburanga,kandi ntuzicare mu nteko y’abagore,
kuko uko mu myambaro havamo inda,mu bagore naho havamo ubugome bubaranga.
Ubugome bw’umugabo busumba ineza y’umugore;umugore akoza isoni, agateza ikimwaro.
heading: II. IKUZO RY’IMANA / A. UBUHANGANGE BW’IMANA MU BIREMWA BYAYO

text: Reka mbibutse ibikorwa by’Uhoraho,ibyo nabonye mbibatekerereze.Ijambo ry’Uhoraho ni ryo ibiriho byose bikesha kubaho.
Izuba riramurika rikareba ibintu byose,n’ibikorwa by’Uhoraho byuzuye ikuzo rye.
Ndetse n’intungane nta bwo zahawekwamamaza ibitangaza bye byose,bya bindi Uhoraho Umushoborabyose yagennye,kugira ngo isi n’ijuru biganze mu ikuzo rye.
Acengera inyenga n’imitima,akamenya imigambi yayo yihishe,kuko Umusumbabyose afite ubumenyi bwose,ahanze amaso ibimenyetso bigenga ibihe.
Ni we utangaza ibyahise n’ibizaza,akanahishura ibyahishwe.
Nta gitekerezo cy’umuntu kimucaho,nta n’ijambo na rimwe rimwihisha.
Ibiriho byose yabitunganyishije ubuhanga butangaje,kuko nta ntangiriro agira, habe n’iherezo;nta cyo yigeze yiyongeraho, nta n’icyo yagabanutseho,nta mujyanama yigeze akenera.
Mbega ukuntu ibikorwa bye byose biteye ubwuzu!Agace kabyo umuntu areba, kangana n’igishashi cy’umuriro.
Ibyo byose biriho kandi bizahoraho iteka ryose,bifite icyo byagenewe kandi bikumvira Uwabiremye.
Ibintu byose bigenda ari bibiri bibiri,kimwe giteganye n’ikindi;nta cyo yaremye kituzuye,

kandi kimwe gishyigikiye ikindi!Ese ni nde uzahaga kureba ikuzo rye?Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 42: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Ishema ry’ijuru ni ikirere kizira amakemwa,ni cyo buranga bw’ijuru ritamirije ikuzo.
heading: Izuba n’ibindi binyarumuri byo mu kirere

text: Izuba iyo rirashe ryamamazaukuntu igikorwa cy’Umusumbabyose gitangaje!
Ku manywa y’ihangu ryumisha ibyo mu gasozi,ni nde wahangara ubushyuhe bwaryo?
Bacanira itanura kugira ngo umuriro ugurumane,ariko izuba ritwika imisozi incuro eshatu kurushaho,aho ricaniriye hacumba icyokotsi,ryakohereza imirasire yaryo, rigahuma amaso.
Uhoraho wariremye ni igihangange,kandi aho rinyura ryihuta rihayoborwa n’ijambo rye.
Ukwezi na ko, kubonekera igihe cyako,kugatandukanya ibihe, kukaba ikimenyetso gihoraho.
Ukwezi ni ko kuranga ko iminsi mikuru yegereje,kandi iyo kumaze kuzora, guhita kugabanuka.
Ni ko amezi akomoraho amazina yayo,uburyo kugenda kwiyongera kunagabanuka biratangaje;ni ko kuyobora ingabo zose zo mu ijuru,bya binyarumuri bibengeranira mu kirere.
Uburanga bw’ijuru, ni inyenyeri zakirana,ni imitako imurika mu ijuru ry’Uhoraho.
Zikurikiza amategeko Nyir’ubutungane yazihaye,kandi nta bwo zita imyanya yazigeneye.
Jya witegereza umukororombya ushimire Uwawuremye,usanga ufite ubwiza butangaje,
uzengurutsa ijuru uruziga rw’ikuzo,rwabanzwe n’ibiganza by’Umusumbabyose.
heading: Ibindi byiza bitatse ikirere n’isi

text: Ni we utegeka urubura kugwa,akohereza imirabyo;
ni yo mpamvu iyo ibigega bye bifungutse,ibihu biyoyoka nk’inyoni.
Ku bw’imbaraga ze, akorakoranya ibicu,na byo bikabyara amahindu.
Iyo imisozi imubonye, ihinda umushyitsi;
ijwi ry’inkuba ye ritigisa isi yose.
Ku bushake bwe, umuyaga wo mu majyepfo urahuha,
kimwe n’inkubi y’uwo mu majyaruguru, na za serwakira.
Akwiza urubura, rukamera nk’inyoni zimanukiye hasi,rugahongobokera ku butaka nk’isanane,maze urwererane rwarwo rukanyura amaso,warubona rugwa ukumirwa.
Anyanyagiza urubura ku isi nk’umunyu,maze ubukonje bukaruhindura nk’imigera y’amahwa.
Umuyaga ukonje wo mu majyaruguru urahuha,amazi akareka gutemba agahinduka nk’ibuye,aho amazi ari hose bikagenda bityo,ugasanga amazi akomeye nk’urutare.
Hari n’undi muyaga usatura imisozi,ugatwika ubutayu, ukayogoza imirima nk’umuriro.
Nyuma ariko hagahita igicu kizanye amafu,wa muyaga utwika ugashira, hakaza ikime kikabobeza.
Nk’uko yabifatiye umugambi, yahosheje inyenga ngari,maze ayishyiramo ibirwa.
Abagenda mu nyanja batubwira ububi bwayo,maze ibyo baturondoreye bikadutangaza cyane:
Ibyababayeho ni akataraboneka kandi birahimbye,bayibonyemo amafi ahambaye n’ibindi bikoko biteye ukwabyo.
Nyamara ubwato bugera ku cyambu, bubikesheje Uhoraho,maze byose bigatungana bikurikije ijambo rye.
Twashobora kubitindaho, ariko ntashira ararekwa,cyakora muri make: «Ni we maze byose».
Wakura he imbaraga zo kumukuza?kuko ari we gihangange, agasumba ibiremwa bye byose;
Uhoraho aratinyitse, ni Umutegetsi bidasubirwaho,ububasha bwe buratangaje.
Nimusingize Uhoraho, mumurate uko mubishoboye,n’ubwo asumba kure ibisingizo byose!Mu kumutaka, nimwongere imbaraga zanyu;ntimunanirwe, ntimuzagera ubwo murangiza.
Ni nde wamubonye ngo amuvuge?Ni nde wamurata nk’uko bikwiye koko?
Hari n’ibindi byinshi byihishe biruta ibyo twavuze,kuko ibyo tubona ari igice gito cy’ibikorwa bye.

Koko rero Uhoraho yaremye ibintu byose,n’abamwubaha abaha ubuhanga.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 43: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Sign up or sign in
Mureke dusingize abantu bacu b’ibyamamare,ba bakurambere bacu uko ibisekuru byabo byagiye bisimburana.
heading: B. UBUHANGANGE BW’IMANA MU MATEKA YA ISRAHELI / IGISINGIZO CY’ABAKURAMBERE

text: Uhoraho yabahaye ikuzo ryinshi,yaberekaniyemo ubuhangange bwe kuva kera na kare.
Barimo abategetsi mu gihugu cyabo,n’ibyamamare kubera ububasha bwabo.Ni bo bahanuriraga rubanda,
bakayoboresha umuryango inama zikomeye,kandi bakawigishanya ubwenge bwinshi,n’amagambo y’ubuhanga bw’inyigisho zabo.
Bahimbye n’indirimbo zinogeye amatwi,bandika n’ibisigo;
bari abantu bakize, bakagira n’ububasha bwinshi,kandi bakibera iwabo mu mahoro.
Abo bose bahimbajwe n’abo mu gihe cyabo,kandi bakiriho bari ishema rya rubanda.
Benshi muri bo basize izina ryamamaye,ku buryo na n’ubu dushobora kubavuga ibigwi.
Hari kandi n’abibagiranye burundu,barazimira nk’aho batabayeho,bahinduka nk’aho batigeze babaho,kimwe n’abana babakurikiye.
Nyamara ariko, dore abantu baranzwe n’ineza,ibikorwa byabo by’ubutungane ntibyibagiranye.
Ababakomokaho bakomeza umurage mwiza,ari wo uranga n’urubyaro rwabo.
Ababakomokaho bibanda ku masezerano,bakayatoza n’abana babo.
Urubyaro rwabo ruzabaho iteka,n’ikuzo ryabo ntirizasibangana.
Imibiri yabo yahambwe mu mahoro,ariko amazina yabo azavugwa mu bisekuru byose,
amahanga yose azataka ubuhanga bwabo,n’ikoraniro rizamamaze igisingizo cyabo.
heading: Henoki na Nowa

text: Henoki yanyuze Uhoraho, nuko avanwa mu bantu,ibyo bibera ibindi bisekuru igitangaza.
Nowa yabonyweho kuba indakemwa koko mu gihe cy’uburakari,ni we ubwoko bw’abantu bwashibutseho;kubera we, ku isi hagize igisigara,igihe habaye umwuzure.
Uhoraho akorana na we amasezerano y’iteka,kugira ngo hatazagira ikinyamubiri cyongera kwicwa n’umwuzure.
heading: Abrahamu

text: Abrahamu ni umubyeyi ukomeye w’amahanga menshi,kandi nta muntu n’umwe wigeze amurusha ikuzo.
Yakurikije amategeko y’Umusumbabyose,agirana isezerano na we.Iryo sezerano yarishinze mu mubiri we,hanyuma ageragejwe asanganwa ubudahemuka.

Ni yo mpamvu Imana yamurahiyekuzahera amahanga yose umugisha mu nkomoko ye,ko izabagwiza nk’umukungugu wo ku butaka,abamukomokaho bakangana n’inyenyeri zo ku ijuru,ko umurage wabo uzava ku nyanja ukajya ku yindi,ukava no ku Ruzi ukagera ku mpera z’isi.
heading: Izaki na Yakobo

text: Izaki na we amusezeranya atyo,kubera se Abrahamu.

Umugisha w’abantu bose n’isezerano rye,Uhoraho yabikoranyirije ku mutwe wa Yakobo,yongera kumwizeza imigisha ye,kandi amuha n’igihugu ho umurage;yagiciyemo imigabane,ayigabanya ya miryango cumi n’ibiri.Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 44: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices? Mu bamukomokaho yiboneramo umugiraneza,washimwe n’abantu bose,agakundwa n’Imana n’abantu:Uwo ni Musa twibuka tumushimagiza.
heading: Musa

text: Uhoraho yamuhaye ikuzo ringana n’iry’intungane ze,amugira igihangange gitera abanzi ubwoba.
Amagambo ye yahosheje ibyago byo mu Misiri,Uhoraho aramukuza imbere y’abami,amuha amategeko agenewe umuryango we,anamuhishurira ku ikuzo rye.
Kubera ubwitonzi n’ubudahemuka bye, yaramwiyeguriye,amuhitamo mu bantu bose.
Yamwumvishije ijwi rye,amujyana mu gicu kijimye,amuha amategeko imbonankubone,ya mategeko y’ubuzima n’ubumenyi,kugira ngo yigishe Yakobo Isezerano ry’Uhoraho,na Israheli ayitoze amabwiriza ye.
heading: Aroni

text: Yakujije Aroni, wari intungane kimwe na Musa,akaba n’umuvandimwe we, wo mu nzu ya Levi.
Yamushinze umurimo uzahoraho,amugabira ubuherezabitambo mu muryango we.Yamwambitse imyambaro imubereye,amuha n’igishura cy’ikuzo.
Yamutamirije ububengerane bwinshi,amwambika ibimenyetso by’ubutware,n’amakabutura, n’ikanzu itatse, n’umusanganyagituza.
Yamuhaye inshunda zo kuzengurutsa ku mwambaro we,n’amayugi ya zahabu impande zose,maze uko atambutse akarangira,ijwi ryayo rikumvikanira mu Ngoro,bikabera urwibutso abana bo mu muryango we.

Yamwambitse umwambaro mutagatifu, uboshye mu budodobwa zahabu n’ubw’umuhemba tukutuku, wakozwe n’abadozi,amuha n’umusesuragituza ugenewe kumara impaka,waboshywe mu budodo butukura n’ababijijukiwemo;ukabamo n’amabuye y’ubufindo;

yawutatseho amabuye y’agaciro asharazwe nka kashe,kandi yasizwe zahabu n’umubaji w’amabuye;kuri yo hari handitsweho amazinay’imiryango yose ya Israheli,kugira ngo itazagira ubwo yibagirana imbere y’Uhoraho.
Ku gitambaro cyo mu mutwe we,yamutamirije ikamba rya zahabu,ryanditseho ngo «Uweguriwe Uhoraho».Mbega imitako itangaje ikanakoranwa ubuhanga,mbega imirimbo ihebuje, ikanogera amaso!
Mbere ye, nta cyiza nk’icyo cyagaragaye,nta munyamahanga wigeze kwambara nk’ibye;keretse abana be, n’abuzukuru be ubuziraherezo.
Ibitambo bye birashya bikayoka,kabiri ku munsi, ntibihwema.

Musa ni we wamweguriye Uhoraho,amusiga amavuta matagatifu.Koko byamubereye isezerano rihoraho,kimwe n’abamukomokaho, igihe cyose ijuru rizabaho,bakazakorera Imana,kandi bagatunganya umurimo w’ubuherezabitambo,baha n’umuryango umugisha mu izina ry’Uhoraho.
Yamuhisemo mu bantu bose,kugira ngo amurikire ituro Uhoraho,amurike ububani n’umubavu wurura ho urwibutso,maze asabire umuryango we imbabazi z’ibyaha.
Yamushinze amategeko ye,amuha n’amabwiriza y’Isezerano rye,kugira ngo yigishe Yakobo Itegeko rye,kandi amurikire Israheli ku byo itegetswe.
Abanyamahanga bamwivumbuyeho,bamugirira ishyari mu butayu;abantu ba Datani n’aba Abiramu,hamwe n’agatsiko ka Kore, baramurakarira bikabije.
Uhoraho abibonye, ntibyamunyura,kubera umujinya we mwinshi, bose bararimbuka,abaterereza ibyago, abatsembesha umuriro we ugurumana.
Yongereye ikuzo rya Aroni, amuha n’umugabane,amugenera umuganura w’imbuto za mbere,amuha cyane cyane umugati akeneye wose.
Ni koko, barya ibitambo byatuwe Uhoraho,yarabimweguriye, we n’abamukomokaho.
Ariko nta munani ahabwa mu gihugu,nta mugabane agira mu muryango,kuko Uhoraho yamubwiye ati «Jyewe ubwanjye,ni jye murage wawe n’umugabane wawe.»
heading: Pineyasi

text: Pineyasi, mwene Eleyazari, ni we wa gatatu mu ikuzo,kuko yashishikariye kubahisha Uhoraho,akanga kuva ku izima umuryango wasubiranyemo;yakomeje umutima we,maze Israheli imukesha ityo kubabarirwa ubuhemu bwayo.
Byatumye Uhoraho agirana na we isezerano ry’amahoro,amugira umutware w’Ingoro, n’uw’umuryango we,kugira ngo we n’abamukomokaho bonyine,bahererekanye ubuherezabitambo bukuru ubuziraherezo.
Nanone Uhoraho yagiranye isezerano na Dawudi,mwene Yese, wo mu nzu ya Yuda;ariko umurage w’umwami wegukana umwe mu bahungu be,umurage wa Aroni, wo wahererekanyijwe n’urubyaro rwe rwose.

Uhoraho nabashyire ubuhanga mu mutima,kugira ngo murebane ubutungane umuryango we,bityo amahirwe yawo atazayoyoka,kimwe n’ikuzo ryawo mu bisekuru byawo byose!Currently Selected:Mwene Siraki 45: KBNTHighlightCopyCompareShareWant to have your highlights saved across all your devices?
